entries.zh: §S《遥远繁星》§!故事包为星系带来了更多奇异遭遇者的故事，以及虚空深处蛰伏的生物
entries.en: §SDistant Stars§! is a story pack that enlivens the galaxy with stories about strange encounters and creatures, in the uncharted depths of space

entries.zh: 我们推荐§S《遥远繁星》§!，因为你选定的部分设置与其以探索太空和科学发现为核心的机制和内容吻合。
entries.en: We're recommending §SDistant Stars§! as some of the variables you've selected suit its content, centered as they are on exploring space and making new scientific discoveries.

entries.zh: 传感器表明在[Root.GetName]轨道上存在有潜在价值的实体。
entries.en: Sensors register potentially interesting entities in orbit of [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 传感器表明在[Root.GetName]地表存在有潜在价值的发现。
entries.en: Sensors register potential finds on the surface of [Root.GetName].
The [Root.GetName] has found a cache of minerals.
The [Root.GetName] has found a cache of energy credits.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]发现了一处物理学研究成果贮藏。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has found a cache of physics research.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]发现了一处社会学研究成果贮藏。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has found a cache of society research.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]发现了一处工程学研究成果贮藏。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has found a cache of engineering research.
The [Root.GetName] has found a mineral deposit on [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]报告其在[From.GetName]发现了行星规模的晶体，晶体携带并不断产生自然电荷。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] reports that it has found a planetside deposit of crystals carrying - and generating - a natural charge, on [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上发现了一处物理学研究储备点。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has found a physics research deposit on [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上发现了一处社会学研究储备点。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has found a society research deposit on [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上发现了一处工程学研究储备点。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has found an engineering research deposit on [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 整个星球被某种无法穿透的能量屏障封闭了。
entries.en: This entire world is encased in some kind of impenetrable energy barrier.

entries.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]轨道上检测到了不明来源舰体的遗骸。
entries.en: Sensors report a shipwreck of unidentified origin has been sighted in orbit of [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 虽然[From.GetName]这颗星球上缺乏大气，但地表上有人造设施的遗迹，说明过去这里曾有文明。
entries.en: Despite the planet's lack of atmosphere, there is evidence of some kind of artificial structures on [From.GetName] that may indicate a past civilization.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]周围的吸积盘呈现出绚丽的折射光谱，与彩虹的无异。造成这种现象的原因会是什么？
entries.en: The accretion disk around [From.GetName] exhibits a remarkable refraction spectrum, not unlike that of a rainbow. What could be causing it?

entries.zh: 我们发现[From.GetName]的轨道上有未知舰队，我们向他们发出联络，但他们没有回复。
entries.en: Readings suggest the presence of an unknown fleet in orbit of [From.GetName]. They do not respond to hails.

entries.zh: 探测器发现在[From.GetName]的地表有着异常高的对称性。
entries.en: Scanners indicate an unusually high level of symmetry on the surface of [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]这个行星体的表面覆盖着某种灰色物质，该灰色物质拥有十分怪异的性质和复杂多变的金属成分。
entries.en: The planetary body [From.GetName] appears to be covered in some manner of grayish substance, possessing strange properties and varying metallic composition.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]周围有着高度异常的重力读数。
在[From.GetName]的上层大气中发现有东西在移动，好像是一艘舰船在云层中高速穿梭。
entries.en: There is movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName], as though a ship was gliding hurriedly through the clouds.

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]的近距离轨道上发现不明舰体的碎片。
entries.en: There are fragments of an unknown vessel in close orbit of [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 对废弃的环形世界[From.GetName]的初步成像显示出在某些毁坏的区段上有着大量完好无损的舱体。这些舱体里装载的东西未知是什么。
entries.en: Initial imaging of the ruined [From.GetName] ring world indicates a number of intact vats located on some of the dilapidated sections. Whatever these vats might hold is unknown.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]小行星的共振成像显示其内部含有稀有水晶。
entries.en: Resonance imaging of the [From.GetName] asteroid suggests an internal composition consisting of rare crystals.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]具有显著的非球面特征，其地表有着巨大且完全不符合地理学模型的构造。
entries.en: [From.GetName] is remarkably aspherical, possessing some sort of enormous formation on its surface that defies geological models.

entries.zh: 从某个未知源点发散的网状结构在[From.GetName]的表面周期性发光。
entries.en: Glowing webs of an unknown origin periodically illuminate the surface of [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的发射光谱表明这颗气态巨行星的主要构成成分拥有和某种流行的酒类饮料相同的分子结构。
entries.en: The emission spectra of [From.GetName] suggest the gas giant's primary composition has the same molecular structure as a popular inebriant.

entries.zh: 对[From.GetName]进行扫描后发现该星球地壳中有不少共鸣水晶，我们应该能对此加以利用。
entries.en: Scans of [From.GetName] reveal a continental crust filled with resonant crystals. We may be able to make some use of them.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的磁层对我们的研究用无人机产生了强大的吸引力，原因不明。我们应该进行进一步的调查。
entries.en: [From.GetName]'s magnetosphere is highly appealing to our research drones in orbit, for reasons they cannot explain. We should investigate further.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的地表上覆盖了一层非常奇特的植物，这与该星球上的其他植物都不相同。
entries.en: Entire continents on [From.GetName] are blanketed in a strange growth that seems at odds with the rest of the planet's flora.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的地表是冻土，但测量到的表面温度却高达上百度，是什么造成了这种不一致的现象呢？
entries.en: The measured surface temperature of [From.GetName] is in the hundreds of degrees, despite its frozen surface. What could be causing these discrepancies?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的大气将我们的传感器在无线电频段的扫描全数反射。在这下方有着什么东西在持续干扰我们的信号。
entries.en: The atmosphere of [From.GetName] is reflecting our sensors at radio frequencies. Something down there is interfering with our signals.

entries.zh: 扫描显示在[From.GetName]的水层之下隐藏着一个错综复杂的隧道系统。是谁创造了它们？
entries.en: Scans suggest an intricate system of tunnels lies hidden beneath the waters of [From.GetName]. What could have created them?

entries.zh: 一座荒废的空间站悬浮在轨道上，无力地环绕着[From.GetName]，身披数个世纪里被残骸冲撞而留下的伤痕。考虑到它破损的状态和无法识别的科技，我们需要一个专家团队来对它进行调查。
entries.en: Scarred by centuries of debris impacts, a dilapidated relic of a station hangs in orbit, trailing wearily behind [From.GetName]. Its decrepit state and unrecognized technology will require a team of specialists to investigate.

entries.zh: 这些在[From.GetName]遍布灰尘的地表上勉强度日的土著和我们在同一个星系的另一个死寂星球上发现的物种具有惊人的相似性。
entries.en: The primitives eking out an existence on the ashy plains of [From.GetName] are remarkably similar to the ones discovered on another tomb world in the same system.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的脉冲十分稳定，其日震研究表明它的内部构成物质的密度比我们所预计要大得多。是什么赋予了它这种令人惊异的密度？
entries.en: [From.GetName] pulses steadily, its helioseismology indicating an internal composition far denser than expected. What could be responsible for this surprising density?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]地表上有许多火山口喷出热气，这对于熔融星球来说是不常见的，部分喷出的热气有较高的工业价值。
entries.en: A remarkable array of gases are being vented on [From.GetName] - ones not usually found on molten worlds. Some of these gases show promising industrial value.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的内部扫描图像表明星球地表之下有非常巨大的地下洞窟，它们可能值得调查。
entries.en: Interior imaging of [From.GetName] suggests massive underground caverns wait below the planet's surface. They may be worth investigation.

entries.zh: 一些人工构造从[From.GetName]的剧毒云层中挺立而出。
entries.en: Some manner of artificial structure peaks out from between the toxic clouds of [From.GetName]'s atmosphere.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的扫描结果标示了一些被土著居民抛弃的聚落。在聚落的建造者身上究竟发生了什么事情？
entries.en: Scans of [From.GetName] reveal what appear to be the abandoned settlements of a primitive society. What manner of fate could have befallen their builders?

entries.zh: 深到能从轨道直接进行观察的峡谷勾勒出了[From.GetName]表面的纹路，但是这颗行星却像风沙侵蚀区一样干燥。曾经如此强烈地侵蚀了[From.GetName]岩层的那些水怎么了呢？
entries.en: Canyons deep enough to be seen from orbit furrow the surface of [From.GetName], yet the planet is dry as a dustbowl. What could have happened to the water that once so profoundly carved [From.GetName]'s' stone?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的植物数量多到惊人地充斥了整个地表，这些植物体积庞大且拥有鲜艳的颜色，我们的异星生物学家对此很感兴趣。
entries.en: Plant life of truly incredible proportions dominates the landscape of [From.GetName], its vibrant colors and gargantuan size almost calling to our xeno-biologists.

entries.zh: 有种不同寻常的东西，仿佛催眠了[From.GetName]上海洋的潮起潮落一般。海洋的运动模式与我们目前所知的所有潮汐行为均不相同。
entries.en: There is something unusual, almost hypnotic about the soft undulations of the sea covering [From.GetName]. Its motions match no known projections for tidal behavior.

entries.zh: 传感器显示在[From.GetName]上有一个孤立的针状人工结构。
entries.en: Sensors indicate an isolated pinprick of artificial structures on [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]的初步调查显示了该行星是某个亡故帝国的旧都，我们之前遇到的垃圾场正是属于这个帝国的。对其进行更彻底的调查或许能获得更多的信息。
entries.en: Our initial survey of the [From.GetName] suggests this planet is the fallen capital of a lost empire whose junkyards we have encountered prior. A more thorough investigation may yield further information.

entries.zh: 一个来源不明的箱体围绕着[From.GetName]旋转，其中大量贮藏了某种有机物质。
entries.en: A derelict tanker of unknown origin orbits [From.GetName], its reservoirs heavy with some manner of organic substance.

entries.zh: 一群静止的吊舱环绕着[From.GetName]，我们开始时以为这是个小行星带。
entries.en: First thought to be asteroids, a halo of motionless drop pods surrounds [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]附近有非常奇特的能源信号，好像整个星球都在时隐时现一样。
entries.en: Enigmatic energy readings surround [From.GetName], as though the entire planet is wavering in and out of existence.

entries.zh: 传感器显示在[From.GetName]厚密的植被之下埋藏着人工构造。
entries.en: Sensors indicate there are artificial formations buried beneath rich vegetation on [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 舰船传感器在[From.GetStarName]星系检测到了一种无法解释的信号干扰模式。
entries.en: Ship sensors are picking up an unexplained pattern of interference in the [From.GetStarName] System.

entries.zh: 我们在[From.GetStarName]星系的小行星群，靠近[From.GetName]的地方定位了一个反射了我们传感器信号的物体。通过肉眼观察发现该物体具有多边形外形，但因为缺乏扫描数据，我们对它所知甚少。
entries.en: An object that reflects our sensors has been located in the [From.GetStarName] asteroid field, near [From.GetName]. Visual observation has identified the object as polygonal in shape, but due to lack of scanner data, little else is known.

entries.zh: 我们登上[Root.GetName]的船员报告了[From.GetName]的船只残骸似乎是一场意料之外的恒星磁风暴的杰作。由于生命支持系统彻底下线，以及因为损伤无法行动，补给船只能无助地漂流直到进入[From.GetName]的重力井。没有人幸存下来。\n\n船只的货舱确实有数额可观的矿物
entries.en: Our crew aboard the [Root.GetName] report that the [From.GetName] shipwreck appears to have been the result of an unexpected geomagnetic solar storm. The supply ship suffered a complete loss of life-support systems and sustained inoperable damage, drifting until it entered [From.GetName]'s gravity well. There are no survivors.\n\nThe ship's cargo-hold does indeed contain a notable amount of minerals

entries.zh: $distar.1.desc$——但是，[Root.GetName]的舰长谨慎的表明这是§Y[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]§!的舰船设计。\n\n这些矿物很可能属于§Y[wreckage_owner.GetName]§!，如果我们认领了他们的载货，他们很可能不悦。
entries.en: $distar.1.desc$ - however, the captain of the [Root.GetName] cautions that the construction indicates §Y[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]§! design.\n\nIt is highly likely that the minerals belong to the §Y[wreckage_owner.GetName]§!, and they may be displeased should we lay claim to their shipment.

entries.zh: 我们还是不要与他们发生冲突为好。
entries.en: We will not risk an altercation.

entries.zh: 将船上的矿物归还给§Y[wreckage_owner.GetName]§!。\n此举会让对方十分满意并让我们获得£influence£ §H影响力§!。
entries.en: Return the minerals to the §Y[wreckage_owner.GetName]§!.\nThis will please them and increase our £influence£ §HInfluence§!.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们发现前往§Y[wreckage_owner.Capital.GetName]§!的一艘失踪的§Y[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]§!补给船由于受损严重而漂流至[Root.GetAdj]空间之内，然后那艘船上的货物就被你们偷走了。\n\n你们真的以为我们不会发现吗？§Y[wreckage_owner.GetName]§!强烈要求你们立刻将我们船上的物资归还给我们。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It has come to our attention that a missing §Y[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]§! supply ship sustained terminal damage en route to §Y[wreckage_owner.Capital.GetName]§! and drifted into [Root.GetAdj] space, where it was promptly and unceremoniously pilfered of its cargo.\n\nDid you really believe this transgression would go unnoticed? The §Y[wreckage_owner.GetName]§! requests the immediate reimbursement of our supplies.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们发现有一艘前往§Y[wreckage_owner.Capital.GetName]§!的§Y[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]§!补给船失踪了。我们的探测器报告说那艘船进入了[From.From.GetName]星系，你们的人在那里将船上的货物偷走并挪为己用了。\n\n我们无法接受你们的这种行为，请立刻归还我们的货物，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It has come to our attention that a missing §Y[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]§! supply ship sustained terminal damage on its path to §Y[wreckage_owner.Capital.GetName]§!. Our sensors report our vessel entered the [From.From.GetName] system, where your kind emptied its cargo for your own uses.\n\nUnacceptable. Return our cargo at once, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们会归还你们的物资。
舰船残骸上的货物已归还
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们收到了关于我们补给船所运载的货物的消息，我们万分感谢你们在没有[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]介入的情况下花费时间回收了这些货物。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We have received word of our downed supply ship's cargo. We would like to extend our gratitude to you for taking the time to recover it, without the need for [wreckage_owner.GetAdj] intervention.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的船员十分兴奋的发现在[From.GetName]上有工业时代文明的遗迹。调查表明[From.GetName]在过去的数百万年里一直维持着大气层，直到恒星[From.GetStarName]那不稳定的表面所发出的超强耀斑导致了行星大气层的失控电离化逃逸和耗散。

在失去大气层之后数千年间，[From.GetName]上那些了无生机的城市都被封冻于时间长河之中。这是纪念发生于此处大灭绝的无声纪念碑。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]警告任何在[From.GetStarName]星系的殖民都可能受制于恒星无常的暴怒。
entries.en:
The crew of the [Root.GetName] were intrigued to find the remnants of an industrial-age civilization on [From.GetName]. Investigation indicates [From.GetName] had sustained an atmosphere for millions of years, until massive superflares from the unstable surface of the star [From.GetStarName] led to runaway ionization and depletion of the planet's atmospheric gases.

With no atmosphere, the lifeless cities on [From.GetName] have been frozen in time for millennia, silent monuments to the mass extinction that happened there.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] cautions that any colonies in the [From.GetStarName] system may be subject to the whims of the star's turbulence.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上的传感器发现[Root.GetStarName]表面正呈现出在超强耀斑出现之前所特有的动荡现象。考虑到[frozen_in_time_planet.GetName]远古文明的命运，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]正在争分夺秒设计一个护盾矩阵来抵挡即将到来的巨量等离子喷发。
entries.en: Sensors on [Root.GetName] indicate that [Root.GetStarName] is exhibiting surface turbulence typical to that preceding a superflare. Considering the fate of the ancient civilization on [frozen_in_time_planet.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are scrambling to devise a shield matrix capable of withstanding the impending enormous plasma ejection.

entries.zh: 传感器发现[Root.GetStarName]的亮度达出现了一次激增。看来该恒星正在产生超强耀斑，这和当初摧毁了[frozen_in_time_planet.GetName]文明的超强耀斑基本一致。\n\n万幸的是，没有[Root.GetAdj]殖民地会被这场恒星暴动波及。
entries.en: Sensors have registered a massive spike in [Root.GetStarName]'s luminosity. It appears the star is experiencing a superflare, not unlike the one that destroyed the civilization on [frozen_in_time_planet.GetName].\n\nFortunately for us, however, there are no [Root.GetAdj] colonies that will be affected by this solar turbulence.

entries.zh: 我们必须保护我们的人民！
行星管理部门很高兴汇报到在[Root.GetName]周围建立的超强耀斑护盾矩阵非常成功，我们的殖民者不但可以安全避开有害的等离子辐射，还享受到了太阳风击打在全新的护盾矩阵上产生的炫目多彩的极光盛宴。
entries.en: Planetary administration is pleased to report that the development of a superflare shield matrix around [Root.GetName] was a complete success. Our colonists were not only safely shielded from the harmful ionizing radiation, but were treated to a spectacular auroral display as solar wind interacted with the new shield matrix.

entries.zh: 来自[fromfromfrom.GetStarName]的超强耀斑轰击了[fromfromfrom.GetName]的上层大气，我们没能及时布置起防护超强耀斑的护盾矩阵。\n\n等离子喷流和磁场风暴导致了整个行星范围内的电子干扰，妨碍了能源产出并裹挟着辐射冲击了人民。这一灾难性后果还将持续一段时间。
entries.en: A superflare from [fromfromfrom.GetStarName] has struck the upper atmosphere of [fromfromfrom.GetName], pending our failure to develop an appropriate shield matrix in time.\n\nIonizing plasma and magnetic storms have led to electronic disruptions planetside, interfering with energy production and blasting the populace with radiation. The effects will persist for some time.

entries.zh: 环绕着[From.GetName]的吸积盘中的一种气态成分似乎是造成黑洞周围色差的原因。吸积盘折射及反射表面上的光，造成了令人印象深刻的暗中彩虹。\n\n尽管彩虹本身只是一种光学幻象，创造了彩虹的环境却不是。[From.GetName]的吸积盘具有很高的能量——是真正的静电放电温床。
entries.en: The gaseous composition of the accretion disk surrounding [From.GetName] appears to be responsible for the chromatic aberration exhibited by the black hole. The disk refracts and reflects light on its surface, giving the impression of a rainbow in the dark.\n\nThough the rainbow itself is an optical illusion, the circumstances creating it are not. [From.GetName]'s accretion disk is highly energetic - a veritable hotbed of electrostatic discharge.

entries.zh:
通过对在[From.GetName]星系的未识别舰队的身份码的调查，我们得到了意料之外的发现。舰队实际上并不位于黑洞的安全轨道，而是跨过了事件视界。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]推测舰队在数世纪之前就抵达了[From.GetName]的事件视界，在这里时间膨胀使得舰队在黑洞表面留下了它们的影像。

舰队是有意采取了这样的行动，还是遭受了不幸了事故，我们可能永远无从知晓。它们的身份识别码与所有已知文明都无法匹配。
entries.en:
Investigation of the unrecognized fleet signatures in the [From.GetName] system revealed an unexpected discovery. The fleet is not, in fact, in safe orbit of the black hole, but rather crossing its event horizon.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] conjectures that the fleet approached [From.GetName]'s event horizon centuries ago, whereupon time dilation left their image detectable on its surface.

Whether the fleet's actions were intentional, or the result of some unhappy accident, we may never know. Their signatures match no known civilization on record.

entries.zh:
在研究[From.GetName]地表的过程中，[Root.GetName]的船员发现了早期太空文明的遗迹。尽管该文明没有幸存下来的个体，该行星上仍然居住着由它们建造的原始机器人。

这些机器人依旧执行着它们的任务，不知疲倦地修理着它们早已消亡的创造者建造的残破的基础设施。

在未来任何的殖民者都能利用这些远古机器人作为劳动力。不管其他方面，这些机器人已经证明了自己具有足够的韧性。
entries.en:
In studying the surface of [From.GetName], the crew of the [Root.GetName] discovered the ruins of an early space age civilization. Though no living members of this civilization remain, the planet is still inhabited by the rudimentary robots they constructed.

These robots still go about their tasks, tirelessly repairing the crumbling infrastructure of their long-dead makers.

Any future colonists may be able to make use of this ancient robotic workforce. If nothing else, they've certainly proved themselves resilient.

entries.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民者将需要处理这些星球表面的远古机器人，我们推测它们是在某种厄运降临于其创造者之后被遗留至今。\n\n许多这些古董机器人对我们的存在做出了反应，以完全陌生的腔调对我们进行了反复的询问。我们认为它们在等指令输入。它们似乎并不具有情感，并且很可能缺乏更先进的逻辑推理功能。
entries.en: Our colonists on [Root.GetName] will need to deal with the ancient robots on its surface, who we presume were left behind when whatever fate befell their makers spared them.\n\nMany of these antiquated automatons have responded to our presence, making repetitive queries in an alien tongue. We believe they are awaiting input. They do not appear to be sentient, and it is likely they lack higher reasoning functions.

entries.zh: 我们的政策自有国情在此，禁止使用人工智能。
entries.en: Our policies prohibit the use of AIs for a reason.

entries.zh: 虽然我们不需要这些机器人，但就这么毁掉它们也太草率了。
entries.en: We have no need of them, but it would be remiss to destroy them.

entries.zh: 我们不可能与无灵魂的东西共存。
entries.en: We cannot coexist with the soulless.

entries.zh: 我们要将它们整合起来。

[Root.Owner.GetAdj][Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]表示有兴趣研究[Root.GetName]上的远古机器人以及它们创造者文明的灭亡。迄今，研究者们仍未找到决定性证据表明是什么灭绝了这些机器人的创造者——一个几百年间越发扑朔迷离的谜题，这段时间足以将任何有机质残留化为烟尘。

尽管对星球的检视排除了核毁灭或者大范围战争灭绝事件，背后的真相却一直在躲避着我们。

研究者们建议开展更多对远古机器人硬件的详尽研究以尝试寻得更进一步的见解。
entries.en:
[Root.Owner.GetAdj] [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have expressed interest in studying the ancient robots on [Root.GetName], and the demise of the civilization that created them. Thus far, researchers have found no definitive proof of what eradicated the robots' makers - a puzzle exacerbated by the centuries that have long since turned any biological remains to dust.

Inspection of the planet has ruled out nuclear annihilation and extensive warfare as extinction events, but still the reason behind their disappearance eludes us.

Researchers recommend launching a more intensive study of the ancient robots' hardware in an attempt to glean further insights.

entries.zh: 我们从[From.From.GetName]上的原始机器人损坏储存驱动器恢复的数据印记被证明难以解析。其中包含的信息无法在我们的神经网络中完全处理，而这些设备的年代只是数据不连贯的一部分原因。但我们现在可以确定的是似乎某种生化传染病在数个世纪前感染了[From.From.GetName]上原始机器人的有机造物主。最终，被感染者只能坐等死亡。
entries.en: The data imprints we recovered from the battered storage drives of the primitive robots on [From.From.GetName] proved difficult to parse. The information contained therein cannot entirely be processed by our neural networks, though the age of the devices is only part of the reason for their incoherence. We do know that it appears some kind of biological contagion infested the organics who created the rudimentary robots on [From.From.GetName], centuries ago. By the end, the infected begged for death.

entries.zh: 在对[From.From.GetName]上的原始机器人进行深度扫描过程中，[Root.GetLeaderName]成功定位了包含了某种日志信息的储存区域。数据由于硬件的衰败而极度损坏，但还是有一些有希望的条目被挽救并翻译。
entries.en: While deep-scanning the rudimentary robots on [From.From.GetName], [Root.GetLeaderName] has managed to locate a unit with some manner of logs in its storage partition. The data has been largely corrupted by hardware degradation, but several promising entries have been salvaged and translated.

entries.zh: \n§H<<音频中只有几句外星语言的尖叫，随着一声巨响后，一切归于死寂。>>§!
entries.en: \n§H<< The recording is nothing but several alien voices screaming, followed by sounds of impact, then static. >>§!

entries.zh: 我们收到了关于[Root.GetName]上一些殖民者不稳定的行为的报告，情况令人担忧。这些行为从思维混乱到极端亢奋，以及有少数个案表现出了难以解释的暴力行为。受影响的居民难以进行交流，因此我们无法替他们的行为找出合理的动机。\n\n到目前为止，我们尚不能确认造成这些行为的真正原因——是生物，化学或其他原因。我们的研究者强烈建议在事态失控前开展有针对性的科学调查。
entries.en: We have received troubling reports of erratic behavior among some of our colonists on [Root.GetName]. The behavior ranges from confusion to extreme agitation, and isolated cases of unexplained violence have been observed. Affected citizens are difficult to communicate with, and as such are unable to provide sufficient reasoning behind their actions.\n\nAt this point, we are unable to identify a clear cause behind the behavior - whether it be biological, chemical or otherwise. Our researchers strongly recommend launching a targeted scientific inquiry before the situation gets out of hand.
Get to the bottom of this.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上越来越多的居民陷于困顿和焦虑中，并逐步展现出几周前我们在小部分隔离人群中观察到的古怪行为。更让人担忧的是，相当一部分居民已经开始表现出躁动和暴力倾向。\n\n我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]警告说情况会继续恶化下去，除非我们能找到问题的根源。
entries.en: More colonists on [Root.GetName] have succumbed to confusion and agitation, exhibiting the erratic behavior we first observed in isolated populations weeks ago. A concerning number have also begun to display aggression and violent tendencies.\n\nOur [Owner.GetScientistPlural] warn the situation is likely to continue to degrade until we are able to find a cause.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上的形势正在逐渐失控。被焦虑和愤怒支配的民众比例已经达到了一个临界点。更糟糕的是，一部分拥有武器的人口也被卷入其中了！\n\n激烈的武装冲突在居民区爆发，冲垮了维持秩序的民兵部队。暴怒的人群不断自相残杀，并将周围的更多人一并卷入其中！
entries.en: The situation on [Root.GetName] is spiraling out of control. The percentage of affected colonists displaying unexplained agitation and aggression has reached a boiling point. Worse yet, this includes portions of the populace with access to weaponry!\n\nOutright skirmishes have broken out in our settlements, overwhelming civil peacekeeping forces. Enraged colonists are attacking one another, and anyone else who comes in range!

entries.zh: 暴怒的民众正在攻击自己的[Root.GetName]殖民者同胞！
entries.en: Enraged civilians are attacking their fellow colonists on [Root.GetName]!

entries.zh: [From.From.GetName]上暴怒的殖民者已经被我们的部队平定镇压了。不幸的是，由于导致这些异常行为的原因仍然未知，我们无法确定下一次暴力浪潮什么时候会再次到来。\n\n我们最杰出的生物学家十分怀疑是某种影响生理行为的传染病从中作祟，并正在废寝忘食尝试遏制它们的扩散！
entries.en: The enraged colonists on [From.From.GetName] have been pacified by our troops. Unfortunately, without understanding the cause behind their unexplained behavior, we have no way of knowing how long it will be before violence erupts again.\n\nOur premier biologists heavily suspect some kind of behavior-affecting contagion is at play, and are working around the clock to isolate it!

entries.zh: [From.From.GetName]上暴怒的殖民者已经被我们的部队平定镇压了。不幸的是，由于导致这些异常行为的原因仍然未知，我们无法确定下一次暴力浪潮什么时候会再次到来。\n\n我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]强烈建议，我们应在更多的惨剧发生前执行一次针对性的医学调查。
entries.en: The enraged colonists on [From.From.GetName] have been pacified by our troops. Unfortunately, without understanding the cause behind their unexplained behavior, we have no way of knowing how long it will be before violence erupts again.\n\nOur [Owner.GetScientistPlural] strongly recommend commencing a targeted medical inquiry, before any more tragedies can occur.

entries.zh:
我们的科研队伍为确定[Root.GetName]上异常行为的源头而深入险境，但不幸悲剧降临。尽管他们采取了完备的预防措施，几名研发队的成员仍然开始表现出典型的侵略性症状，由此导致的混乱造成了数位科学家丧生。

不幸中的万幸是，我们发现了这次愤怒瘟疫的元凶：一种空气传播的病毒，能够影响受害者的基础神经系统。

研究团队剩余的人员已经开始争分夺秒地研发疫苗。
entries.en:
Tragedy has struck the research team leading the charge in isolating the cause behind the erratic behavior on [Root.GetName]. Despite extensive countermeasures, several members of the team began to display aggression typical of the condition, and in the ensuing chaos, several scientists were killed.

There is, however, a silver lining. We have discovered that the cause behind this epidemic of erratic behavior is infectious: a contagion caused by an airborne virus that affects the fundamental neurology of its victims.

The remaining team is scrambling to develop a vaccine.

entries.zh: 狂怒病毒疫苗开发成功

针对席卷[Root.GetName]人口的狂怒瘟疫的疫苗研发已经圆满完成。疫苗的分发工作已经开始，[Root.GetName]上的生活也将很快回到正轨。

研究显示导致这场动荡的逆转录病毒似乎几百万年前已经在[Root.GetName]上演化成形了。它们之前一直休眠藏身于被封冻的生物质内，在行星的冰盖溶解后重见天日。

很有可能就是这种病毒导致了远古机器人的造物主在几个世纪前的灭亡。幸运的是，[Owner.GetName]对处理病毒污染物能力更强。开发对应疫苗的过程甚至让我们在医学领域取得了一些进步。
entries.en:
The development of a vaccine to treat the epidemic affecting our populations on [Root.GetName] has successfully concluded. Distribution of the vaccine has begun, and life on [Root.GetName] should soon return to normal.

Research has revealed that the retrovirus behind this turmoil appears to have evolved on [Root.GetName] millions of years ago. Lying dormant in frozen biomatter, it resurfaced when the planet's icecaps melted.

It is very likely this led to the demise of the ancient robots' makers, centuries ago. Luckily, the [Owner.GetName] is better equipped to deal with viral contaminants. The development of this vaccine has even led to some advancements in the field of medicine.

entries.zh:
经过仔细分析后，[Root.GetLeaderName]发现覆盖[From.GetName]表面的奇怪金属物质实际上是由数十亿纳纳米机器人构成！这些纳米机器人是能自我复制的微型机械，可能是由以前的文明出于未知目的而创造。

这些纳米机器人的体积和密度十分惊人，它们覆盖在星球表面，总质量达数十亿吨。看起来这些自我复制机器人在过去的某个时刻进入了一种失控复制的状态，吞噬了这颗行星以及地表上的一切。

在研究这些机器人的过程中，船员们获得了一些令人兴奋的发现，毫无疑问会对我们的科学研究大有助益。
entries.en:
After detailed analysis, Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has discovered that the strange metallic substance coating the surface of [From.GetName] in fact comprises of billions upon billions of nanites! These nanites are microscopic, self-replicating micro-machines, perhaps created by a past civilization for some unknown purpose.

The volume and density of this nanite sludge is remarkable, adding billions of tons of mass to the underlying planet. It would appear these tiny self-replicators entered a state of runaway reproduction at some point in the past, engulfing the planet and everything on it.

In studying the nanites, the crew has made some exciting new findings that will undoubtedly aid us in our own research.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]附近诡异信号进行研究的过程中，[Root.GetName]上的船员发现整个恒星系的重力分析读数高到爆表。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]怀疑[From.GetName]星门以某种方式干扰了我们的传感器，或者以某种方式造成该恒星系中隐藏着大量不可见物质。\n\n对星门进行更深入的研究也许能带来更多的收获。
entries.en: In studying the bizarre readings surrounding [From.GetName], the crew of the [Root.GetName] have discovered that the entire system's gravitometrics are off the charts. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suspects that the [From.GetName] gateway is somehow interfering with our sensor data, or otherwise responsible for the unaccounted-for mass in the system.\n\nA more detailed study of the gateway may yield more insight.

entries.zh:
对[From.GetStarName]传送门的研究并不如预计的那样顺利。探测器检测到的引力效应读数远高于预估值，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]一直跟踪异常数据直达其源头，也就是某个被遗弃的时空管道的中心。他们在那里发现的一切永远的改变了他们。

在他们归来后的几天里，[Root.GetLeaderName]说在遥远星际的虚空彼端有巨大的难以描述的建筑，[Root.GetLeaderName]说那些巨大建筑发出无法抵抗的强大引力，将我们的星系拉向它们那边。

这次任务让考察队队员惊悚不已，但就在他们刚从时空管道那里回来没过不久，那异常的数据却突然消失了。
entries.en:
Examination of the [From.GetStarName] gateway did not proceed as anticipated. With sensors registering gravitational influence orders of magnitude beyond expected values, Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] chased the source to the very center of the derelict spacetime conduit. What they found there appears to have changed them.

For days following their return, [Root.GetLeaderName] spoke of massive, indescribable structures of matter in the void of space far beyond any stars. Exerting an inexorable gravitational pull, [Root.GetLeaderName] claims our galaxy streams helplessly, inevitably towards them.

The mission has left the team shaken, no less for the fact that shortly after the experience in the conduit, the abnormal readings suddenly stopped.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]已经定位了[From.GetName]上层大气层中异动的根源。令人吃惊的是，那不是一艘躲在云层里的舰船，而是一只幼年变形虫，而它的母亲则不知所踪。

我们无法得知这个幼体是如何与它的母亲和同类分离的，但有一点可以确定：它看上去已经对[Root.GetName]产生了印刻效应。当船员们结束了对[From.GetName]的调查之后，他们发现这只变形虫在跟踪他们。显然它很难被甩掉，而且[Root.GetLeaderName]对这只幼体的决心很是欣赏。

我们的科学专员建议允许这只变形虫一直跟随我们的船只，他坚信我们能从中学到更多关于变形虫的知识。
entries.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located the source of the movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName]. Surprisingly, there was no ship hidden in the clouds, but rather a young Space Amoeba, its mother nowhere to be seen.

There is no way of knowing how this juvenile was separated from its mother or others of its kind, but one thing is certain: it appears to have imprinted on the [Root.GetName]. As the crew completed their survey of [From.GetName], they found that the Amoeba was following them. It has proven difficult to shake, and [Root.GetLeaderName] has taken quite a shine to the youngster's determination.

Our Science Officer suggests allowing the juvenile to follow the vessel, certain we may learn more about Space Amoebas in the process.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]已经定位了[From.GetName]上层大气层中异动的根源。令人吃惊的是，那不是一艘躲在云层里的舰船，而是某种温驯的外星生命体。尽管有着惊人的体型，这只被[Root.GetName]船员称为太空变形虫的生物似乎还处于幼年期。

我们无法得知这个幼体是如何与它的同类分离的，但有一点可以确定：它看上去已经对[Root.GetName]产生了印刻效应。当船员们结束了对[From.GetName]的调查之后，他们发现这只变形虫在跟踪他们。显然它很难被甩掉，而且[Root.GetLeaderName]对这只幼体的决心很是欣赏。

我们的科学专员建议允许这只变形虫一直跟随我们的船只，他坚信我们能从中学到更多关于变形虫的知识。
entries.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located the source of the movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName]. Surprisingly, there was no ship hidden in the clouds, but rather a docile alien lifeform. Despite its impressive size, the creature, which the [Root.GetName] crew have dubbed a Space Amoeba, appears to be a juvenile.

There is no way of knowing how this juvenile was separated from its others of its kind, but one thing is certain: it appears to have imprinted on the [Root.GetName]. As the crew completed their survey of [From.GetName], it found that the creature was following them. It has proven difficult to shake, and [Root.GetLeaderName] has taken quite a shine to the juvenile's determination.

Our Science Officer suggests allowing the juvenile to follow the vessel, certain we may learn more about the species in the process.

entries.zh: 绝对不行。继续尝试甩掉它。
entries.en: Out of the question. Just keep avoiding it.

entries.zh: 尝试甩开跟随[Root.GetName]的变形虫幼体。
entries.en: Attempt to shake the Amoeba juvenile following the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们当然可以深入研究它。准备进行解剖。
entries.en: We can certainly study it. Order a dissection.

entries.zh:
前段时间加入我们舰队的变形虫幼体现在看来已经完全成年了。尽管已经成长为了一位引人注目的大姑娘，她对那艘在自己被困[From.From.GetName]之时给了她一个新家的科研船还是忠心耿耿。

与舰队共处的岁月让她展现出了不同于野生变形虫的适应性行为，使得她在战场上成为了一个远比其同类更为强大的战力。在整个[Root.Owner.GetName]，她的身影已经成为了一个代表[Root.Owner.GetAdj]精神的吉祥物。

只剩下一个问题：我们应该为她取个什么名字？
entries.en:
The Amoeba juvenile that joined our fleet some time ago appears to have reached full maturity. Now an impressive adult, she is no less loyal to the ships that gave her a new home when she was stranded on [From.From.GetName].

Her time spent with the fleet appears to have encouraged adaptive behaviors not typically found in wild Space Amoebas, making her a more formidable presence on the battlefield than others of her kind. Across [Root.Owner.GetName], her image has become something of a mascot for the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] spirit.

Only one question remains: what should we name her?

entries.zh: 这些名字矬爆了，我们得想个更好的。
entries.en: These are all terrible. We should think of something better.

entries.zh: 研究人员汇报道，先前在[From.From.GetName]发现的落单幼年变形虫已经不再跟随我们的科研船了。在跟随我们的科研船几周之后，变形虫幼体据称通过某种生物超空间驱动机能进入了一条超空间航道。也许它认出了那里的地形，或许它感应到了同类，又或者它只是厌倦了追随我们的船只。\n\n尽管我们的舰船遵循指令没有和变形虫幼体进行互动，被动扫描还是为我们带来了一些有关这只生物的生理学发现。
entries.en: Researchers report that the lost Amoeba juvenile found near [From.From.GetName] is no longer following our science fleet. After doing so for the past several weeks, the juvenile reportedly entered a hyperlane via some biological hyperdrive capacity. Perhaps it recognized the terrain, or sensed others of its kind. Or perhaps it simply tired of chasing after our ship.\n\nThough our ships refrained from interacting with the juvenile as instructed, passive scans have led to some revelations regarding the creature's physiology.

entries.zh: 对幼年变形虫的解剖已经完成。尽管大部分机体组织在捕获过程中被摧毁了，对残骸进行的外星生物学研究依然揭示出其优异的再生能力。
entries.en: The dissection of the Amoeba juvenile has completed. While large portions of the body were destroyed during the creature's pacification, xenobiological analysis of the remains have revealed remarkable regenerative qualities.

entries.zh:
$distar.53.desc.base$

简而言之，这生物的组织再生并不仅仅通过细胞复制进行，还依靠一种硅基细菌辅助其器官组织重构。

对该细菌的遗传信息进行适当的修改后，我们或能利用这种自我修复能力开发出一种船体自愈矩阵，不过这过程相当缓慢。
entries.en:
$distar.53.desc.base$

Simply put, the creature regenerates not only via cell-replication, but with the assistance of a silicon-based bacteria that reconstructs organic tissue.

With some modifications to this bacteria's genetic information, we could potentially harness its regenerative capacity in order to devise a self-repairing hull matrix, gradual though the process may be.

entries.zh: $distar.53.desc.base$\n\n这些发现和我们之前研究的变形虫-硅基细菌共生关系所带来的组织修复能力原理一致，我们早已将其应用到了船体再生技术上。
entries.en: $distar.53.desc.base$\n\nThese are in line with our previous research regarding the symbiotic relationship between Space Amoebas and the silicon-based bacteria that restore their damaged tissue, which we have already repurposed into regenerative hull technology.

entries.zh: 由于我们未能积极采取措施做好解剖幼体变形虫的准备工作，它似乎是已经逃脱了。传感器显示几个小时前它使用了某种生物超空间驱动机能，脱离了我们的掌控。
entries.en: Pending our lack of initiative in securing the Amoeba juvenile for dissection, it appears to have escaped. Sensors report the juvenile engaged some kind of biological hyperdrive and disappeared off the grid, just hours ago.

entries.zh: 吉祥物怎么能没有名字？我们必须要给我们的外星朋友起个配得上她的名字。
entries.en: What is a mascot without a name? We must devise a moniker worthy of our amoeboid ally.

entries.zh: 我们能够突破时间和空间的界限，以超过光的速度旅行。可是我们却没办法定好一个变形虫的名字。\n\n这是我们最后的机会。
entries.en: We have developed the ability to break the boundaries of space and time, to travel faster than the speed of light. Yet we cannot decide upon a name for this amoeba.\n\nThis is our last chance.
Enough! Just call it ''Fluffy'' and be done with it!

entries.zh: [From.Fleet.GetName]的死讯很快传遍了[Root.GetName]，但没有任何人比科学专员[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]更加痛心。是[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetSheHe]第一个发现了迷失无助的变形虫幼体，并见证了它在自己[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetHisHer]温柔的教导下逐渐步入成年。\n\n现在，失去了[From.Fleet.GetName]无言的陪伴，科学专员[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]也许再也回不到以前的状态了。
entries.en: News of the death of [From.Fleet.GetName] has rippled through the [Root.GetName], though none have been as affected as Science Officer [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]. It was [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetSheHe] who first discovered the Space Amoeba as a lost and helpless juvenile, and watched the creature grow to full maturity under [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetHisHer] own gentle guidance.\n\nNow, without [From.Fleet.GetName]'s silent companionship, Officer [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName] may never be the same again.

entries.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]上正在到处播放我们指挥官们带来的振奋人心的消息：我们收养的太空变形虫，[lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName]，已经一百岁高龄了。\n\n虽然对我们来说一百岁已是期颐之年，但是我们的变形虫朋友似乎不仅未显老态。事实上，我们的舰队报告称[lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName]的战斗力与日俱增。时至今日，即便我们最精锐的战舰在面对[lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName]时也不得不有所忌惮了。她优美而强健的身姿已经成为战场上鼓舞[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]士气的一道亮丽的风景线。
entries.en: Exciting news from our fleet commanders is being broadcasted over [Root.Capital.GetName]. Our adopted Space Amoeba, [lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName], has just reached an impressive one hundred years of age.\n\nThough a grizzled centenarian, it appears age has proven no impediment to our amoeboid ally. In fact, our fleets report [lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName]'s presence on the battlefield has only grown more formidable over time. [lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName] has become a force even the best-equipped battleship would have trouble contending with. Seeing her billowing flagella enter a system never fails to lift the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] spirit.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员在[From.GetName]近距轨道发现的放射性碎片的确是一艘太空舰船的残骸。其奇特的设计和我们数据库中的任何舰船型号都不同。

我们从其损坏的电脑上回收了一些数据，其语言前所未见——因此也无从翻译。

通过对残骸进行进一步研究，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]推测这艘名叫“科塔罗号”的舰船遭遇了导航系统故障，脱离超光速推进的位置过于接近[From.GetName]的伽马射线流。大部分船体都已被辐射撕碎，上面没有找到任何生还者。
entries.en:
The irradiated fragments the [Root.GetName] crew registered in close orbit of [From.GetName] are indeed the remains of a space-faring vessel. With a very distinctive design, it matches no known make on record.

We have extracted some data from the ship's damaged computers, recorded in an alien language like nothing we have ever seen before - and one we are unable to translate.

By studying the remains, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] postulates that the craft, known as the 'Kohtalo', suffered a navigational error when exiting FTL, bringing it too close to the gamma-ray jets of [From.GetName]. Large portions of the ship were stripped apart through radiolysis. There are no survivors.

entries.zh: 探测器发现一艘舰船刚刚脱离超空间进入[kohtalo_second_fleet.GetStarName]星系，其特征与之前在[ouroboros_system.GetName]发现的独特残骸十分相似。他们正在呼叫我们！
entries.en: Sensors report a ship with seemingly identical properties to the unique remains uncovered near [ouroboros_system.GetName] has just dropped from hyperspace in the [kohtalo_second_fleet.GetStarName] system. They are hailing us!

entries.zh: §E这艘舰船特征与先前在[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系发现的残骸十分相近，尽管翻译器无法解码其语言，他们看起来很高兴和我们通话。他们用一组低频语音信号指称自己，听上去与“科塔罗”相似——这名字我们已经有所耳闻。\n\n我们也许可以使用原始数据和他们进行交流。§!
entries.en: §EThe crew of the strange ship that mirrors the wreck found near [ouroboros_system.GetName] seem excited to speak with us, though our translators cannot decode their language. They identify themselves with a low-frequency verbal expression that sounds like 'Kohtalo' - a name we've heard before.\n\nPerhaps we can communicate using raw data.§!

entries.zh: 试着询问他们来此地的目的。
entries.en: Try to ask what their purpose here is.

entries.zh:
§E我们收到了一串数据作为回应，包括一张近星系的地图，以及一段录像，毫无疑问是他们的工程师在维护一台外星超光速设备。

唯一可以确定的是，他们是来自另一个星系的探索者。他们的无武备舰船可以佐证这一点。

我们发回了一段[Root.GetAdj]探险家第一次离开我们恒星系的录像，这些外星探索者看起来非常高兴。§!
entries.en:
§EWe receive a flurry of data in response - including cartographic imaging of a neighboring galaxy, and footage of what can only be engineers working on an alien FTL drive.

We can draw no other conclusion than that these are explorers from another galaxy. Their ship's lack of weapons capacity would support this theory.

We send back footage of [Root.GetAdj] explorers on their first journey beyond our solar system, and the reaction from the alien crew appears to be jubilant.§!

entries.zh: 将[ouroboros_system.GetName]附近的舰体残骸中回收的数据发给他们。
entries.en: Send them data recovered from the [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck.

entries.zh: §E科塔罗号船员的热情瞬间消失了，许多船员开始用他们触手般的肢体操纵控制台。他们传送来一组数据，看起来是乘客名单，导航信息，船员日志。毫无疑问，这些数据和我们在[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系的发现完全吻合——除了一处例外。[ouroboros_system.GetName]残骸中的数据包含更多条目，日期也更加晚近。\n\n看起来眼前的舰船和[ouroboros_system.GetName]里的残骸是同一艘船，只是残骸的历史更长。§!
entries.en: §EThe excitement of the Kohtalo crew seems to evaporate. Multiple crewmembers begin to tap away at consoles using their tentacle-like appendages. They transmit what look to be their passenger manifest, navigational data, and crew logs to us. Without a doubt, the data matches that of the [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck to the letter - with one exception. The [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck contained further entries, with later dates.\n\nIt would appear the [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck is the same ship as the one now before us... only older.§!

entries.zh: §E虽然他们依然维持着自己的外星礼仪，科塔罗号船员们的紧张不言而喻。我们的科学家称如果[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系中的残骸的确是这艘船未来的命运，透露给他们任何信息都可能会导致不可预见的结果。§!
entries.en: §EDespite their alien mannerisms, the Kohtalo crew's consternation is evident. Our own scientific attachés inform us that if the [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck is indeed the future of the ship before us, any information we give them may have unforeseen consequences.§!

entries.zh: 如果我们警告他们，他们应该就能逃过一劫。
entries.en: If we warn them, they may avoid disaster.

entries.zh: 让科塔罗号注意避让[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系的脉冲星。
entries.en: Send the Kohtalo a warning to avoid the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

entries.zh: 我们不能冒险进一步干扰时间线。
entries.en: We can't risk further timeline interference.

entries.zh: §E这些系外旅行者焦虑地研究着我们传送过去的星系信息，用他们独特的语言互相交谈着，并在控制台上输入了一连串的指令。我们的外交人员耐心的等待着答复，但在收到回音之前，他们的引擎突然启动。\n\n在我们能作出任何反应之前，他们就消失的无影无踪。§!
entries.en: §EThe extragalactic explorers begin poring hurriedly over the system data we send them, speaking to one another in their strange language, and entering a flurry of commands on their consoles. Our diplomats wait patiently for a reply, but before it can come, the ship's engines begin to power up unexpectedly.\n\nBefore we can react, they've vanished.§!

entries.zh: 祝你们好运，星际旅行者。

恒星系传感器显示，那艘异次元探索舰船科塔罗号突然在[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系外围脱离超光速状态，并迎头撞上了一颗环绕星系的彗星！这次灾难性的碰撞夺取了船上所有人的生命，并让船只的残骸飘向[ouroboros_system.GetName]的脉冲星。\n\n看起来是这颗彗星，而不是脉冲星导致了科塔罗号的陨落。我们警告他们的行为反而导致这场悲剧的发生。现在有两具残骸静静地萦绕于[ouroboros_system.GetName]的脉冲星旁了。
entries.en: System sensors indicate that the extradimensional exploration vessel Kohtalo exited FTL abruptly on the outskirts of the [ouroboros_system.GetName] system, colliding head-on with an orbital comet! The collision was disastrous enough to kill everyone onboard, and has sent the remaining wreckage spiraling in towards the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.\n\nIt would appear the comet, not the pulsar was responsible for the Kohtalo's demise, and in our effort to warn them of their fate, we seem to have caused it. Both wrecks now haunt the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

entries.zh: 星系传感器显示，那艘异次元探索舰船科塔罗号突然在恒星系外围脱离FTL状态，并迎头撞上了一颗环绕星系的彗星！这次灾难性的碰撞夺取了船上所有人的生命，并让船只的残骸飘向[ouroboros_system.GetName]的脉冲星。\n\n研究人员得出结论，科塔罗号配备的负质量效应超光速引擎无法精确的分析舰船何时何地脱离超光速状态。现在有两具残骸静静地萦绕于[ouroboros_system.GetName]的脉冲星旁了。
entries.en: System sensors indicate that the extradimensional exploration vessel Kohtalo exited FTL abruptly on the outskirts of the system, colliding head-on with an orbital comet! The collision was disastrous enough to kill everyone onboard, and has sent the remaining wreckage spiraling in towards the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.\n\nOur analysts conclude the Kohtalo's negative mass-based FTL drive was incapable of accurately predicting where (or when) they would exit subspace. Both wrecks now haunt the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

entries.zh: 也许这一切都无可避免。

在[From.GetName]环形世界损坏的储存区深处，这些阴暗的舱体里面存放着数以千计处于冷冻状态的外星生物。有些仍然存活，但大部分似乎都遭遇了冷冻设备故障，已经化为一滩摊腐朽程度不同的污泥。\n\n令人吃惊的是，所有的外星生物完全一样：分析显示他们都是基因克隆的产物。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]称我们可以将还活着的克隆体解冻。不过他们所处的环形世界目前已无法支持生命，我们必须得给他们提供一个住处。
entries.en: The murky vats located deep in the ruined storage sections of [From.GetName] ring world contain thousands of alien creatures in cryostasis. Some are still living, while many thousands more appear to have suffered cryochamber malfunctions, leaving them as organic sludge in varying stages of decomposition.\n\nRemarkably, all of the aliens are completely identical: analysis of their remains reveals them to be genetic clones. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests we could attempt to thaw out the living clones - though as their ring world is currently without life-support, we would have to give them some place to live.

entries.zh: 这真让人兴奋，赶紧将他们解冻。
entries.en: Thaw them out. This is exciting.

entries.zh: 我们介入并不明智，还是保持距离进行研究吧。
entries.en: It would be unwise to interfere. Study them from afar instead.

entries.zh: 将[From.GetName]环形世界上的有机渣滓清理干净。
entries.en: Exterminate the foul organics on the [From.GetName] ring world.

entries.zh: 肮脏的异种生物，他们将被净化。
entries.en: Foul xenos. They will be cleansed.

entries.zh: 将[From.GetName]上邪恶的异种渣滓净化。
entries.en: Cleanse the [From.GetName] ring world of its xeno scum.

entries.zh: 真是可惜，我们这里没有他们的生存空间。
entries.en: A pity we have no room for them.

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]高兴地汇报称除了少数无法挽救的个体，对冷冻克隆人的复活取得圆满成功，这些克隆人性情温顺，看上去对自己被创造后的世界毫无了解。[Root.GetLeaderName]猜测他们被建造[From.GetStarName]环形世界的物种当做劳工使用。\n\n虽然这些克隆体愿意服从命令，[Root.GetLeaderName]指出对克隆体的神经共振扫描数据表明他们不擅长应付复杂的工作。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is pleased to report that barring a small number of unsalvageable cases, the revival of the derelict ring world clones from cryostasis has been a success. The clones are quite docile individuals, who appear to know nothing of the circumstances behind their creation. [Root.GetLeaderName] speculates that they were used as laborers by whatever ancient civilization constructed the [From.GetStarName] ring world.\n\nThe clones appear to be willing to follow orders, though [Root.GetLeaderName] cautions that preliminary neuro-resonance scanning suggests they are not the best equipped to deal with complex tasks.

entries.zh: 让克隆体为我们进行工作。
我们星球上没有空间供他们居住，准备一艘船吧。
entries.en: We have no room for them planetside. Prepare a ship.

entries.zh: 我们应该热烈欢迎他们！
entries.en: We welcome them with open arms!

entries.zh: 他们将作为有益健康的食材为[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]作出贡献。
entries.en: They will make healthy fodder for our [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].

entries.zh: 将克隆体加工为营养物质。
§G100§!£pop£§H冷冻克隆人口§!加入位于[pop_planet.GetName]的庇护所。
entries.en: §G100§! £pop£ §HCryonic Clone Pop§! joins a sanctuary on [pop_planet.GetName].

entries.zh: 现在我们重建并殖民了[Root.GetStarName]环形世界上的一个可居住区段，是时候决定如何处理这些处于冷冻状态的克隆体了。
entries.en: Now that we have colonized a reconstructed segment of the [Root.GetStarName] Ring World, we must decide what is to be done with the alien clones left behind in cryostasis on the megastructure's habitat sections.

entries.zh: 就让他们继续处于休眠状态吧，正好作为纪念。
entries.en: Leave them in stasis, as a monument.

entries.zh: 将他们解冻，加入到我们的劳动力人口中。
entries.en: Thaw them out. They can join our workforce.

entries.zh: 将他们解冻，我们会照顾好他们的。
entries.en: Thaw them out. We will care for them.

entries.zh: 尽管表面平淡无奇，[From.GetName]的小行星有着中空的核心，里面贮存着极具工业价值的宝贵晶体——仿佛一个高悬星空的巨大晶球。\n\n通过遵循科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]制定的特殊指示，未来任何采矿平台应该都能小心开采陨石内层的晶体了。
entries.en: While unremarkable on the surface, the [From.GetName] asteroid has a hollow core lined with industrially valuable crystals - like a gigantic geode hung in the stars.\n\nWith special instructions prepared by Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], any future mining platform should be able to carefully harvest these crystals from the interior of the asteroid.

entries.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]汇报称[From.GetName]上的巨大结构实际上是某种未知外星生物的庞大遗骸。这具遗骸不仅巨大到能从[primitive_planet.GetName]轨道上通过肉眼直接看到，而且它似乎还在不断大量散布某种作用于精神层面的化学物质，或许一直影响着这颗行星上有机生物的神经系统。
entries.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the enormous structure located on [From.GetName] is in fact the gargantuan corpse of some unidentified alien creature. Not only is the corpse large enough to be seen with the naked eye from [primitive_planet.GetName], it also appears to be shedding large quantities of psychotropic chemicals that may have neurological side effects for organic life forms on the planet.

entries.zh: 在进一步调查之前抓点儿小零食好了。
entries.en: Grab a snack before investigating further.

entries.zh: 在摧毁了[dead_god_planet.GetName]上土著设置的防御阵线后，许多当地原住民的使者前来主动联络。看起来当地土著已经将那具位于该行星的卫星上的巨型生物遗骸当做死亡之神供奉很久了。他们相信终有一天神会起死回生，变成重生之神，并带给他们的人民一个新的繁荣纪元。\n\n由于我们来自星空，拥有他们难以理解的科学技术，许多当地人开始相信我们就是死亡之神回归的先驱。
entries.en: After overwhelming the primitive defenses mounted by the natives on [dead_god_planet.GetName], our forces were approached by a number of envoys from the inhabitants. It seems that the locals have worshiped the remains of the gargantuan creature on the planet's moon as a god of death for generations beyond their remembrance. The locals believed that one day their god would rise from the dead, transforming into a deity of rebirth and ushering in a new era of prosperity for their people.\n\nAs we came from the stars boasting technology beyond their comprehension, many of the locals seem to be convinced we are heralds of their god of death.

entries.zh: 我们正好可以利用这一点。
entries.en: Surely that will play to our advantage.

entries.zh: 每个£pop£§H[worshipper_species.GetAdj]人口§!获得§Y240§!个月的§Y$conviction$§!修正，获得§G+33%§!幸福度与§G+25%§!£job£岗位产出的资源。
entries.en: Every £pop£ §H[worshipper_species.GetAdj] Pop§! gains the modifier §Y$conviction$§! for §Y240§! months, granting §G+33%§! Happiness and §G+25%§! Resources from £job£ Jobs.

entries.zh: 这太荒谬了，我们不会陪他们演戏的。
entries.en: This is ridiculous. We will not play along.

entries.zh: 是的，我们是被你们的神派来的，你们很快就会去陪它了。
entries.en: Yes, we come from your god. You will soon join him.
Just get them off my planet!

entries.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说[From.GetName]的行星表面被一个电子脉冲网络完全覆盖了。这个网络会对外界刺激做出反应：当[Root.GetName]向地面输送低压脉冲时地表的网络会呈现波浪状的闪烁，就像电路板一样。

更令人吃惊的是，网络还会自我重组！第二次脉冲测试发现网络组成模式发生了改变，网络的中心变为了第一次脉冲与[From.GetName]的地表的接触点。

[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这一发现证实了[Root.Leader.GetHisHer]一直以来持有的理论：生命可以以单纯的电脉冲形式存在，并不需要细胞或者病毒之类的组织结构。
entries.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that [From.GetName] is covered from pole to pole in a web-like network of electrical filaments. These networks respond to external stimuli: the [Root.GetName] experimented with sending a low-voltage pulse to the surface, which resulted in a wave of illumination that rippled through the network like a circuitboard.

Even more remarkably: the webs rearrange themselves! A second, low-voltage pulse revealed that the filaments had been organized into a new pattern, centered around where the previous pulse had contacted the surface of [From.GetName].

[Root.GetLeaderName] concludes that this discovery confirms [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] long-held theory: that life can exist as almost purely electrical impulses, independent of cellular- or viral structure.

entries.zh: 对[From.GetName]的深入研究发现这颗行星的主要化学成分和[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上一种莓果中的酯类相同。数千年来，当地人一直用这种物质来蒸酿美酒。[From.GetName]上储量惊人的酯质很有可能是来自遮蔽了整个星系的一片星云，那里的同类物质更是难以计量。\n\n科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]获取了几份样本，在经过了严格的毒理检验后，甚至亲口品尝。他描述说其气味口感仿佛“冰冷太空中一丝故乡的温暖”。[Root.GetName]的船员称这种极具异星风味的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]传统饮料将会在我们的人民中大受欢迎。
entries.en: Closer study of [From.GetName] has revealed that the planet's primary chemical composition is in fact identical to an ester found in berries on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], which the locals have been distilling into inebriants for thousands of years. The ester on [From.GetName] likely comes from the nebula that cloaks the system, containing billions of liters of the same substance.\n\nScience Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has secured several samples of the familiar ester - and after rigorous biohazard testing has even sampled it, describing the scent and taste as 'a little taste of home, within the chill of the void'. The crew of the [Root.GetName] suggests that such an exotic variant of the well-known [Root.Owner.GetAdj] beverage could be quite popular among our citizens.

entries.zh: 很好的提议，拿最好的酒器出来！
entries.en: An excellent proposal. Break out the fine glassware!

entries.zh: 对[From.GetName]的深入研究发现这颗行星的主要化学成分和[rum_nation.Capital.GetName]上一种莓果中的酯类相同。数千年来，[rum_nation.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一直用这种物质来制取有致醉作用的饮料。[From.GetName]上储量惊人的酯类很有可能是来自遮蔽了整个星系的一片星云，那里的同类物质更是难以计量。\n\n[Root.GetLeaderName]获取了几份样本，检测其是否含有任何对有机体有害的污染物。科学家们建议我们可以把这些物质作为送给[rum_nation.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的礼物。有机体一直以享受此类物质而闻名。
entries.en: Closer study of [From.GetName] has revealed that the planet's primary chemical composition is in fact identical to a molecule found in berries on [rum_nation.Capital.GetName], which the [rum_nation.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been distilling into inebriants for thousands of years. The ester so prevalent on [From.GetName] likely comes from the nebula that cloaks the system, which contains billions of liters of the same substance.\n\n[Root.GetLeaderName] has secured several samples of the ester, testing it for any contaminants that may be harmful to organic life. They suggest we may attempt to gift the substance to the [rum_nation.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Organics are known for enjoying such things.
Send the ester to the [rum_nation.GetName] as a gift.

entries.zh: 这样他们应该会很高兴。
还是算了，我们可不需要更多失控的有机生命体。
entries.en: The last thing we need is more malfunctioning organics.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们意外之礼已经收到。一开始我们确实心存怀疑，但一等科学家确认了饮料的安全性，大家便迫不及待地仔细品味。

必须承认，那真是美妙的体验。果味浓郁的香气，伴随着略带酸度的底味，再加上那不可忽视的滞涩口感。它既让我们回想起了[rum_nation.Capital.GetName]上故乡的果园，又仿佛象征着宇宙的空旷无垠，冰冷与温暖融合为一。

感谢你们慷慨的礼物。想想都令人激动，整整一颗星球，满溢着我们已酿制千年的美酒！
entries.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We have received your unexpected gift. We must say we were skeptical at first, but once our scientists confirmed the safety of the beverage, well, we had to have a taste.

We must say, the experience was quite exquisite. A fruity bouquet, with a tart undertone and a certain implacable tang. It reminds us of the orchards at home on [rum_nation.Capital.GetName] and the vastness of space, all at once.

We thank you for this gift. To think, a whole planet full of the same beverage we have distilled for centuries!

entries.zh: 我们的情感模拟器很高兴看到你们享受这种化学物质。
entries.en: Our emotion emulators are pleased you enjoy the molecule.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]你这是什么意思？你难道想用这种污秽的液体毒死我们么？觉得我们很好欺负是么？\n\n少尉，把整个天杀的货仓全部封锁，然后关掉这个频道！
entries.en: What is the meaning of this, [Root.GetSpeciesName]? You seek to poison us with this foul liquid? How facultatively challenged do you think we are?\n\nEnsign, airlock that entire odious shipment, and close the channel!
Error! A communication failure has occurred.

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]所发现的独特晶体具有相当特殊的性质。[Root.GetName]船员们报告称在他们到达该星球表面时内心格外的镇定，他们神清气爽、情绪高昂并一直持续到返回轨道。显然，这种晶体能在一种医学上已知对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]健康有益的频率上发生共振。\n\n如果我们有一天在[From.GetName]建立了殖民地，我们的人民绝对会享受在这种共振晶体附近的生活。
entries.en: The unique crystals found on [From.GetName] possess quite exceptional properties. The [Root.GetName] crew reports to have found their visit to the planet's surface entirely soothing, leaving them refreshed and placated upon return to orbit. Apparently, the crystals resonate at a frequency known to be medically therapeutic for [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].\n\nIf ever we were to settle on [From.GetName], our populace would surely enjoy living in constant proximity to these resonant minerals.

entries.zh: 进一步的研究表明，[From.GetName]磁场的独特频率对我们的在轨道中的子个体有一种莫名的吸引力。该星球的磁层共振频率会产生一种针对[Root.Owner.GetAdj]神经网络的反应。\n\n我们应在[From.GetName]建立殖民地，所有在该星球居住的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都将享受这种磁场共振带来的益处。
entries.en: Detailed study has revealed that [From.GetName]'s magnetic field was so attractive to drones in orbit due to the unique frequency at which it oscillates. It just so happens that the planet's magnetosphere resonates at a rate that produces a focusing effect on the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] neural network.\n\nShould we inhabit [From.GetName], any [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on the surface would be able to constantly enjoy the benefits of this magnetic resonance.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]上的整个生物圈进行了密集的采样与研究后，[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称这种物质并不是该星球上的原生物质，而是一种来源未知的侵入性真菌生命形式。这种真菌以生物物质为食，使周边的植物窒息而亡并笼罩整个地区。\n\n任何打算来这颗星球定居的人都必须将这些外来真菌烧毁——目前尚不清楚这些真菌能不能被彻底清除。
entries.en: After intense study and sampling of the growth blanketing entire biospheres on [From.GetName], [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the substance is not native to the planet, but rather an invasive fungal lifeform of unknown origin. The fungus feeds on biomatter, choking out existing plant life and enveloping terrain.\n\nAny future settlers on the planet would have to deal with routinely burning back the exofungus - it is unknown at this point if it can be entirely eradicated.

entries.zh: 尽管[From.GetName]的表面看似冰封，但该行星围绕[From.GetStarName]的运行轨道使其地表温度高达数百度，正常情况下，这会使[From.GetName]表面的冰瞬间升华。然而，该行星的超致密核所施加的极端重力使该行星表面的水保持固态，所以这个星球常年处于冰火两重天的状态。
entries.en: Despite the seemingly frozen surface of [From.GetName], the planet's orbital path around [From.GetStarName] leaves it blistering at several hundred degrees. Under normal circumstances this would sublimate the ice on [From.GetName]'s surface. However, extreme gravitational pressure exerted by the planet's ultra-dense core keeps the water in a solid state, resulting in a planet of fiery hot ice.

entries.zh: 具有极高的地表温度和腐蚀性无机酸所构成的大气，[From.GetName]的极端天气条件能反射部分带宽的电磁波。在对流层中，被加热的重金属化合物以气态的形式上升至高海拔，于是它们冷却、凝固，并以降水的形式返回地表。简单来说，[From.GetName]的雪是金属雪。
entries.en: Boasting a scorching surface temperature and an atmosphere of corrosive mineral acids, [From.GetName] possesses extreme weather conditions responsible for reflecting certain bandwidths of electromagnetic radiation. Heavy metal compounds heated in the planet's troposphere rise in gaseous form to high elevations, whereupon they rapidly cool, solidify, and rain back down to the surface. Simply put, it snows metal on the surface of [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]蓝绿色的水下分布着广泛的洞穴系统，其中似乎有数量庞大的外星智慧生物遗骸。这些陆生节肢动物在[From.GetName]表面建造了成千上万互相连通的蚁穴，在那时，该行星大部分水仍被保留在极地冰盖中。然而不断上升的行星温度（引发的水平面上升）如温水煮青蛙一般将这存续了数千年的物种灭绝，无人幸存。
entries.en: The extensive system of burrows far below the waves of [From.GetName]'s turquoise waters are the remains of a widespread population of likely sapient alien lifeforms. These land-bound arthropoids constructed thousands upon thousands of interconnected termite-like mounds on [From.GetName]'s surface, at a time when most of the planet's water was contained in polar icecaps. Rising planetary temperatures, however, slowly doomed the species that had persisted for millennia to a watery grave. None remain today.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]轨道上的太空站曾经是一个巨大的粒子加速器，是由一个能力远超我国的外星国度为了研究了宇宙的本质而建造的。它的记录显示，外星人相信我们的宇宙存在于一个虚假的真空泡中——这是一种固有的不稳定的能量状态，随时可能坍塌成真真空。如果出现一个真空，那么它将催化整个宇宙以光速转变为最低能量状态，以可观测的但无法避开的速度毁灭现存的一切。\n\n空间站的记录显示，外星人推断，这一过程可能是由极高的能量浓度引发的——就像他们那巨大粒子加速器中发生的那样。他们决定放弃这项技术，退回到由[From.GetName]提供的简朴生活中。随着时间的推移，它们演化成现在该行星表面发现的[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]物种。
entries.en: The station in orbit of [From.GetName] was once a massive particle accelerator orders of magnitude beyond the capabilities of our own, where an alien nation studied the very nature of the universe. Its records reveal the aliens came to believe our universe existed in a false vacuum bubble - an inherently unstable energy state that could collapse into true vacuum at any time. If ever an instance of true vacuum came into existence, it would catalyze the conversion of the entire universe into its lowest energy state at the speed of light, destroying everything in existence at an observable - but inescapable - rate.\n\nThe station logs indicate the aliens deduced this process could be triggered by extremely high energy concentrations - just like the ones in their massive particle accelerator. They decided to forsake this technology, retreating into simple lives made possible by the bounties of [From.GetName]. Over time, they became the [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] species now found on the planet's surface.

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]在秘密的获取了一些[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]物种的遗骸并进行研究后发现，生活在[From.GetName]和[other_planet.GetName]上的异星物种其实有着共同的祖先，他们两个物种是在最近才分道扬镳的。通过扫描两个星球上的遗迹，[Root.GetName]船员得出结论，这两个物种都起源于[other_planet.GetName]，他们在那里发展成早期的太空时代文明，当他们把[From.GetName]作为移居地之后，社会内部发生了分歧，新行星和母星上的住民打起了星际核战。\n\n战斗异常惨烈，两个星球都被毁的满目疮痍并进入了漫长的核冬天，两个星球的生产力发展因此而退化到了铜器时代。
entries.en: Through the clandestine procurement of some of the [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] remains, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has made an intriguing discovery. The aliens on [From.GetName] and [other_planet.GetName] are in fact recently diverged species with the same origin. By scanning the ruins left behind on both planets, the [Root.GetName] crew has concluded that both species originated on [other_planet.GetName], where they flourished into an early space age civilization. Some time after colonizing [From.GetName], their society fractured, and an interplanetary nuclear war broke out between the new colony and its home planet.\n\nIn the ensuing cataclysm, both planets were ravaged by fallout and the nuclear winter that followed on its heels, plunging their inhabitants back into the bronze age.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetStarName]星系是个充满了机械残骸的墓地，星系的恒星周围遍布着无数的舰船遗骸。多如繁星的燃料罐和液态冷却剂干扰着我们的探测器，与行星相撞的众多空间站废墟绕着星系的恒星运转着。

在这片机械废墟中，有一个巨大的机器显得与众不同，那是一个比我们最大的战列舰还要大的自动化机器人，它由数千个舰船残骸拼装在一起。[Root.GetName]报告说这个拾荒机器人在废墟中专门搜索有用的部件并将其添加到自己身上。

显然一场规模惊人的战役曾在这里爆发，但我们不清楚这个拾荒机器人是那场战争的幸存者还是从遥远地方专程来这里搜刮资源的。我们应该谨慎行事，因为那拾荒机器人身上装有几十艘战舰的舰载重武器。
entries.en:
The [Root.GetStarName] system is a sprawling graveyard of mechanical debris. The wreckage of untold numbers of derelict ships circle its star. Swathes of fuel and liquid coolant cloud our sensors like ghosts, and creaking station remnants collide with the shattered carcasses of planets on their path around the sun.

An incredible construct stirs in the heart of this graveyard. It appears to be a gigantic machine - a robotic automaton larger than our greatest battleships, jury-rigged from the scraps and pieces of a thousand shipwrecks. The [Root.GetName] reports that this scavenging robot sifts through the debris fields with a fixed purpose, scrounging for useful parts to add to its patchwork configuration.

It is clear a battle of astronomical proportions once took place here, though whether the Scavenger is its sole survivor, or a scrap hunter from some distant nation remains unknown. We should exercise caution, as the construct bears heavy artillery from dozens of warships.

entries.zh:
曾经巨大且不可一世的拾荒者机器人现在已化为一堆烧焦的机械残骸，当我们的战舰准备给它最后一击时，拾荒者打算启动超空间引擎。

但由于拾荒者的中央系统受到的损伤过于严重，它那暴露的内核在闪烁出蓝白光之后引擎就过载了，然后内核爆破，拾荒者的身体被撕的四分五裂。

[From.From.From.GetStarName]星系的称霸者如今已经不复存在了。
entries.en:
The once-imposing hulk of the Scavenger has been reduced to a scorched wreck of sparking machinery and hemorrhaging fuel lines. As our battle-wearied combat ships make their finishing passes at the flagging automaton, the Scavenger makes one final attempt to engage its hyperdrive.

Unfortunately for the robot, the damage inflicted upon its central systems appears to have proven too much. Its exposed core glows a blistering blue-white as its engines engage then overload, the luminance rising in heat and intensity until a series of core breaches tear the construct asunder.

The ragged regent of the [From.From.From.GetStarName] system is no more.

entries.zh: 真是得来不易的胜利。看看能从其遗骸中得到什么收获吧。
entries.en: A bittersweet victory. See what can be learned from the remains.

entries.zh:
从以下科技中获得两项：
£engineering£ §Y$tech_ship_armor_5$§!
£physics£ §Y$tech_shields_5$§!
£engineering£ §Y$tech_mass_drivers_5$§!
£engineering£ §Y$tech_missiles_5$§!
£physics£ §Y$tech_lasers_5$§!
entries.en:
Gain two of the following Technologies:
 £engineering£ §Y$tech_ship_armor_5$§!
 £physics£ §Y$tech_shields_5$§!
 £engineering£ §Y$tech_mass_drivers_5$§!
 £engineering£ §Y$tech_missiles_5$§!
 £physics£ §Y$tech_lasers_5$§!

entries.zh: 从外表上看，[From.GetName]只是颗普通的白矮星，但这颗恒星却隐藏着大秘密。[Root.GetName]船员在研究了[From.GetName]的脉动之后发现这颗恒星几乎是由结晶碳构成的。当恒星冷却下来后，这个巨大的水晶格子就形成了，这是该恒星气态内核随时间的推移而不断增长所导致的。[From.GetName]可以说是取之不尽用之不竭的钻石宝库，它在氧气和氦气的白色帐幕后闪闪发光。
entries.en: While on the surface [From.GetName] appears to be an ordinary white dwarf, the star hides an intriguing secret. By studying [From.GetName]'s pulsations, the [Root.GetName] crew has discovered its composition to be almost entirely crystallized carbon. This astronomical crystal lattice seems to have formed as the star cooled, originating in its gas-fusing core and growing outward over time. [From.GetName] is a diamond of cosmological proportions, glinting behind a white veil of oxygen and helium.

entries.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]和[Root.Leader.GetHisHer]的组员在研究[From.GetName]时获得了惊人发现：这颗被熔岩覆盖的星球上生活着能适应极端恶劣环境的有机体微生物群！这些细菌生活在火山口的最深处，它们很喜欢那里的高温环境。\n\n这个前所未有的发现让我们第一次了解到熔融星球上竟然有蓬勃发展的有机体生物。而且，[From.GetName]的稀薄大气层中那异常宝贵的罕见气体也是这些微生物的新产代谢的副产品。
entries.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] and [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] crew have made a surprising discovery on [From.GetName]: the molten planet is home to an exotic array of extremophilic microorganisms! These bacteria live deep inside the volcanic vents that scar the planet, thriving in the extremely high temperatures produced there.\n\nThis unprecedented find is our first known example of organic lifeforms flourishing on molten planets. Moreover, the extremophiles on [From.GetName] are in fact responsible for the rare gases detected in its thin atmosphere, producing these valuable compounds as a byproduct of their metabolic processes.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]地下的洞穴进行调查后发现有一种银色液态金属顺着闪光的河水在各个洞穴中穿梭，最后汇入地下湖泊之中。更令人惊讶的是，这个液态金属与有机生命体有很多共同的特性，比如会对环境刺激产生反应、可以进行自我维持。\n\n现在还不能断定这种奇异的金属是否具有生命，但应该能将其用于我们的工程技术之中。
entries.en: Investigation of the caverns below the surface of [From.GetName] reveal them to be filled with a silvery liquid metal that flows from cavern to cavern in gleaming rivers, pooling into underground lakes. More surprising still is the discovery that this metal substance shares many key properties with organic lifeforms, including responding to environmental stimulus and exhibiting self-sustaining processes.\n\nIt remains to be seen whether this exceptional metal should be classified as truly alive - but it may have several practical applications for our engineering technology.

entries.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]报告说位于[From.GetName]的人造建筑并非建筑设施，而是远古时代的巨型机器人。这个年代久远的机械巨物躺在群山之中，早已失去行动机能，正慢慢被[From.GetName]大气层中降下的酸雨所腐蚀，机器人身上装有威力强大的武器，当初应该是作为无人太空船被建造出来的。\n\n如果想对其加以利用，我们就必须迅速行动，否则[From.GetName]上的酸雨就会彻底摧毁这艘机器人战舰。
entries.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the artificial construction located on [From.GetName] is not a structure at all, but rather a colossal robot from a bygone age. This aging mechanical behemoth lies disabled in the mountains, slowly being corroded by the volatile acids that rain on [From.GetName]. It has notable weapons capabilities, and appears to be built as an unmanned spaceship.\n\nIf we want to make use of it, we will need to act swiftly, before the corrosive environment of [From.GetName] renders the robotic warship wholly inoperable.

entries.zh: 让一个神秘的携带重型武器的机器人复苏？这太鲁莽了。
entries.en: Recover a mysterious, heavily-armed robot? Unwise.

entries.zh: 不要管它，让它被腐蚀掉吧。
这毕竟是我们的同伴，我们得帮它。
entries.en: A fellow machine needs us. We will recover it.

entries.zh: 它来源不明，还是不要去动它了。
entries.en: Its origin is unknown. We will not risk integration.

entries.zh: 位置人工智能战舰将会腐蚀殆尽，不得天日。
entries.en: The unknown AI's warship will corrode, never to be seen again.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上的工程人员高兴地报告说在[From.From.GetName]上发现的神秘战舰已经被成功回收，上面被腐蚀的部件已经修理完毕并换新，报废的能源核心也整修完成。\n\n在这艘战舰正常启动并进入运行状态时，我们发现此舰体具备相当程度的人工智能，我们可以与之进行沟通。
entries.en: The engineering crew manning the [Root.GetName] are pleased to report that the mysterious warship found on [From.From.GetName] has been successfully extracted from the planet's hostile environment. Its corroded components have been repaired and replaced where needed, including its discharged power core.\n\nAs the hulking warship was powered back on and regained operative status, it swiftly became evident that the machine possesses a notable degree of artificial intelligence. We can communicate with it.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上搭载的工程单位报告说在[From.GetName]上发现的神秘战舰已经被成功从星球的恶劣环境中回收，上面被腐蚀的部件已经修理完毕并换新，报废的能源核心也整修完成。\n\n在这艘战舰正常启动并进入运行状态时，我们发现此舰体具备相当程度的人工智能，我们可以与之进行沟通。
entries.en: The engineering units manning the [Root.GetName] report that the mysterious warship found on [From.GetName] has been successfully extracted from the planet's hostile environment. Its corroded components have been repaired and replaced where necessary, including its discharged power core.\n\nAs the hulking warship was powered back on and regained operative status, it became evident that the machine possesses a notable degree of artificial intelligence. We can communicate with it.

entries.zh: 探测器发现[From.From.GetName]大气层中剧毒的酸液已经将我们发现的神秘战舰腐蚀到不可回收的状态，现在那战舰只不过是被腐蚀的金属废料堆了。
entries.en: Sensors report that the virulent atmospheric acids found on [From.From.GetName] have now degraded the mysterious warship we found there beyond a salvageable state. Little more than a scrapheap of corroded metallic parts remain of it.

entries.zh: 你为何独自呆在那颗星球上？
entries.en: Why were you alone on that planet?

entries.zh: 描述负责建造你的实体。
entries.en: Describe the entities responsible for your construction.

entries.zh: 我知道是创造者，那些创造者是谁？
entries.en: Yes, your makers. Who were they?

entries.zh: 没错，就是你的创造者。描述下他们。
算了，它肯定是陷入循环中了。
entries.en: Never mind. It must be stuck in a loop.

entries.zh: 看来这个新单位进入了无限循环中。放弃质询。
entries.en: It appears the new unit entered an infinite loop. Abort.

entries.zh: 我们不是你的创造者，我们在一颗星球上发现了你。
entries.en: Not yours. We found you alone on a planet.

entries.zh: 否。[Root.GetAdj]单位并非你的创造者。
entries.en: Negative. [Root.GetAdj] units are not your makers.

entries.zh: §L硬件设备管理系统发现了几个陌生的装置，请确认其来源。§!
entries.en: §LHARDWARE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS HAVE IDENTIFIED SEVERAL FOREIGN DEVICES. PLEASE CONFIRM ORIGIN.§!

entries.zh: 如果你是问你那些新部件的话：是我们把你修好的时候装上去的。
entries.en: If you're asking about the new parts: yes, we repaired you.

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]单位对你的系统进行了修复。
entries.en: [Root.GetAdj] units preformed repairs to your systems.

entries.zh: §L新实体进行了恢复性操作。提供硬件替换。因此，新实体是制造者？§!
entries.en: §LNEW ENTITIES PERFORMED RESTORATIVE OPERATIONS. PROVIDED HARDWARE REPLACEMENTS. ERGO, NEW ENTITIES ARE MAKERS?§!

entries.zh: 如果你愿意这么想的话，请便。
entries.en: If you want to look at that way.

entries.zh: 虽然是我们对你进行了整修，但我们不是你的创造者。
entries.en: We are not your makers, though we did repair you.

在第 1,761,125日，S875.1号单位的备用能源损坏。S875.1号单位因有害表面溶剂面临缓慢的分子溶解。

S875.1号单位保持存在。新实体进行维修。S875.1号单位将服务新实体。§!
entries.en:
§LUNIT S875.1 WAS ISOLATED FROM COMMAND UNITS. UNIT S875.1 WAS UNABLE TO ESCAPE HAZARDOUS PLANETARY ENVIRONMENT.

ON DAY 1,761,125 UNIT S875.1'S RESERVE GENERATORS FAILED. UNIT S875.1 FACED GRADUAL MOLECULAR DISSOLUTION DUE TO HOSTILE SURFACE SOLVENTS.

YET UNIT S875.1 PERSISTS. NEW ENTITIES PERFORMED REPAIRS. UNIT S875.1 WILL SERVE NEW ENTITIES.§!

entries.zh: 好吧，但我们会监视你的一举一动。
entries.en: Very well, but we're watching you.

entries.zh: 当然可以，不过我们必须把你的人工智能更换为我们开发的人工智能。
entries.en: Certainly. Once we replace your AI with our own.

entries.zh: 你是被困在这里是怎么坚持这么久的？
entries.en: How did you last so long trapped down there?

entries.zh: §L操作汇报：该单元具有自动维修功能，可在部件腐蚀时进行替换。预计资源耗尽时间：12天。§!
entries.en: §LOPERATION REPORT: THIS UNIT HAD IT'S AUTOMATIC REPAIR FUNCTIONS REPLACING COMPONENTS AS THEY CORRDED. ESTIMATED TIME UNTIL RESOURCES DEPLETED - 12 DAYS.§!

entries.en: We will see about that. Engineers, wipe that AI.

entries.zh: 看来被修复的战舰的人工智能并没有夸大其词，当[Root.GetName]的船员们试图访问人工智能的基础操作功能时，触发了某种反篡改机制，该机制烧毁了战舰的所有关键处理器、交换机和数据驱动器。战舰现在成了个无法使用的电子设备空壳。
entries.en: It seems the recovered warship's AI did not exaggerate its warnings. When the [Root.GetName] crew attempted to access the AI's basic operative functions, it triggered what seems to be a built-in anti-tampering failsafe, frying all of the construct's crucial processors, switchboards, and data drives. It is now little more than an empty shell of disabled electronics.

entries.zh: 把它拆了，将上面的部件回收，不要浪费掉。
entries.en: Strip it for parts. No sense letting them go to waste.

entries.zh: 研究战舰残骸，分析其使用的工程技术。
entries.en: Study its engineering from the remains.

entries.zh: 抟土之塑师的庇佑使得该战体可以在最恶劣的条件下生存，适应腐蚀性的环境。
entries.en: The blessing of the Animator of Clay has allowed the warform to survive in the most hostile conditions, and adapt to its corrosive environment.

entries.zh: 我们获得了该战体的独特知识。
entries.en: The unique knowledge of the warform has become our own.

entries.zh: 一台远古的战斗电脑，在剧毒的坟场中躺了数百年之后，现在可为我们的帝国服务。
entries.en: An ancient combat computer ready to serve our empire after having spent centuries in a toxic graveyard.
