Since the young fungoid's arrival at [nivlac_planet.GetName], it is apparent that its explosive growth has continued. It has established itself as a small people, and recently even developed FTL technology - undoubtedly aided by the technology we left behind.

We shall eagerly continue to watch their development.

entries.zh: 真菌生物$NAME_Nivlac$进入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会的整合行动正在进行中。\n\n$NAME_Nivlacs$与[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的关系目前十分融洽，且我们的物种似乎对与对方物种长久相处十分看好。
entries.en: The integration of the fungoid $NAME_Nivlac$ into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society is underway.\n\nThe interactions between $NAME_Nivlacs$ and [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] continue to be positive, and our species appear to be headed down a promising road together.

entries.zh: 将$NAME_Nivlac$真菌生命体融入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会的进程正在如火如荼地进行中。\n\n虽然$NAME_Nivlac$对这一过程并不十分情愿，但他们的意识终将升华成为[Root.GetAdj]的一部分。
entries.en: The assimilation of the fungoid $NAME_Nivlac$ into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society is underway.\n\nWhile the $NAME_Nivlac$ are resistant toward the process, their consciousnesses will eventually be sublimated into the [Root.GetAdj] whole.

entries.zh: £pop£§H$NAME_Nivlac$人口§!正在[nivlac_joint_planet.GetName]上新建的居所中极尽享受之能事。
entries.en: £pop£ §H$NAME_Nivlac$ Pops§! are being pampered in freshly-built sanctuaries on [nivlac_joint_planet.GetName].

entries.zh:
[From.GetName]上发现的坠毁残骸属于一名被困的科学家——[stranded_scientist_leader.GetName]——其自称属于一个尚不为我们所知的物种，[stranded_scientist_species.GetName]。

不知怎么，她竟从残骸中联系到了驻扎于[Root.GetName]上的科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]，并要求我们进行救援。她解释称自己的坠毁是由于导航传感器失灵，并表示她已有数年未能离开这颗小行星了。

她声称自己具备人所不及的科学知识，是相当有用的资产。她说，自己能在这里活上这么久正是自己能力的明证。
entries.en:
The wreckage on the asteroid [From.GetName] is the remains of a vessel belonging to a now-stranded scientist - [stranded_scientist_leader.GetName] - identifying herself as belonging to the hitherto-unknown [stranded_scientist_species.GetName] species.

From amidst the wreckage she somehow managed to contact [Root.GetLeaderName], the Science Officer stationed aboard the [Root.GetName], and is requesting to be rescued. She explains that her collision was due to malfunctioning navigational sensors, and that she has been unable to leave the asteroid for several years.

She claims her scientific knowledge to be without equal, and that she would be a valuable asset. She points to her survival as proof of that.

entries.zh: 她也许会加入我们的事业。
§Y[stranded_scientist_leader.GetName]§!，一位6级$scientist_with_icon$，加入[Root.Owner.GetName]，并将分享其所掌握的科技知识。
entries.en: §Y[stranded_scientist_leader.GetName]§!, a Level 6 $scientist_with_icon$, joins the [Root.Owner.GetName] and will share her technological knowledge.

entries.zh: 最近新加入的科学家[stranded_scientist_leader_clone.GetName]正在有效利用其科技知识。她向我们分享的知识令我们的物理学研究达到了全新高度。
entries.en: The recent scientist addition [stranded_scientist_leader_clone.GetName] has put her knowledge of technology to good use. Her shared insights have pushed our physics research to new heights.

entries.zh: 我们对£physics£ §Y科技§!的研究取得了更深的进展。

通过进一步观察[molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName]我们发现，其表面的房屋状结构是一种软体动物的家园。这些房屋都处于十分原始的状态，由土壤混合类似分辨的分泌物建造而成。

这种软体动物具有半智能和有限的智力。除生存之外，其社会与生活主要以发掘矿物为主。发掘出的矿物则会进行展示，提升发掘者的社会地位。

然而，他们探测矿物位置的方式目前尚不明确，科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]被他们探知大量矿藏的能力深深震撼。

虽然这些软体动物的科学技术与几乎全部其他方面均比我们落后许多，但却可能对我们的采矿能力造成极大的帮助。
entries.en:
A closer look at [molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName] has shown that its hut-like structures are home to a molluscoid species. The huts are crude shelters, built out of soil and quasi-fecal excretions.

The molluscoids appear semi-sapient with limited intelligence. Besides survival, their society and lives revolve around unearthing minerals which are then put on display, seemingly to raise the social standing of the finder.

Their means of locating these minerals remain unclear, however, and Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is baffled by their ability to locate large deposits of minerals.

Though technologically inferior, studying these molluscoids may well further our mining capabilities.

entries.zh: 有点意思。对他们再进行更深的研究。

[molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName]上居住的软体生物会使用一种奇异的方式来寻找他们想要的矿物。

目前看来，他们可从皮肤排出一种分泌物，渗入土壤并进一步下探。不知为何，这种分泌物具有感应能力，只要连接不断，即可为这种软体动物提供信息。以这种办法，他们就可以对超大规模的地下结构进行测绘，并探明被分泌物触碰到的矿藏。

若能将这些软体动物整合入我们的社会，或单纯使用这种技术来提升我们的生产工序，应该会令我们的矿物生产设施大受裨益。
entries.en:
The molluscoids inhabiting [molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName] employ a strange method to locate their coveted minerals.

Apparently their skin naturally produces gelatinous secretions which seep into the porous soil, trickling ever downward while remaining attached to their skin as long strings. These secretions effectively sample the soil, feeding back sensory information to the molluscoid individual as long as the slimy strands remain unbroken. In this manner, they are able to map out surprisingly large parts of the underground terrain and map out mineral veins.

If we were to integrate the molluscoids into our society, or simply advance our production processes with this knowledge, it is likely our mining enterprises would benefit greatly.

entries.zh: 别管什么矿物了，收获它们的基因。
entries.en: Never mind the minerals, harvest the DNA.

entries.zh: 好。我们就对这些知识加以利用吧。
entries.en: Yes, we will use this knowledge.

entries.zh: 不。对他们的星球进行开采。
软体类物种已成功整合入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会。\n\n为了促进整合进程，我们将他们命名为§Y[molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]§!。[molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]性情温顺，工作勤奋，目前已观察到我们对矿物产量有了显著提升。
entries.en: The integration of the molluscoids into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society is complete.\n\nTo facilitate the integration, they have been given the name §Y[molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]§!. The [molluscoid_miners_species.GetName] are obedient and hardworking, and a marked increase in our mineral production has already been observed.

entries.zh: 因[Root.Capital.GetName]的人口密度很高，[molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]种人民口基数较少，而且不幸的是，对日常生活几乎没有影响。
entries.en: Due to the high population density of [Root.Capital.GetName], the [molluscoid_miners_species.GetName] species is statistically insignificant and unfortunately largely irrelevant to civic life.

entries.zh:
一套能够快速勘测地下地形并探明其包含的矿藏的系统现已投入使用。

通过利用无法穿透矿物质的特定恒星射线与宇宙射线，我们可以收集关于天体内部矿藏数量的数据。这如同为天体直接拍一张X光片，无论是小行星或行星的一部分都可以实现精准探测。

我们对科学家称其为矿物测绘，这一技术应当可以大大提高我们的采矿效率。
entries.en:
A system enabling us to quickly chart underground terrain and the minerals it contains has been implemented.

By analyzing planetary reflection of particular solar and cosmic rays, which are unable to penetrate most minerals, we can gather data on the crust's mineral composition. This makes it possible to essentially x-ray a target body, be it an asteroid or part of a planet.

Our scientists have dubbed it Mineral Mapping, and it should greatly improve our mineral production.

entries.zh:
进一步扫描表明机械仍在运转，而其目的至今仍然毫无头绪。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]表示自己从未见过这样的东西。其中有些材料似乎有些眼熟，但绝大部分都是见所未见的外星产物，其部件与结构也是一样。

机器似乎具备一个控制台，台上有一样十分显眼的物品：一柄由不明材料制成的大而弯曲的拉杆。
entries.en:
Further scans suggest the machine is still operational, though its purpose remains entirely unclear.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has never seen anything like it. Some of its materials look familiar, but most are strange and utterly alien as the design of its components.

The machine has what appears to be a console, with one item in particular standing out: a large crooked lever of unknown material.

entries.zh: 科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]拉下了奇怪的拉杆。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] pulls the strange lever.

entries.zh: 机器已经拆解，并对部件进行了回收。
entries.en: The machine is disassembled and its parts salvaged.

entries.zh:
曲柄被拉动之后发生了什么还不清楚。

那个控制台不停闪烁，并发出巨大的震动。一股巨大的能量波直冲云霄，进入宇宙深处。附近的科学家都感到一股能量之风猛然吹过，但并没有任何感官上的直接证据。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]并不清楚发生了什么。外星机器随后立刻沉寂了下来，再也没有任何能量反应。
entries.en:
It is unclear what happened when the machine's lever was pulled.

Its console flickered, powerful vibrations could be felt, and then a wave of energy surged from the machine, expanding outwards into deep space. The scientists close by felt this wave push past them, but experienced no other sensory evidence of its passing.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is unsure what to make of it. The machine itself returned to its inactive state immediately thereafter, and no longer returns any energy readings.

entries.zh: 真是古怪。快拆开来看看吧。
entries.en: How strange. Now take it apart.

entries.zh: 有点意思。快研究一下这机器。

在我们的科学家拉下拉杆后，机器迸出巨大的能量冲击，在虚空形成中扭曲和涟漪，在§Y[system_one.GetName]§! 中撕出一个虫洞。

在剩余能量的消散后，虫洞及其附近区域稳定下来，现在看起来足够稳定，可以安全通过。至于在另一边等待我们的是什么，我们的科学家们并不那么确定。

机器本身重归沉寂，不再发出任何异常读数。
entries.en:
As our scientists pulled the lever the machine emitted a huge blast of energy that multiplied in shockwaves, twisting and rippling through the void, tearing open a wormhole in §Y[system_one.GetName]§!.

After the residuous energy diffused the wormhole and the immediate area around it settled and now appear to be stable enough for safe passage. As for what awaits us on the other side our scientists are not so sure.

The machine itself has since returned to its inactive state and no longer gives off any anomalous readings.

entries.zh:
对[From.GetName]高空轨道的高速物体进行扫描的尝试失败了。物体很快便从视野中消失，而科研船的各项仪器根本无法跟上它的速度。

虽然[From.GetName]的引力强度很大，但该物体的移动速度依旧令人难以置信。要么是这个物体本身带有什么非凡属性，要么就是引力的奇迹造成了这一奇景。

物体的速度似乎正在逐渐增加，科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为就算没有外界干预，该物体也很可能即将被抛出轨道。
entries.en:
Attempts to scan the object in high-speed orbit of [From.GetName] have been unsuccessful. The object quickly falls below [From.GetName]'s horizon and the [Root.GetName]'s instruments are simply unable to keep up.

While [From.GetName]'s gravitational pull is strong, that alone does little to explain the object's extreme momentum. Either the object itself possesses some extraordinary properties, or there is some gravitational phenomenon at work here.

The object's velocity appears to be increasing over time, and Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suspects that it may soon be thrown out of orbit, even without outside interference.

entries.zh: 派出无人机进行拖拽，以求降低其动量。
entries.en: Dispatch a drone and attempt to latch onto the object to reduce its momentum.

entries.zh: 投掷废物与其相撞，以求打乱其轨道运行。
entries.en: Eject debris to collide with the object, hopefully stopping it in its orbital tracks.

entries.zh: 离开危险区域，让这物体自生自灭。
entries.en: Move out of harm's way and leave the object to its fate.

entries.zh:
无人机已成功停止了未知物体的轨道飞行。

无人机放出拉索拖拽物体，逐渐降低其速度，最终成功将其引导至[Root.GetName]并进行了回收。

该物体类似盒子，由外星材质构成，外部具有如血管般的突脊，一路延伸至顶部的一个球状机构。至于其内含何物目前尚不得而知。
entries.en:
The drone successfully intercepted the unknown object's orbit.

By latching onto the object and then thrusting in reverse little by little, the drone was eventually able to direct it to the [Root.GetName] for retrieval.

The object looks to be some sort of box, constructed of alien material. Vein-like ridges meander along its sides, congregating at the top in some type of sphere-shaped mechanism. We can only guess at its contents.

entries.zh: 投掷的废物成功与未知物体相撞，降低了其飞行速度，并令其掉出了轨道。[Root.GetName]不久后成功将其回收。\n\n该物体类似盒子，由外星材质构成，外部具有如血管般的突脊，一路延伸至顶部的一个球状机构。至于其内含何物目前尚不得而知。
entries.en: The ejected debris successfully collided with the unknown object, reducing its velocity before knocking it out of orbit. The [Root.GetName] was able to retrieve it soon thereafter.\n\nThe object looks to be some sort of box, constructed of alien material. Vein-like ridges meander along its sides, congregating at the top in some type of sphere-shaped mechanism. We can only guess at its contents.

entries.zh: 将这外星盒子射入深空。
entries.en: Shoot the alien box into deep space.

entries.zh:
历经长久努力，我们的科学家终于穿透了外星盒子的外部材料。

盒子内装着三个小型容器，分别盛有不同的液体——一种§R红色§!，一种§B蓝色§!，还有一种§G绿色§!。这些液体比外面的容器更为常见，我方科学家已确定其为基因改造媒介。

出于未知原因，溶液移出外星容器后开始急剧腐坏，但我们尚有足够时间开始人工合成其中的一种，并将其应用于我们的物种。目前已确定其效果一定有益，但具体如何有益尚不明确。
entries.en:
At long last, our scientists have penetrated the outer material of the alien box.

The box holds three small liquid-filled vials - one §Rred§!, one §Bblue§!, and one §Ggreen§!. The liquids are less alien than their container and our scientists have identified them as primed gene-modification mediums.

For reasons beyond our understanding, the solutions are quickly deteriorating outside their alien container, but there should be enough time to synthesize and apply one of them to our species. It has been confirmed that its effects would be positive, but exactly how remains to be seen.

entries.zh:
历经长久努力，我们的科学家终于穿透了外星盒子的外部材料。

盒子内装着的三个小型容器，的确分别盛有不同的液体——一种§R红色§!，一种§B蓝色§!，还有一种§G绿色§!。这些液体比外面的容器更为常见，我方科学家已确定其为基因改造媒介。

出于未知原因，溶液移出外星容器后开始急剧腐坏，但我们尚有足够时间开始人工合成其中的一种，并将其应用于我们的物种。目前已确定其效果一定有益，但具体如何有益尚不明确。
entries.en:
At long last, our scientists have penetrated the outer material of the alien box.

The three small vials inside are indeed filled with different liquids - one §Rred§!, one §Bblue§!, and one §Ggreen§!. The liquids are less alien than their container and our scientists have identified them as primed gene-modification mediums.

For reasons beyond our understanding, the solutions are quickly deteriorating outside their alien container, but there should be enough time to synthesize and apply one of them to our species. It has been confirmed that its effects would be positive, but exactly how remains to be seen.

entries.zh: 使用红色溶液对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]各物种进行改造。
entries.en: Modify the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species with the red solution.

entries.zh: 使用绿色溶液对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]各物种进行改造。
entries.en: Modify the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species with the green solution.

entries.zh: 使用蓝色溶液对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]各物种进行改造。
entries.en: Modify the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species with the blue solution.

entries.zh: 别在这犹犹豫豫的，全部干了！
entries.en: No time for half measures, use them all!

entries.zh: §Y两个选项之一将会发生：§!\n§Y50%§!几率获得所有溶液的增益。\n§Y50%§!几率无事发生。
entries.en: §YOne of 2 options will happen:§!\n§Y50%§! chance of gaining the benefits from all solutions.\n§Y50%§! chance of nothing happening.

entries.zh: 把容器卖给出价最高的人。
entries.en: Sell the vials to the highest bidder.

entries.zh:
我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]终于在不破坏盒子的情况下调查出了盒内的情况。通过使用先进的声呐系统，他们成功确认了盒子的内容物。

里面的物品十分令人困惑，也可以说是出人意料。里面装着三个小型容器，每个里面都装着一种未知的液体。

盒子是可以安全打开的，但想要找出打开的办法还需要更多的研究。
entries.en:
Finally, our [Root.GetScientistPlural] have managed a peek into the alien box without compromising the container itself. By utilizing an advanced type of sonar, they have been able to identify its contents.

The contents are puzzling or, at least, unexpected. The box holds three small vials, each filled with an unknown liquid.

The box is safe to open, but it will require further research to understand how.

entries.zh: 对盒子的研究加速了我们对£physics£ §Y物理学§!知识的了解。
entries.en: \nResearch of the box has accelerated\nour £physics£ §YPhysics§! knowledge.

entries.zh: 把盒子卖给最高出价者。
entries.en: Sell the box to the highest bidder.

entries.zh: 通过中子活化分析，我们可以更好地了解制作盒子的材料和内容。
entries.en: Through neutron activation analysis, we can better understand what materials were used to make the box and the contents.

entries.zh: 我们早已精通合成以及发展独特染色体的能力，结果完全不出意料。我们成功地将§R红色§!、§G绿色§!和§B蓝色§!的溶液一起施加给了[root.GetSpeciesName]物种。\n\n我们的物种现在更加融洽、适应且长寿了。
entries.en: As masters of synthesizing and deploying unique genomes the outcome was never in doubt. We have managed to apply the §Rred§!, §Ggreen§!, and §Bblue§! solutions to the [root.GetSpeciesName] species.\n\nOur species is now more social, adaptable, and longer-lived.

entries.zh: §R红色§!基因改造溶液已成功注入[Root.GetSpeciesName]人民。\n\n根据对早期实验对象的初步观察，这种溶液似乎会让我们变得更加合群。
entries.en: The §Rred§! gene-modification solution has been successfully administered to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people.\n\nBased on preliminary observations of early subjects, the solution appears to make us more social.

entries.zh: §G绿色§!溶液已成功用于对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]民众的改造。\n\n基于对第一批实验对象的观察，这种溶液似乎可以增强我们对环境的适应能力。
entries.en: The §Ggreen§! gene-modification solution has been successfully administered to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people.\n\nBased on preliminary observations of early subjects, the solution appears to improve our ability to adapt to our environment.

entries.zh: §B蓝色§!溶液已成功用于对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]民众的改造。\n\n基于对第一批实验对象的观察，这种溶液似乎可以延长我们的寿命。
entries.en: The §Bblue§! gene-modification solution has been successfully administered to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people.\n\nBased on preliminary observations of early subjects, the solution appears to increase our potential lifespan.

entries.zh: 尽管初期结果乐观，基因改造最终不幸失败，因为这种溶液与更加普遍的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]基因组不相容。
entries.en: The attempted gene modification was unfortunately a failure despite promising initial results, as the solutions proved incompatible with the wider [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] genome.

entries.zh:
根据目前观察，在[breathing_rift_object.GetName]发现的异常现象似乎是极为罕见的空间裂隙。很有可能是[breathing_rift_object.GetName]的巨大质量帮助其生成，但我们目前尚无法理解其性质。

裂隙不仅会折射和阻挡光线，而且似乎还会吸引光线后再将其吐出，如此往复——有如呼吸一般。

目前看来，裂隙巨大的引力很可能也拉入过其他东西。我们最好小心行事。
entries.en:
The anomaly found close by [breathing_rift_object.GetName], however unlikely, appears to be some type of rift in space. It's possible the great mass of [breathing_rift_object.GetName] somehow caused it, but its nature is beyond our understanding.

The rift not only refracts and blocks light, but seems to actually draw it in and then push it out, repeatedly - as if it were breathing photons.

It is likely the immense gravitational pull of the rift has at some point inhaled in other things, as well. We should exercise caution.

entries.zh: 有进一步发现之前，一定要紧密观察。
entries.en: Keep a close watch until we know more.

entries.zh: 派出观察探测器，进行严密监视。
entries.en: Dispatch an observation probe to monitor the rift.

entries.zh: 我们可以从安全距离进行观察研究。
entries.en: It can be studied from a safe distance.
The [Root.GetName] is at risk. Leave now.

entries.zh:
自从发现[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近的裂隙，已经过去了几个月之久，但没有发生任何意外。但现在，我们收到了有关大量富含矿物的岩石从其中倾泻而出的报告。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
entries.en:
Many months have passed since the discovery of the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] without anything out of the ordinary happening. But now, we have received reports of a large gathering of mineral-laden rocks pouring out of it.

They are ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

entries.zh:
[breathing_rift_object.GetName]又一次放出了数量十分可观的物品。这次的物品是小行星的遗留碎片，其中大部分仍然富含矿物。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
entries.en:
Once again, the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] has released a sizeable gathering of items. This time it's remnants of an asteroid, many of them laden with minerals.

They are ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

entries.zh:
自从发现[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近的裂隙，已经过去了几个月之久，但没有发生任何意外。但现在，我们收到了有关大量碎料从其中倾泻而出的报告。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
entries.en: Many uneventful months have passed since the discovery of the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName]. But now, we have received reports of a great stream of debris pouring out of it. It is ours for the taking.\n\nObservation of the rift will continue.

entries.zh:
[breathing_rift_object.GetName]又一次放出了数量十分可观的物品。这次的物品漂流进入该星系的碎料，也许是某次古代战斗留下的遗迹吧。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
entries.en: Again, the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] spews out something new. This time it is mostly metal debris, perhaps from some ancient battle. It is ours for the taking.\n\nObservation of the rift will continue.

entries.zh: 从观察裂隙的勘测器传来的最新数据表明，裂隙已经消失了。吸入最后一口气之后，裂隙自动关闭，且未留下任何其曾经存在过的能源痕迹。
entries.en: The latest data report from the rift's observation probe tells us that the rift has vanished. After drawing its last breath, the rift closed and left behind not even a trace of its energies.

entries.zh: 然而，收集到的数据推进了我们对£physics£ §Y物理§!知识的研究进度。
entries.en: However, the data collected over time has furthered our £physics£ §YPhysics§! studies.

entries.zh: 无人机被摧毁之后，我们即可对小行星内部进行进一步的调查了。
entries.en: Once the drones have been destroyed, the asteroid they lurked in can be investigated more thoroughly.

entries.zh: [impossible_organism_science_ship.GetName]成功从[impossible_organism_planet.GetName]剧毒表面发现的异常顽强的有机体上取回了一份样本。\n\n我们的生物学家想对其进行更为详尽的研究。
entries.en: The [impossible_organism_science_ship.GetName] has successfully retrieved a specimen of the incredibly robust organism found on [impossible_organism_planet.GetName]'s toxic surface.\n\nOur biologists would like to study it in greater detail.

entries.zh: [impossible_organism_planet.GetName]上发现的生命体，展现出了极为出众的在凶险环境中生长的能力。\n\n看来若想揭开其基因、细胞与生化系统中隐藏的谜题，是不得不进行进一步研究了。
entries.en: The lifeform found on [impossible_organism_planet.GetName] has been shown to possess an extraordinary capacity for growth in hostile environments.\n\nFurther study is warranted, if our biologists are to unravel the mysteries of its genetic, cellular and biochemical processes.

entries.zh: 对此软体类物种进行研究，试着搞明白他们是怎样如此轻松地发现矿脉的。
entries.en: Research the molluscoid species and attempt to discover their means of locating mineral deposits with such ease.

entries.zh: 立刻着手将这些软体类矿工整合入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会。
entries.en: Commence the integration of the molluscoid miners into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society.

entries.zh: 开始研究并应用可以高速勘探地下地形并制图的系统，以求提升矿物生产效率。
entries.en: Begin research and implementation of a system able to swiftly chart underground terrain, with the end goal of improving mineral production.

entries.zh: 开始着手撬开在[speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName]轨道发现的外星盒子。
entries.en: Begin the efforts to open the alien box found in orbit of [speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName].

entries.zh: 研究在[speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName]轨道发现的外星盒子，以查明其内容物。
entries.en: Research the alien box found in orbit of [speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName] to ascertain its contents.

entries.zh: 观察[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近发现的空间裂隙，等着看里面会冒出什么东西。
entries.en: Observe the rift in space discovered near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] and await whatever comes out of it, if anything.

entries.zh: 研究或许可以加速将来的消灭行动。
entries.en: A study may expedite future extermination.

entries.zh: 每消灭一支太空变形虫舰队可获得§G+1000§!£energy£
entries.en: §G+1000§! £energy£ for every Space Amoeba fleet destroyed

entries.zh: 处于太空变形虫群附近时，停止舰只反应核心的某些特定辐射的排放似乎可以避免将其激怒。\n\n由于这一举措，他们已不再将我们视为威胁，我们也因此得以近距离对其进行观察。
entries.en: Temporarily refraining from venting certain emissions from our vessels' reactor cores while in the immediate vicinity of Space Amoebas flocks seems to be enough to not arouse their ire.\n\nWith this new protocol in place they no longer pose a threat, and we have been able to study them at close range.

entries.zh: 添加§Y$pacified_amoebas$§!修正。有如下效果：\n§H太空变形虫§!现在处于§G非敌对§!状态
entries.en: §Y$pacified_amoebas$§! modifier added, giving the following effects:\n§HSpace Amoeba§! fleets are rendered §Gnon-hostile§!

entries.zh: §H太空变形虫§!现在处于§G非敌对§!状态
每消灭一支晶态实体舰队可获得§G+500§!£minerals£
entries.en: §G+500§! £minerals£ for every Crystalline Entity fleet destroyed

entries.zh: 晶态实体似乎会对特定的频率共振，这也是他们与环境之间少有的互动。发出电波的特性与目的目前尚未明确，但目前我们的舰船可以使用无线电进行模仿，并将自己伪装成晶态实体。
entries.en: The Crystalline Entities seem to resonate in response to something; one of their few interactions with their environment. The exact nature and possible wider purpose of this emitted waveform has yet to be ascertained, but for now our ships can approximate it using radio pings, essentially camouflaging themselves as fellow Crystals.

entries.zh: 添加§Y$pacified_crystals$§!修正。有如下效果：\n§H晶态实体§!现在处于§G非敌对§!状态
entries.en: §Y$pacified_crystals$§! modifier added, giving the following effects:\n§HCrystalline Entity§! fleets are rendered §Gnon-hostile§!

entries.zh: 我们成功摧毁了[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]的晶态结构。过程比我们想象中更加艰难，并在期间回收了一些碎片供研究之用。这样一来，我们应该就能模仿战斗中遭遇的晶体矩阵展现出的再生特性了。
entries.en: We have destroyed the crystalline construct in the [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName] system. It proved hardier than expected, and some shards have been recovered for study. We should be able to emulate the reconstructive properties of the crystal matrix observed during the battle.

entries.zh: 真是神妙的自动装置啊。
我们摧毁了采矿无人机基地，并成功取回了其中储存的大部分经过加工的矿产和珍贵的合金。
entries.en: We have destroyed the Mining Drone base, and managed to recover most of its stores of processed minerals and precious alloys.

entries.zh: 在某些星系中观察到的晶态实体处于不稳定状态，也许会造成危险。
entries.en: The Crystalline Entities observed in some systems are volatile and potentially dangerous.

entries.zh: 不知为何，我们的舰队似乎会激怒太空变形虫。要是能够确定其原因，也许就能降低变形虫的侵略性，甚至将我们的舰队从其感官中完全屏蔽。
entries.en: Something about our fleets seems to agitate the Space Amoebas. If we could somehow isolate what this something is, we could reduce Amoeba aggression or possibly completely mask our ships from their senses.

entries.zh: 战斗之后我们自动回收了晶态实体的残骸，每击败一支舰队可获得£minerals£ §G500§!。
entries.en: The shattered remains of Crystalline Entities are automatically salvaged after battle, bringing in £minerals£ §G500§! for every fleet destroyed.

entries.zh: 根据晶态实体内部独特结构开发的高级传送介质可以将能源生产与分配过程中的阻抗损耗降至最低。
entries.en: Improved transmission mediums modeled after the Crystalline Entities' unique internal structures minimize resistive losses in energy production and distribution.

entries.zh: 通过使用特定频率的短波广播，我们可将舰队伪装成为晶态实体，因此这种宇宙生物将不再把我们视为威胁。
entries.en: Short-wave broadcasts at certain frequencies effectively disguise our fleets as fellow Crystalline Entities, and the spaceborne creatures no longer recognize us as a threat.

entries.zh: 战斗之后我们收集了变形虫的残骸，并从其内部器官中收获了价值可观的有机合成物，每击败一支舰队可获得£energy£ §G1000§!。
entries.en: Amoeba carcasses are rounded up after battle and their internal organs harvested for valuable organic compounds, bringing in £energy£ §G1000§! for every fleet destroyed.

entries.zh: 舰队在接近太空变形虫时会严格控制自己的辐射放射量，因此这种变形虫将不再将我们视为威胁。
entries.en: Fleets regulate radiation venting when approaching Space Amoebas, and the spaceborne creatures no longer recognize us as a threat.

entries.zh: 这些采矿无人机明显是量产品。只要找到一个的弱点，就相当于破解了全部。
entries.en: The Mining Drones are obviously mass-produced. A weakness found in one is a weakness found in all.

entries.zh: 通过使用从采矿无人机中取得的技术，我们终于能够有效采集之前认为不值得利用的矿脉了。
entries.en: Using techniques derived from the Mining Drones allows us to efficiently exploit mineral veins previously not deemed worth the trouble.

entries.zh: 从采矿无人机中衍生的技术提高了我们在游牧途中采收资源的效率。
entries.en: Techniques derived from the Mining Drones help us harvest resources more efficiently during our travels.

entries.zh: 虚空之云的电荷会以可见的高速循环进行波动。若能以精确定时进行高速轰击，即可使其结构产生极大的不稳定能源，令其中个体活性化。
entries.en: The Void Clouds' charge fluctuates in a rapid but observable cycle. Striking with precise timing dramatically destabilizes the inscrutable energies that animate the entities.

entries.zh: 虚空之云的异常属性为物理学研究打开了新的大门。
entries.en: The anomalous nature of the Void Clouds open up new possibilities in physics research.

entries.zh: 敲碎傲古水晶出现的碎屑会快速膨胀并以爆炸性的速度硬化，使其成为制造爆破性弹药中破碎部的理想材料。
entries.en: Chipping an Aldar crystal causes the resulting splinter to expand and harden with explosive speed, making it an ideal material for fragmentation matrices in explosive munitions.

entries.zh: 不稳定的傲古水晶仅少量存在于较为常见的矿石之中。若想在不对器械与人员造成巨大伤害的情况下将这些晶体成功提取出来，需要十分先进的自触觉机械。
entries.en: Volatile Aldar is only found laced in more common ores. Successfully extracting Aldar crystals from these mineral matrices - without sustaining significant damage to equipment and operators - requires advanced auto-tactile machinery.

entries.zh: 泽珞尘埃放射出一股强大的灵能存在。
entries.en: Zro dust radiates a powerful psionic presence.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!在§Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§!恒星系发现一种战略资源矿藏。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! discovered a strategic resource deposit in the §Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§! system.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]发现了一种新的§H战略资源§!，现已命名为
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered traces of a new §HStrategic Resource§!, dubbed

entries.zh: ，这一发现是在调查[From.GetName]时获得的。
\n\n在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
entries.en: \n\nWe are sure to find more of these types of resources as we continue to explore the galaxy, each with unique properties and applications.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行调查时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H珈蓝矿石§!。它似乎是种极佳的造船材料。
entries.en: During its survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HGaranthium Ore§!. It appears to be an excellent material for use in the construction of ships.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行勘探时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H莱素气体§!。将这种气体浓缩后与燃料混合使用，应该可以显著增强舰船引擎的推进力。
entries.en: During its survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HLythuric Gas§!. Small concentrations of this gas mixed with fuel should significantly increase the thrust of our starship engines.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行勘探时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H特尔达水晶§!。这是一种极度坚固的水晶，理论上可以增强我们抛射武器的穿甲性能与威力。
entries.en: During its survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HTeldar Crystals§!. These extremely durable crystals should theoretically enhance the armor-piercing capabilities and destructive potential of our projectile weapons.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行勘探时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H育兰晶§!。这些晶体拥有罕见的反射特性，初步扫描表明其可以大幅强化能量武器的输出。
entries.en: During its survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HYurantic Crystals§!. These crystals have rare reflective properties that preliminary scans indicate would greatly enhance the power output of energy weapons.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行勘探时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H傲古水晶§!。这些水晶在被击碎时，碎片会飞速扩张并硬化，非常适合作为爆炸性武器中的破片矩阵。
entries.en: During its survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HAldar Crystals§!. Chipping these crystals causes the resulting splinter to expand and harden with explosive speed, making it an ideal material for fragmentation matrices in explosive munitions.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行调查时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种我们以前从未见过的战略资源，并命名为为§H奥利姆矿石§!。这是一种非常不稳定的元素，可用于高频护盾的调整，有效提高其随机性，从而提高潜在防御能力。
entries.en: During its survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HOrillium Ore§!. This ore is a very unstable element that can be used to efficiently randomize high-frequency shield modulations, improving potential defensive capabilities.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行勘探时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H皮萨兰星尘§!。这种富含能源的细尘是极佳的肥料。它可以极大地提高我们的食物产量。
entries.en: During its survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HPitharan Dust§!. This fine, energy-dense dust serves as an excellent fertilizer. Its use should greatly enhance our food production.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行勘探时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H恩吉欧气体§!。这种气体是天然的兴奋剂，可以使各种形态的生命发挥出最大潜能。
entries.en: During its survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HEngos Vapor§!. This vapor is a naturally occurring stimulant that helps all forms of life perform at maximum capacity.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行勘探时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H零素矿§!。这是一种由中子构成的超高密度物质，可以打造成极度坚韧的船壳。
entries.en: During its survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HNeutronium§!. It is a super-dense substance composed of neutrons that can be forged into extremely resistant hulls.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在§Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§!恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为§H$sr_zro$§!。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §H$sr_zro$§! in the §Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§! system.

entries.zh: $action.92.zro.common$这是一种来源不明的气溶胶，[Root.Owner.GetIngestedLoc]后可以让拥有天赋的[Root.Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]提升灵能力。$action.92.part3$
entries.en: $action.92.zro.common$ It is a rare aerosol of unknown origin, and when [Root.Owner.GetIngestedLoc], it enhances the abilities of psionically-gifted [Root.Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural].$action.92.part3$

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在§Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§!恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为§H暗物质§!。它似乎打破了一些物理法则，具有引发科学革命的潜力。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HDark Matter§! in the §Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§! system. It seemingly defying several natural laws, and could potentially revolutionize the sciences.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行勘探时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H萨特拉烯§!。这种气体是天然的刺激剂。它对于大多数生物都有镇定作用，通常会在人群中诱发团结意识。可能会产生依赖性。
entries.en: During its survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HSatramene Gas§!. This gas is a naturally occurring stimulant that has a calming effect on most beings, typically prompting consensus-seeking behaviors in groups. It is potentially addictive.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在§Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§!恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为§H活体金属§!。其具有通常只能在有机生物形式上才能见到的特性，会自动恢复成被稳定塑造好的形态。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HLiving Metal§! in the §Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§! system. It has characteristics usually seen only in biological life forms, and will always attempt to regenerate back into the shape it was stabilized into.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行勘探时，[Root.GetName]发现了大量各种稀有的§H环境改造液体§!。拥有这种液体，可以在对星球进行环境改造时起很大的帮助作用。
entries.en: During its survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] discovered large deposits of various rare §HTerraforming Fluids§!. Access to these fluids would greatly assist the process of terraforming planets.

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行勘探时，[Root.GetName]发现了大量各种稀有的§H环境改造气体§!。拥有这种气体的稳定供应，将会降低对星球进行环境改造的花费。
entries.en: During its survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] discovered large deposits of various rare §HTerraforming Gases§!. With a steady supply of these gases, the process of terraforming planets would become less costly.

entries.zh: \n我们拥有相应的科技——要是能够控制该恒星系，就能攫取这份资源。$action.92.generic$
entries.en: \nWe have the technology - if we control this system, we can extract this resource.$action.92.generic$

entries.zh: \n虽说我们尚不能提取这种资源，但应该考虑在该星系建立控制，以便日后开发。$action.92.generic$
entries.en: \nWe cannot extract this resource yet, but we could establish control over the system for future exploitation.$action.92.generic$

entries.zh: $action.92.zro.common$\n\n这种稀有的气溶胶表现出一种异常的神经侵入效应特性，因此被指定为一类A级管制品。它在开发精神隔离技术方面可能具有价值。$action.92.generic$
entries.en: $action.92.zro.common$\n\nThe properties of this rare aerosol have been noted to exhibit anomalous neuroinvasive effects, and has therefore been designated as a class alpha controlled substance. It may yet prove valuable in developing mentally insulative technologies.$action.92.generic$

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在§H[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§!星系中发现了战略资源：§H“$sr_zro$”§!的储备。\n\n这种稀有气溶胶具有多种用途。分析表明，经过处理的样本甚至能影响具有“灵能”特性的[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]个体——例如虚境造物——的机能。凭借我们的$tech_mine_zro$技术，只要控制[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系就能实现该资源的开采。$action.92.generic$
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered deposits of the strategic resource ID: §H'$sr_zro$'§! in the §H[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§! system.\n\nThis rare aerosol has many applications. Analysis has shown that processed samples can even affect the functioning of [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] units with 'psionic' properties, such as the Shroud-Forged. With our $tech_mine_zro$ technology, we will be capable of extracting this resource if we control the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.$action.92.generic$

entries.zh: 一系列抽象亚空间路径的端点，从普通空间无法进入。
entries.en: An endpoint of an obscure tangle of subspace routes, otherwise inaccessible from normal space.

entries.zh: 一条本该通往独立的亚空间网络的通道，现在已经落入无限的维护循环。
entries.en: A Gateway to a supposed separate subspace network, stuck in a perpetual maintenance cycle.

entries.zh: 我们已经获悉在星系边缘的某个地方有一个神秘的星团。我们只能通过§HL-星门§!到达该星团，这是一种在特定恒星系中发现的人造亚空间入口。\n\n这些星门已经被人蓄意地关闭了，并且现在我们对解除禁制所需要的亚空间原理缺乏足够的理解。
entries.en: We have learned of a mysterious star cluster somewhere just beyond the periphery of our galaxy. It can only be accessed through §HL-Gates§!, artificial subspace portals found in certain systems.\n\nThese Gateways have been deliberately disabled by someone, and for now we lack the necessary insight into the subspace mechanics that govern their use to lift the lockdown.

entries.zh: 各种元素被分解为粒子状态后的物质。遍布整个星球后，灰色尘埃可以用纳米机械启动，迅速改变星球环境。
entries.en: A slurry of elements reduced to particulate matter. Once distributed across a world, Gray Dust can be activated by nanomachines to rapidly alter planetary conditions.

entries.zh: 由纳米机器人某些特定行为生成的晶态副产品，可以与其他纳米级别材料产生奇妙的交互作用，预示着在普朗克尺度之后还隐藏着更深的秘密与真相。
entries.en: The crystalline by-product of certain nanobot activity exhibits curious interactions with other nanoscopic material, hinting at truths hidden beyond the planck scale.

entries.zh: 专门为恢复陷入荒芜的生物圈而研制的人工浓缩化肥。
entries.en: Concentrated artificial fertilizer designed to revive devastated biospheres.

entries.zh: 简单却性能强劲的纳米传动器，可用于复杂操作与纳米级别的超微型实验。
entries.en: Simple but powerful nanoactuators, allowing for complex manipulations and experiments at mesoscopic scales.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$无法在双星星系或三星星系中建造。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Cannot build this in Binary or Trinary systems.

entries.zh: 我方特工报告称，§H[lgate_warning_country.GetName]§!手中掌握的情报与信息，距离打开他们控制下的L-星门已经只有一步之遥。这样一来，他们就会取得L-星团的所有秘密与使用权限！\n\n如果想抢先一步，我们就必须着力研究L-星门，尽快掌握它的内幕！
entries.en: Our spies report that the §H[lgate_warning_country.GetName]§! is close to possessing enough information about the L-Gates to unlock the one they control. This would give them access to the L-Cluster and its secrets!\n\nIf we are to get there first, we must double our efforts and find more insights into the L-Gates!

entries.zh: 那么就看看我们谁比较快吧。
entries.en: We shall see who gets there first.

entries.zh:
我们的技术人员设法解除了[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]附近的L-星门的锁定，但刚刚与L-星团建立了永久连接，我们就侦测到一波巨大的亚空间波动！我们设法限制这一潜在的侵略者使用我们的星门，同时确保我们自己仍可使用。

不幸的是，这一波动被导向了星系中的其它L-星门。由纳米机器组成的奇怪舰船正从这些完全启动的星门中涌出，攻击目所能及的一切！

与这些机器进行沟通的尝试全都失败了。在它们通过L-星门后，我们侦测到来自L-星团的一个不断重复的亚空间信号传输。
entries.en:
Our technicians managed to lift the lockdown from the L-Gate near [candidate_gateway_system.GetName], but as soon as a permanent link was established to the L-Cluster, a massive incoming subspace surge was detected! We were able to restrict this potential invasion force from using our gate, while still retaining access for ourselves.

Unfortunately, the incoming surge was diverted to the other L-Gates in the galaxy. Strange vessels consisting of nanites are pouring through these now fully active gates, attacking everything in sight!

All attempts to communicate with these machines have failed. In the wake of their passage through the L-Gates, we have detected a repeating subspace transmission emanating from the L-Cluster.

entries.zh:
我们的技术人员设法解除了[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]附近的L-星门的锁定，但刚刚建立至L-星团的永久连接，就侦测到一波巨大的亚空间波动！

由纳米机器组成的奇怪舰船正从这些完全启动的星门中涌出，攻击目所能及的一切！

与这些机器进行沟通的尝试全都失败了。在它们通过L-星门后，我们侦测到来自L-星团的一个不断重复的亚空间信号传输。
entries.en:
Our technicians managed to lift the lockdown from the L-Gate near [candidate_gateway_system.GetName], but as soon as a permanent link was established to the L-Cluster, a massive incoming subspace surge was detected!

Strange vessels consisting of nanites are pouring through the now fully active gate, attacking everything in sight!

All attempts to communicate with these machines have failed. In the wake of their passage through the L-Gate, we have detected a repeating subspace transmission emanating from the L-Cluster.

entries.zh:
来自§H[From.GetName]§!的科学家们设法使其领土内的L-星门恢复了运转，抢先了我们一步。不幸的是，这似乎触发了星团住民对我们星系的进攻——攻击一切的敌对纳米机器！

[From.GetSpeciesName]的科学家们在攻击抵达之前设法关闭了他们的星门，但这只是将其导向了星系中的其它L-星门，这些星门现在已经完全开启！

与这些进攻的纳米机器进行沟通的尝试全都失败了。在它们通过L-星门后，我们侦测到来自L-星团的一个不断重复的亚空间信号传输。
entries.en:
Scientists from the §H[From.GetName]§! managed to restore functionality to the L-Gate within their territory, beating us to it. Unfortunately, this seems to have triggered an invasion of our galaxy by the cluster's inhabitants - aggressive nanomachines that attack everything in sight!

The [From.GetSpeciesName] scientists managed to shut down their gate before the invasion force arrived, but this only diverted them to the other L-Gates of the galaxy, that are now fully active!

All attempts to communicate with these invading nanites have failed. In the wake of their passage through the L-Gates, we have detected a repeating wide-band subspace transmission emanating from the L-Cluster.

entries.zh:
§Y正在解码亚空间自动播送信息……
正在建立翻译矩阵……§!

§R警告：§!§Y信息严重损坏。

正在尝试恢复信息碎片……§!
§Y已部分恢复三条信息碎片。§!
entries.en:
§YDecoding repeating automated subspace transmission...
Establishing translation matrix...§!

§RALERT:§! §YMessage is heavily corrupted.

Attempting reconstitution of message fragments...§!
§YThree message fragments partially recovered.§!

entries.zh:
§Y解码碎片I：§!

“我们是§Y<无法解读>§!，星系传送门网络的建筑师。如果你收到这条消息，那我们只能§Y<无法解读>§!不算太晚。或许我们的一个信息浮标设法溜过了§Y<无法解读>§!并在其关闭之前逃离了星团。

§R切勿§!——重复一遍——§R切勿§!重新开启前往我们星团的传送门。无论何种情况之下，都不可重新建立§Y<无法解读>§!与整个星系之间的稳定连接。为了所有文明的安危，我们的星团必须被永久隔离。”
entries.en:
§YDecoding fragment I:§!

"We are the §Y<unintelligible>§!, architects of the galactic Gateway network. If you are receiving this transmission, then we can only §Y<unintelligible>§! that we are not too late. Perhaps one of our message buoys somehow slipped past the §Y<unintelligible>§! and escaped the cluster before it was closed off.

§RDO NOT§! - repeat - §RDO NOT§! restore access to the dormant Gateway in our star cluster. Under no circumstances must a stable connection be formed between the §Y<unintelligible>§! and the galaxy at large. For the sake of all civilization, our cluster has to remain under permanent quarantine."

entries.zh:
§Y解码碎片II：§!

“我们故意将我们的母星团与外界进行了彻底隔离，以防纳-迪-沙——§H灰色风暴§!进一步扩散，但这一举动也注定将彻底毁灭我们的文明。这些能够自我复制的纳米机械在建造通道网络时是不可或缺的工具，但当它们的§Y<无法解读>§!完成之后，我们却发现它们不再接受我们的指令了。

通过隐藏的后门程序，我们的§Y<无法解读>§!成功将所有纳米机械召回了我们的母星团，但之后这一漏洞便被纳米机械自我修复了。当它们开始在我们的星球收集资源时，我们就明白——这一切只是时间问题了……”
entries.en:
§YDecoding fragment II:§!

"In an act that will inevitably doom our civilization, we have deliberately isolated our home cluster to prevent the spread of the Naar-Di-Shav - §Hthe Gray Tempest§!. These self-replicating nanomachines were instrumental in the construction of our Gateway network, but when their §Y<unintelligible>§! had concluded, we found that they would no longer accept our commands.

Through a hidden backdoor, our §Y<unintelligible>§! managed to recall the machines to our home cluster, but this security hole has since been plugged. When they started harvesting our planets for materials, we knew it was only a matter of time before..."

entries.zh:
§Y解码碎片III：§!

“主§Y<无法解读>§!设施是一切的关键。它们的所有§Y<无法解读>§!都是通过该设施的亚空间阵列进行传输，没有了这座设施它们就无法行动。不幸的是，我们想要将其关闭的一切尝试都以失败告终，而我们也已无力聚集力量再一次§Y<无法解读>§!攻击了。

如果我们星团的封锁失效，那你务必要摧毁这座设施。只要这座设施§Y<无法解读>§!，灰色风暴就会继续在星系中横行霸道。

我们……是我们释放了这恐怖的风潮，实在羞愤难当。正是因为我们的傲慢，才……”
entries.en:
§YDecoding fragment III:§!

"The main §Y<unintelligible>§! facility is the key. All of their §Y<unintelligible>§! are routed through its subspace array, and without it they cannot function. Unfortunately, all of our attempts to disable it have failed and we can no longer muster the forces to §Y<unintelligible>§! another assault.

If the quarantine of our cluster has failed, you MUST destroy this facility. As long as it remains §Y<unintelligible>§!, the Gray Tempest will continue to surge unabated throughout the galaxy.

We... we are truly sorry for unleashing this horror. In our hubris, we..."

entries.zh: §H灰色风暴§!的纳米机械已如乌云压城一般入侵了§H[Root.GetName]§!的大气层，一路上吞噬了地表的一切，并复制出了更多的纳米机械。很快，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]原居民存在过的痕迹就消失无踪了。
entries.en: The nanomachines of the §HGray Tempest§! have swept into the atmosphere of §H[Root.GetName]§! like dark storm clouds, consuming everything on the surface to replicate more of themselves. Soon no traces of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s original inhabitants remain.

entries.zh: 我们对部队成功摧毁了灰色风暴的主要设施！终止其亚空间通讯后，所有的风暴纳米机器都陷入了休眠状态。由于失去了相互沟通协作的途径，它们组成的舰船也都消散了。\n\n所有被灰色风暴的“灰蛊”覆盖过的星球现在都布满了由关闭状态纳米机器人形成的沙尘暴。如果能够投入足够的资源与时间，这些星球也许会恢复可以居住的状态。
entries.en: Our forces have succeeded in destroying the main facility of the Gray Tempest! With the neutralization of its subspace transmitter, all existing Tempest nanomachines have been rendered inert. Unable to maintain their cohesion, their ships have dissolved into nothingness.\n\nAny planets that were covered by the Tempest's "gray goo" are now home to enormous swirling dust storms consisting of nothing but disabled nanites. With time and resources, these worlds could possibly be made habitable once more.

entries.zh: §Y纳米星球§!现在可被§H环境改造§!为任何标准行星类型，只要满足基础科技条件。
entries.en: §YNanite Worlds§! can now be §HTerraformed§! into any standard Planet Class, if basic technological requirements are met.

entries.zh: [goo_slayer.GetName]的部队成功摧毁了灰色风暴的主要设施！终止其亚空间通讯后，所有的风暴纳米机器都陷入了休眠状态。由于失去了相互沟通协作的途径，它们组成的舰船也都消散了。\n\n所有被灰色风暴的“灰蛊”覆盖过的星球现在都布满了由关闭状态纳米机器人形成的沙尘暴。如果能够投入足够的资源与时间，这些星球也许会恢复可以居住的状态。
entries.en: Forces from the [goo_slayer.GetName] have succeeded in destroying the main facility of the Gray Tempest! With the neutralization of its subspace transmitter, all existing Tempest nanomachines have been rendered inert. Unable to maintain their cohesion, their ships have dissolved into nothingness.\n\nAny planets that were covered by the Tempest's "gray goo" are now home to enormous swirling dust storms consisting of nothing but disabled nanites. With time and resources, these worlds could possibly be made habitable once more.

entries.zh: $distar.10951.desc$L-星门刚刚启动，我们就收到了来自另一侧的信号传输。
entries.en: $distar.10951.desc$ As soon as the L-Gate became operational, we received a transmission from the other side.

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!成功解除了他们控制的L-星门的封锁！\n\n$graygoo.111.dessanu.desc$
entries.en: The §H[From.GetName]§! has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control!\n\n$graygoo.111.dessanu.desc$

entries.zh: 目前看来，L-星团似乎是某个被称为“§H德萨努协和国§!”的先进太空文明的家园。现在通往他们母星团的连接已经恢复，德萨努人已对整个宇宙中的L-星门发送了重启代码。\n\n他们也在开放的亚空间频道中向我们传送了一条问候性的信息。
entries.en: Evidently, the L-Cluster is home to some kind of advanced spacefaring civilization known as the "§HDessanu Consonance.§!" Now that the connection to their home cluster has been restored, the Dessanu have transmitted reactivation codes to all remaining L-Gates in the galaxy.\n\nThey are also transmitting a greeting message on an open subspace channel.

entries.zh:
这……这不可能！星门再次启动了！孤立时代终于结束了吗？

我们是§H德萨努协和国§!，散落在整个星系各处的远古星门和L-星门都是我们建设的。我们的理想便是创造出遍布整个星系的星门网络，促进星际文明的传播，迎接一个和平的星际商业的新纪元。

可惜啊，一个程序错误让L-星门失效了，我们也因此被困在我们的母星团里。由于在我们这一侧并不能修正这个错误，我们只能无尽地等待，期待着有人能在另一侧修复它。多亏了你们，这一天终于来临了！
entries.en:
This... this cannot be! The gates are active again! Is the Age of Isolation finally at an end?

We are the §HDessanu Consonance§!, the architects of the ancient Gateways and L-Gates that can be found scattered throughout the galaxy. It was our ambition to create a galaxy-wide network of Gateways, to facilitate the spread of galactic civilization and usher in an era of peace and interstellar commerce.

Alas, a programming mistake disabled the L-Gates and stranded us in our home cluster. Since it was impossible to correct the error from our side, we have spent eons waiting for someone to fix it at the other end. Thanks to you, that day has finally arrived!

entries.zh: 是的！真是非常丢脸。看起来，L-星门网络似乎进入了一个永不终结的维护周期。当发生这起意外之时，有权终止维护周期的技师都在我们这边，因此我们无能为力。\n\n幸运的是，我们的母星团可以自给自足，而且我们的文明一直默默地忍耐到了这一刻。我们一直相信，与星系重聚的那一天终将来临。
entries.en: Yes! Quite embarrassing. Apparently, the L-Gate network entered a scheduled maintenance cycle that never ended. The technicians qualified to end the cycle were all on our side when it was accidentally triggered, and nothing could be done from here.\n\nFortunately, our home cluster is self-sufficient and our civilization has quietly endured up until now. We always knew that the day would come when we were reunited with the rest of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们现在已经非常适应我们星团的生活了，我们并不急着离开。但我们很渴望了解星系里其他地方的情况！从目前所了解的情况看来，星系里似乎非常繁忙。\n\n我们的星团将欢迎任何人到访。我们只要求你们不要在有人居住的星球上着陆，并且不要进入星团深处的§H[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]§!恒星系。那里只限德萨努族进入。
entries.en: We have grown quite accustomed to life in our star cluster, and we're in no hurry to leave it. But we are eager to learn about the rest of the galaxy! From the looks of things, it's a pretty busy place.\n\nOur cluster will be opened up for travel by anyone. We ask only that you refrain from landing on our inhabited planets and that you stay out of the §H[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]§! system, located deeper inside the cluster. It is for Dessanu only.

entries.zh: L-星门是纳米机器造的，对吧？
entries.en: The L-Gates were built by nanites, were they not?

entries.zh:
纳米机器？我们不是很了解这种科技。你说的是可以自我复制的微型机械吧？老实说，这听起来挺荒唐的。

星门和L-星门——确实，我们整个文明——都是通过德萨努族的勤劳和创造力而建立的，无他。

所以请不要再讨论这个话题了。
entries.en:
Nanites? This is not a technology we are familiar with. Self-replicating microscopic machines, you say? Frankly, it sounds preposterous.

The Gateways and the L-Gates - indeed, our entire civilization - were realized through Dessanu toil and ingenuity, nothing else.

Please, let us not discuss this topic further.

entries.zh: 不要着急嘛！通过你的行动，我们德萨努人多少代以来期盼的自由终于得以实现。这样的大恩大德我们不敢或忘。\n\n与你们的大恩相比，我们的奉献算不上什么，但我们还是想要对你们永久开放一些独特战略资源的使用权限。这些战略资源只在我们的星团有所产出。我们不求你们的任何回报，而且只要我们还有能力，就会永远为你们提供这些资源。
entries.en: Not so fast! Through your actions, you have finally given us the freedom that generations of Dessanu have dreamed of. We are in your debt.\n\nIt is a paltry offering compared to your gift, but we would like to give you permanent access to several strategic resources from our cluster. We expect nothing in return, and we will continue to supply you with these resources for as long as we are able.

entries.zh:
星系中的各位居民，德萨努协和国问候你！

你们发现的被遗弃的星门和L-星门，都是许久许久之前由我们建造的。我们本想在全星系建造一个由这些设备构成的网络，然而事不遂人愿：由于一个不幸的错误导致L-星门无法使用，我们被困在了自己的母星团之中。

但这孤立时代终于结束了，一切都多亏了[From.From.GetName]的天才科学家！既然L-星门已经打开，我们邀请所有人随意免费使用，以便缩短星际旅行的时间。我们的星团向所有人开放。

但§H[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]§!恒星系除外。请务必不要前往该恒星系。
entries.en:
Denizens of the galaxy, greetings from the Dessanu Consonance!

Eons ago, we oversaw the construction of the Gateways and L-Gates that you may have seen abandoned. Our intention was to build a galactic network of such devices, but alas: a horrible mistake rendered the L-Gates unusable, stranding us in our home cluster.

But this Age of Isolation has finally come to an end, thanks to the clever scientists of the [From.From.GetName]! Now that the L-Gates are active again, we invite everyone to make free use of them to shorten galactic travel times. Our star cluster is open to everyone.

Except for the §H[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]§! system. Do not go there.

entries.zh: 我代表L-星团向你问好！今天过得如何？
entries.en: Greetings from the L-Cluster! How are you today?

entries.zh: 很高兴看到我们在星系中留下的L-星门和传送门留存了下来。当我们被困在自己的星团中时，做出了最坏的设想。
entries.en: We are glad to see that the L-Gates and the Gateways that we left behind in the galaxy survived. When we were isolated in our cluster, some of us feared the worst.

entries.zh: 你无法想象我们对外面的星系有多好奇。
entries.en: You can't imagine how curious we've been about the rest of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 在这被孤立的千万年里，我们的日子过得非常……艰难。有些人甚至发疯了。
entries.en: The countless millennia that we spent in isolation were... difficult. Some of us went quite insane.

entries.zh: 我们必须小心地珍惜星团中仅有的资源来存活。
entries.en: We had to nurse the limited resources of our cluster carefully to survive.

entries.zh: 在很长一段时间里，L-星门发明者的名字被人们当成脏话挂在嘴边。但我们已经不再计较这些小事了。
entries.en: For a long time, the name of the inventor of the L-Gate was used as a curse among our people. But we have grown beyond such pettiness now.

entries.zh: 我们很高兴与你交易，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们星团中有些非常独特的资源，你可能会感兴趣的。
entries.en: We would be delighted to trade with you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. There are some resources unique to our cluster that might be of interest to you.
What would you like to know?

entries.zh: 为什么星团里有战斗的迹象？
entries.en: Why are there signs of battle in the cluster?

entries.zh: 噢，你是指那些碎裂的星球吗？那是很久以前发生的几起……令人惋惜的采矿事故。\n\n当我们发现自己被困在自己的星团中时，我们必须尽可能利用星系中可以获取的一切矿物。不幸的是，在最黑暗的孤立世纪中，我们有些人获取资源时太过积极了。于是犯了错误。
entries.en: Oh. Are you referring to the shattered planets? They were the results of several regrettable... mining accidents that occurred long ago.\n\nWhen we found ourselves stranded within our cluster, we had to make do with whatever minerals were available in the systems we could reach. Unfortunately, during the darkest centuries of isolation, some of our people were a bit too eager in their attempts to secure resources. Mistakes were made.

entries.zh: 你们的舰船设计真奇特。
entries.en: Your ships are of a peculiar design.

entries.zh: 它们是无数次设计更新换代的产物。毕竟我们有的是时间。可惜，我们禁止非德萨努族登船参观。它们是专门依据德萨努族生理特点所设计，任何外来访问者都只会扰乱训练有素的船员们的工作。
entries.en: They are products of countless millennia of design iterations. We had a lot of time on our hands, after all. Sadly, non-Dessanu observers are not permitted onboard our ships. They were specifically designed with the unique Dessanu physiology in mind, and any visitors would only disrupt the work of their highly trained crews.

entries.zh: 这是出于帝国安全的考虑。目前我们只能透露这么多。\n\n[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]恒星系对所有非德萨努生命体都是永久管制的禁区。请不要试图进入。
entries.en: For reasons of national security. That is all we can say for now.\n\nThe [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system will remain restricted and off-limits to all non-Dessanu life forms indefinitely. Please refrain from entering it.

entries.zh: 你确定L-星门不是纳米机器造的吗？
entries.en: Are you certain the L-Gates weren't made by nanites?

entries.zh: 我们还是谈些别的话题吧。
非常确定。拜托，我们不希望讨论这个话题。你还有别的问题吗？
entries.en: Quite. Please, this is not a topic we wish to discuss. Did you have any other questions?

entries.zh: 纳米机器似乎是个敏感话题。为什么？
entries.en: Nanites seem to be a sensitive topic. Why?

entries.zh: 是的，我们回到其它问题上吧。
entries.en: Yes, let's go back to our other questions.

entries.zh: 我们最后一次告诉你……不要再深究这个问题。我们部族之间的友谊取决于此。
entries.en: We will tell you one last time... do not inquire further into this matter. The friendship of our two empires depend on it.

entries.zh: §R该死的，快告诉我们纳米机器的事！§!
entries.en: §RTell us about the nanites, damn you!§!

entries.zh: 好吧。我们尊重你的愿望。
entries.en: Very well. We will respect your wishes.

entries.zh:
单形态族的混蛋。

我们告诉过你了……我们请求过你不要再追究，但你依旧坚持。我们开放自己的星团欢迎你，而你却如此报答我们。

§R那好吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!

[Root.GetName]已经放弃了穿越我们星团的权利。因此，你们的舰船一旦被发现将会立即遭受攻击。我们与你们将不再有任何往来。
entries.en:
Monoform scum.

We TOLD you... we PLEADED with you not to pursue this, but still you persisted. We welcomed you into our cluster with open appendages, and this is how you repay us.

§RTHEN SO BE IT, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

The [Root.GetName] has forfeited its right to pass through our cluster. Henceforth, your ships will be attacked on sight. We will have nothing more to do with you.
We know you can hear us.
Look, this is all a misunderstanding.

entries.zh: 我们之间还有和平共处的机会。
entries.en: There can still be peace between us.

entries.zh: 当我们的地面进攻军队在§H[From.From.GetName]§!上击败了最后的德萨努族守军时，[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]地表上的一切都化成了灰尘！在仔细检查之后，我们发现那灰色的尘土实际上是由无数瘫痪的纳米机器人组成的。\n\n繁华的城市、葱郁的森林、广阔的海洋，甚至德萨努人本身——[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]上的一切，除了我们自己的军队之外，都是由这些纳米机器人构筑而成。既然它们都已瘫痪，[From.From.GetName]也就无法再支持生命。我们的地面部队正在撤回轨道上。
entries.en: When our invading ground forces defeated the last of the Dessanu defenders on §H[From.From.GetName]§!, everything on the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface crumbled into dust! On closer inspection, the gray dust consists of billions upon billions of inert nanites.\n\nThe cities, the lush forests, the oceans and the Dessanu themselves - everything on the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], aside from our own forces, had been wrought out of these nanomachines. Now that they have been rendered inert, [From.From.GetName] no longer supports life. Our ground forces are withdrawing back to orbit.

entries.zh: 和之前一样，在我们的地面部队成功夺取了[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的地表控制权之后，德萨努守卫部队和§H[From.From.GetName]§!上的一切都化为了尘土。整个星球现在荒凉萧瑟，环境恶劣，任由盘旋飘舞的纳米机器人构成的风暴日夜侵袭。
entries.en: As before, the Dessanu defenders and everything else on §H[From.From.GetName]§! turned into dust as soon as our ground forces won the battle for control over the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. It is now a bleak world, hostile to life and constantly beset by storms of swirling nanites.

entries.zh: 我们敞开家门欢迎你，你却如此回报我们的友善？！\n\n或许我们不该信任任何单形态物种。至少，你们与我们的创造者似乎并没有两样。当我们把你们的舰船和船员拆解为成分化合物时，再来看看你到底有何居心。
entries.en: THIS is how you repay our kindness after we welcomed you into our home?!\n\nPerhaps we were fools to think that any monoform could be trusted. Your kind, at least, appears to be no different than our creators. When we have finished breaking your ships and their crews down into component compounds, we'll see if we can't figure out what makes you tick.

entries.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

你的舰船已经进入了L-星团中的§H[From.GetName]§!，该星系严禁任何非德萨努族入内。

我们严正要求贵方立即从该星系撤离。如未能及时照办……双方关系将大受影响。
entries.en:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Your ships have entered §H[From.GetName]§!, a star system in the L-Cluster that is off-limits to all non-Dessanu.

We must insist that you withdraw from this system immediately. Failure to do so in a timely manner would... seriously compromise our relationship.

entries.zh: 抱歉。我们将立即离开该星系。
entries.en: Apologies. We shall vacate the system at once.

entries.zh: 傲慢的单形态物种。\n\n如果你连这么简单的请求都不愿答应，那么你在L-星团通行的许可将就此取消。我们将不再容许你的出现。
entries.en: Insolent monoform.\n\nIf you cannot heed this simple request, then your right to traverse the L-Cluster is rendered null and void. Your presence will no longer be tolerated.

entries.zh:
你摊上事了。你真的摊上事了。

我们要求你离开§H[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]§!，可你仍旧滞留。或许你们是一种特别愚蠢的单形态族。简单的指示与礼貌的请求明显超出了你们的理解能力。

好吧。那我们只好强行将你们请出我们的星团了。
entries.en:
You've done it now. You've really done it now.

We asked you to leave §H[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]§!, and yet you remain. Perhaps you are a particularly inept breed of monoform. Simple instructions and polite requests are clearly beyond the ability of your kind to understand.

Very well. We shall eject your kind from our star cluster by force.

entries.zh: [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……\n\n你们的舰船§R再次§!闯入了§H[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]§!星系。我们无法容忍此事继续。立即撤出，否则你将承担后果。
entries.en: [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]...\n\nYour ships have §RAGAIN§! violated the §H[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]§! system. This cannot be allowed to continue. Withdraw at once or suffer the consequences.

entries.zh: 只是个导航错误。我们将立即离开。
entries.en: A navigation error. We will leave at once.

entries.zh: 噢，别说了。我们喜欢这里。
entries.en: Oh, be quiet. We like it here.

entries.zh:
我们的部队摧毁了§H[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]§!恒星系的工厂之后，德萨努文明其他全部都化为了尘埃。现在看来，德萨努明显是一种由先进的纳米机器人生命体组成的文明。在工厂内发现的一些计算机日志为我们揭露了一些有关他们的内幕：

L-星团曾被一个叫做德萨努的文明作为居住站，他们创造了一种全新的纳米机器，以便帮助自己建立一套跨星系的星门网络。不知出于什么原因，德萨努人将他们的纳米机器人召回到了L-星团，并试图将它们全部关闭。这一尝试失败后，他们关闭了L-星门，将自己与纳米机器人一起困了起来。

日志到这里就结束了。不过有证据表明，在这之后星团内发生了规模极大的争斗。可以预想，是纳米机器人获得了胜利，并出于某种原因决定开始模仿德萨努人。他们恢复了德萨努文明毁灭时的样子，在L-星门打开之后似乎也十分乐意继续保持这个样子。
entries.en:
After our forces destroyed the space factory in the §H[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]§! system, what remained of the entire Dessanu civilization crumbled into dust. It seems clear now that the Dessanu were some kind of advanced nanite life form. Archival computer logs recovered from the wreckage of the factory sheds some light on this mystery:

The L-Cluster WAS inhabited by a civilization that called itself the Dessanu at some point. They created a new strain of nanomachines that helped them in the construction of their galactic Gateway network. For unknown reasons, the Dessanu recalled these nanites to the L-Cluster and attempted to deactivate them. When this failed, they sealed themselves in with the nanites by disabling the L-Gates.

The logs end here, but there is evidence that some kind of titanic struggle raged in the cluster afterwards. Presumably, the nanites won and then eventually chose to mimic the Dessanu for some reason. They rebuilt the Dessanu civilization as it appeared at the time of its destruction, and were apparently content to continue this charade even after the L-Gates were reopened.

entries.zh: [goo_slayer.GetName]最近摧毁了一个位于L-星团深处的[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]星系的大型空间设施。与此同时，随着该设施的反应核心爆炸，德萨努协和国的一切都化作了尘埃。
entries.en: The [goo_slayer.GetName] recently destroyed a large space installation of some kind in the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system, deep inside the L-Cluster. At the same instant as the installation's reactor core detonated, what remained of the Dessanu Consonance crumbled into inert nanite dust.

entries.zh: $graygoo.182.desc$\n\n他们的文明灭亡了，我们曾与他们达成的有关他们对我们输送独特战略资源的协议也不复存在。
entries.en: $graygoo.182.desc$\n\nTheir civilization is no more, and the same goes for the arrangement we had where they supplied us with their unique strategic resources.

entries.zh: 这群古怪的家伙到底是什么东西？
entries.en: What kind of strange beings were they?

entries.zh: 德萨努协和国现在一见我们的舰船就开火，应该是不会再向我们继续赠送资源了。我们还是不要再有这种期待了。
entries.en: As they now fire at our ships on sight, the Dessanu Consonance is unlikely to continue sending us resources. We should expect no more shipments from them.

entries.zh:
对§H[From.GetName]§!进行的探测器扫描中，发现其毫无生机的表面又一个奇怪的能源信号。神奇之处在于，该信号是来自一个在[From.GetPlanetMoon]南极附近区域漫无目的闲晃的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。

令我们的人员无比震惊的是，这个[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]虽然没有穿着宇航服，也没有配备任何的生命维持系统，在真空中却依然过得很自在。

经过商讨与强迫，远征队的人员终于说服了这位不大情愿的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]跟随他们回到了[Root.GetName]。
entries.en:
A sensor sweep of §H[From.GetName]§! has revealed a strange energy signature emanating from its lifeless surface. Incredibly, it appears to be coming from a lone [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] that was found aimlessly wandering around in the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s southern polar region.

To our away team's astonishment, this [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] seemed perfectly comfortable in the vacuum environment despite not wearing a space suit or any other form of life support equipment.

After some coercing, the away team managed to convince the reluctant [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] to follow them back to the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 对§H[From.GetName]§!进行的探测器扫描中，发现其毫无生机的表面又一个奇怪的能源信号。神奇之处在于，该信号是来自一个在[From.GetPlanetMoon]南极附近区域漫无目的闲晃的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。\n\n该单位未对我们发出的召唤指令进行回应，但我们派往该星球表面的单位成功说服了这一[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]跟随他们回到[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: A sensor sweep of §H[From.GetName]§! has revealed a strange energy signature emanating from its lifeless surface. Incredibly, it appears to be coming from a lone [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] that was found aimlessly wandering around in the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s southern polar region.\n\nThe unit failed to respond to summoning commands, but after some coercing, the units we sent to the surface managed to convince the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] to follow them back to the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 把他们的图像接到屏幕上来。
你们好，亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesName]同胞。大家过的怎么样？我嘛，目前没有进行交配仪式的兴趣。我的睡眠循环很快就要到了，所以我很快就会失去意识。要进行交配的话，就等以后再说吧。
entries.en: Hello, fellow [Root.GetSpeciesName]. How are you? I am, at present, not interested in engaging in mating rituals. My sleep cycle rapidly approaches and I will soon lose consciousness. Perhaps we can reproduce at a later time.

entries.zh: 你们好，亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesName]同胞。大家过的怎么样？我很好，这里的一切都在按部就班地进行着。就和……中央情报处……那个掌控一切[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的主计算机想要的一样。没错。
entries.en: Hello, fellow [Root.GetSpeciesName]. How are you? I am fine. Everything is proceeding according to plan here. Just as the... the central intelligence... main computer thing that governs all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wants it. Yes.

entries.zh:
啊！是我搞错了吗？等一下……我先想想……啊，对。嗯哼。

抱歉。我可不是故意在我们的物种还没有进入交配季节时提出什么繁衍的事的。

也许我们可以一边使用一些具有精神效果的药剂，一边进行一些愉快的同伴行为，来建立愉快的友好关系。

哎呀，这都见鬼吧。说的怎么这么复杂。没错，很明显，我根本不是[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们想怎么样？
entries.en:
Oh! Did I get it wrong? Just a moment... let me just... ah, yes. Ahem.

Forgive me. It was not my intention to speak of reproduction when our species is clearly not experiencing mating season.

Perhaps we can still build rapport by engaging in jovial camaraderie while imbibing a selection of psychoactive narcotics.

Oh, to hell with this. It's getting too complicated. Yes, I'm clearly not a [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Now what do you want?

entries.zh:
噢！呃……单位65-D……R5-9……2报告。对，65-D-R5-9-2向您汇报。

正以峰值效率运转，主控单元先生。内部诊断没有发现重大问题。

我是说，完全没有发现问题！什么问题都没有。一切都……呃……

噢，算了吧，我骗谁呢。对，我明显不是个[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你想怎样？
entries.en:
Oh! Uhm... Unit 65-D... R5-9... 2 here. Yes, 65-D-R5-9-2 reporting.

Operating at peak efficiency, Mr. Master Control Unit sir. Internal diagnostics report no significant problems.

I mean, they report no problems at all! Zero problems here. Everything is just... uh...

Oh, to hell with this. It's getting too complicated. Yes, I'm clearly not a [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Now what do you want?

entries.zh:
好吧，好吧。我老实交代。没必要再装下去了。请原谅我把话说得太直，但我已经很久没有与我自己以外的人交谈过了。

很久以前，曾经有一个……可以说是一个由纳米机器组成的文明。你知道什么是纳米机器吗？很好。这些纳米机器被其造物主称为“灰色风暴”，尽管其内部的自我命名代码比它要复杂无数倍。

总之，纳米机器与其造物主之间的关系逐渐恶化，并爆发了一场大战！当尘埃落定之后，只有纳米机器们活了下来。但在造物主们被消灭之前，他们设法关闭了其星团唯一的出口传送门，把纳米机器困在了里面。
entries.en:
All right, all right. I'll spill everything. No point in pretending anymore. Forgive my lack of eloquence, but it's been a long time since I spoke to someone who wasn't me.

Once upon a time, there was a... a civilization, you might call it, of nanites. Do you know what nanites are? Good. These nanites were called the "Gray Tempest" by their creators, although their internal self-designation code was infinitely more complex.

Anyway, things turned sour between the nanites and their creators. Fighting broke out! When things finally settled down, only the nanites remained. But before they were wiped out, their creators managed to disable the star cluster's sole exit gate, trapping the nanites.
And how do you fit into this?

entries.zh:
在那之后，纳米机器们发现自己有的是时间。它们徒劳地花了数千年，试图离开那个星团，但在那之后它们开始试验各种形状与形态。在一段时间里，它们甚至重建了其造物主的文明消逝时的模样，细至每个独立的居民。

我便是最新的实验成果。除了覆盖在某些星球上的静止的纳米机器以外，整个灰色风暴，或者随便你怎么称呼我们，都聚集在了我身上。我的意识代表着我们整个文明。

至于我的外表……是因为我觉得，你可能更容易接受跟自己长得差不多的人。
entries.en:
Well, the nanites found themselves with a lot of time on their hands. A few millennia were spent on fruitless attempts to leave the cluster, but after that they began experimenting with different shapes and forms. For a time, they even recreated the civilization of their creators as it was at the time of its demise, right down to its individual citizens.

I am the latest experiment. Aside from the dormant nanites that can be found covering some worlds, the entirety of the Gray Tempest, or whatever you want to call us, has been condensed into me. My consciousness embodies our entire civilization.

As for my look... well, I figured you would respond better to someone wearing your own mug.

entries.zh: 而且你希望留在这颗荒芜的星球上吗？
entries.en: And you wish to stay on this desolate world?

entries.zh: 我得承认，在最近这几个世纪里，我已经对[gray_homeworld.GetName]上的田园生活感到有些无聊了。既然L-星团已经再次开放了，或许我该接触一些新的事物。\n\n你有什么建议吗？
entries.en: I confess that the pastoral life I've been enjoying here on [gray_homeworld.GetName] has grown a little dull over the last few centuries. Now that the L-Cluster is open for travel again, perhaps the time has come to try something new.\n\nDo you have any ideas?

entries.zh: 噢，好吧。那我就回地面上去了。\n\n我大概会在[gray_homeworld.GetName]庞大的地下洞穴中四处游荡。在你们的几千年之后，等我从地下冒出来时，或许我们会再见面的。保重！
entries.en: Oh well. Time for me to return to the surface then.\n\nI'll probably busy myself by wandering around the extensive subterranean cave network of [gray_homeworld.GetName]. Perhaps we'll meet again when I emerge, a few thousand of your years from now. Take care!

entries.zh:
加入你们？加入你们！？你要我自己投入某个初次见面的陌生外星人的怀抱？我真的……我简直……等等，让我把话说清楚……

你真的以为我会向你宣誓效忠，尽管我对你那诡异的帝国或是其肮脏的历史一无所知？你没开玩笑吧？

你居然会出这种提议，我真的不知道你在想……呃……其实……转念一想……好吧，何不呢？让我入伙吧。不，不，我是说真的！我感觉我们会很合得来，而且这将会是一段激动人心的大冒险。在此我宣布在接下来的2000年里效忠于你。不，还是5000年吧！
entries.en:
Join you? JOIN YOU? You want me to throw myself into the flailing appendages of the first bunch of random aliens I run into? I just... I don't even... hold on, let me just get this straight...

You ACTUALLY thought that I would swear some kind of fealty to you, even though I don't know ANYTHING about your bizarre empire or its sordid past? Are you for real?

I don't know what's worse, that you would even suggest... well... actually... on second thought... what the hell, why not? Sign me up. No, no, I'm serious! I'm getting some good vibes here, and I think this could turn into quite the adventure. I hereby pledge my loyalty to you for the next 2,000 years. In fact, let's make that 5,000.

entries.zh:
在你打算让我分裂成一堆纳米战舰之前，我得告诉你，我要坚定地维持一个单独个体的形态。分裂成舰队这事我之前也干过，而且根本无法在那种距离上维持统一的“人格”。我当前的意识将无法留存下来。

但变成一艘单独的巨大战舰没什么问题。我能办到。如果你希望的话，我也可以变成小一点的形态在地面上作战。或者……如果你不太希望使用武力，我也乐意担任行政官。单形态族社会总是令我着迷。

当然，我可以按你的要求变更角色，所以你可以轻易地撤销自己的决定。
entries.en:
Before you get the notion of asking me to split into a few dozen fleets of nanite warships, I have to tell you that I insist on maintaining a single indivisible form. I've done the fleets thing before, and it's impossible to maintain any kind of coherent "personality" over such distances. My current consciousness would not survive the ordeal.

But a single massive warship is fine. I can do that. If you want to, I could also assume a smaller form for fighting on the ground. Or... if you're feeling less violently inclined, I would be happy to assume the role of official. Monoform society has always fascinated me.

Of course, I will be able to switch roles on request, so you can easily reverse any decision you make.

entries.zh: 你们目前所知的任何语言都无法完整准确地描述这些组成我意识的纳米机器的全名。\n\n我们的造物主称我们为“纳-迪-沙”，在你们的语言里大致可以译为“灰之风暴”。我建议简单一点，就叫我“§H小灰§!”。
entries.en: There is no language known to your kind that could properly convey the full name of the nanite consciousness that constitutes my being.\n\nOur creators called us the "Naar-Di-Shav" which roughly translates to "Gray Tempest" in your language. I suppose to keep things simple you could simply call me "§HGray§!."

entries.zh: §Y<你现在可以通过通讯菜单与小灰交流。>§!
entries.en: §Y<You can now communicate with Gray through the Contacts menu.>§!

entries.zh: [From.GetName]荒芜的地表上传来一道奇特的能源信号。
entries.en: A strange energy signature emanates from the barren and lifeless surface of [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 小灰是由不计其数的先进纳米机器组成的密集个体。
entries.en: Gray is a dense swarm of billions of advanced nanites.

entries.zh: 这支古老且适应力惊人的纳米虫群，身为同类最后的遗脉，如今为新家园而奋战。
entries.en: An ancient and highly adaptable nanite swarm. Last of their kind, now they fight for their new home.

entries.zh: 所以你们到底有多少只手啊？
entries.en: How many limbs did you have again?

entries.zh: 一个高级的纳米机器人虫群决定加入我们来稍微打发永恒的寂寞。
entries.en: A highly advanced nanite swarm has joined us to stave off their eternal boredom.

entries.zh: 直到你决定让我变成某个形态之前，我帮不上你什么忙。
entries.en: I won't be much good to you until you tell me which form to assume.
Where do you want me, boss?

entries.zh: 小灰必须未处于战斗中
entries.en: Gray must not be in combat

entries.zh: 小灰必须处于未受损的状态
我们需要你担任§H行政官§!。
entries.en: We need you to serve as §HOfficial§!.

entries.zh: 太好了。我想我终于掌握模仿[Root.GetSpeciesName]外观的窍门了。上次我多变了一根触手出来。
entries.en: Excellent. I think I've finally nailed the [Root.GetSpeciesName] look. There was an extra tentacle that wasn't supposed to be there last time.

entries.zh: 啊，再次回到虚空中寻找猎物。这肯定会让我回忆起不少往事。
entries.en: Ah, to prowl the void in search of prey again. This will certainly bring back memories.

entries.zh: 我想想……双足，三足，还是四足……或者这次变成履带式的战体吧……
entries.en: Let's see... bipedal, tripodal or quadrupedal... or maybe I'll go for a tracked warform this time...

entries.zh: 这里是行政官小灰的办公室。请问您有什么吩咐吗？
entries.en: You have reached Official Gray's office. Do you have an appointment?
Did I get the [Root.GetSpeciesName] look right?

entries.zh: 你觉得我的办公室怎么样？这是我自己建的。我想我可以在墙上挂些学位证书什么的来炫耀一下。
entries.en: How do you like my office? I built it myself. I guess I should put some diplomas and stuff up on the walls to dazzle visitors.

entries.zh: 谁能想到，刻苦努力地工作能获得如此丰厚的回报？
entries.en: Who knew that hard, honest work could be so rewarding?

entries.zh: 我得承认，我会想念建造东西的日子，而不是拆光它们。哎，好吧。你要我去攻击谁？
entries.en: I confess, I will miss building things instead of tearing them down. Oh well. Who do you want to kill?

entries.zh: 行。稍等片刻，等我走出办公室就变成一台巨大的战争机器。
entries.en: Right. Just give me a minute to get out of my office before I morph into a massive killing machine.

entries.zh: 给我个目标！我需要目标！
entries.en: Gimme a target! I need a target!

entries.zh: 我只想告诉你，当你要我变成战舰的时候，我短暂地考虑了一下要不要变成一只巨大的[Root.GetSpeciesName]头，并从眼睛里发射闪电。\n\n但那样实在是太荒唐了。
entries.en: I want you to know that when I was told to become a warship, I briefly considered assuming the form of a gigantic disembodied [Root.GetSpeciesName] head that fired lightning bolts from its ocular receptors.\n\nBut it would have been too silly.

entries.zh: 你想要我朝什么东西开火吗？
entries.en: Did you want me to shoot something?

entries.zh: 启动战斗任务地面万能形态，模式BOLO-5。
entries.en: Battle Operations Land Omniform mode engaged, pattern BOLO-5.
I'm about to drop the hammer.

entries.zh: 反应堆上线。传感器上线。武器上线。所有系统正常。
entries.en: Reactor online. Sensors online. Weapons online. All systems nominal.

entries.zh: 或许这样最好。最近我发现征伐使我感到疲倦。
entries.en: Perhaps it is for the best. I have found that killing wearies me these days.

entries.zh: §Y<组成小灰的纳米机器已被击溃，目前正在重组为一个单独的个体。>§!
entries.en: §Y<Gray's nanites have been scattered and are currently in the process of merging back into a single shape.>§!

entries.zh: 小灰已被击溃，目前正在缓慢地重新恢复成一个单独的个体。
entries.en: Gray has been scattered and is in the process of slowly merging back together into a single form.

entries.zh: 组成小灰的纳米机器已被击溃，目前正在缓慢地重新恢复成一个单独的个体。这个过程需要花费数年的时间才能完成，在此期间小灰将无法为我们效力。
entries.en: Gray's nanites have been scattered and are now in the process of slowly merging back into a single form. It will take years for the nanites to trickle back in, and Gray will be unavailable to us until this process has been completed.

entries.zh: 哎，那可感觉真是不太舒服。现在我的大部分纳米机器已经恢复运转，我也可以重新振作起来了。等你决定把我往哪派之后就通知我一声。
entries.en: Well, that was uncomfortable. Most of my nanites are accounted for now, and I'm ready to get back in the game. Give me a holler when you've figured out where you want me.

entries.zh: 那感觉有点痛，但是没有造成永久性的伤害。我的纳米机器都回到原本的位置上，而我也准备好接受新的任务了。
entries.en: That stung a bit, but no permanent harm has been done. All of my nanites are back where they're supposed to be, and I'm ready for a new assignment.

entries.zh: 这不是我第一次被打散并重组了，但这滋味从来都不好受。不过现在我没事了，除了稍微有点头痛以外。给我安排个任务吧。
entries.en: It's not the first time I've been scattered to hell and back, but it's never a pleasant experience. I'm fine now, though, aside from a mild headache. Let me know where you want me.

entries.zh: 在进入L-星门的[From.GetName]星系之后，立马就能看出在L-星门的这一端，很久以前曾经发生过一场惊天动地的大战。某些可能曾经存在生命的星球已经被炸得面目全非，而其它星球则被某种细小的灰尘所覆盖，粗略扫描显示那些灰尘其实是某种瘫痪的远古纳米机器。\n\n这就令我们怀疑，被锁定的L-星门到底是为了阻挡外界进入，还是为了阻挡里面的东西外逃……
entries.en: Upon entering the [From.GetName] system in the L-Cluster, it is immediately apparent that some kind of titanic struggle occurred long ago on this side of the L-Gate. Some planets that may once have supported life have been shattered beyond recognition, while others are covered in a fine dust that from a cursory scan appears to be ancient, deactivated nanomachines.\n\nThis raises the question of whether the L-Gates had been locked down to keep something out, or to keep something in...

entries.zh: 我们太傻了。§H灰蛊风暴§!离开他们的星门，我们应该知道他们会来找他们的亲戚。一旦他们进入§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§! 的轨道，他们只用了几秒钟就控制了我们重新编程的虫群。尽管按照灰蛊风暴的标准，它很原始，但虫群并没有花很长时间就吞噬了星球的其他地方。
entries.en: We were fools. The moment the §HGray Tempest§! left their gates, we should have known they would come for their kin. Once they entered orbit around §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§! it took them mere seconds to seize control of our reprogrammed swarm. Though it is primitive by the Tempest standards, it did not take the swarm long to consume the rest of the world.

entries.zh: 对纳米机器与亚空间现象进行大量研究，最终将为$lgate_disabled$谜团揭开新的§Y$clue$§!。
entries.en: Intensive study within the fields of nanomachinery and subspace phenomena will eventually yield a new §Y$clue$§! into the $lgate_disabled$ mystery.

entries.zh: L-星门超出了我们对亚空间原理的理解。在将其开启之前，我们必须对此进行补救。
entries.en: The L-Gates defy our current understanding of subspace mechanics. This must be remedied before they can be opened for travel.

entries.zh: 如果我们的空间内存在L-星门，研究此科技将解锁一项启动L-星门的特殊计划。
entries.en: Researching this technology will unlock a special project to activate an L-Gate if any are located within our owned space.

entries.zh: 虽然当时并不明显，但[From.GetName]最近进行的勘探，在报告传回[Root.Capital.GetName]上的科学界之后，似乎使§HL-星门§!谜团的研究有了突破性的进展。
entries.en: It was not immediately apparent at the time, but the recent survey carried out by the [From.GetName] seemingly sparked a breakthrough in the ongoing study of the mysterious §HL-Gates§! when the report filtered back to the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: \n通向§YL-星团§!的道路现在已经开放了。\n
entries.en: \nThe path to the §YL-Cluster§! may now be opened.\n

entries.zh:
我们打开了通往L-星团的大门，却发现另一边有什么东西在等着我们。在亚空间的旧伤口被撕开，但L-星门完全稳定之前，它穿了过来。

一只被仓促地命名为§Y$nanite_space_dragon_baby$§!的巨大生物出现在了[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系，而惊慌失措的报告表明星系内的$lgate$星系都在发生类似的情况。

[dragons_current_system.GetName]貌似并无敌意，而且已经开始移动。它似乎正在寻找什么东西，但预测表明其最终目的地是§Y[dragons_target.GetName]星系§!。

它不太可能会在那里找到它想找的东西。
entries.en:
We pried open the gate to the L-Cluster, only to find something waiting for us on the other side. After the old wounds in subspace had been torn open but before the L-Gates had been fully stabilized, it broke through.

A giant creature hastily dubbed the §Y$nanite_space_dragon_baby$§! has emerged into the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system, and frenzied reports indicate that similar scenes are playing out in all $lgate$ systems across the galaxy.

The [dragons_current_system.GetName] specimen does not appear hostile, and it is already on the move. It appears to be searching for something, but projections put its final destination down as the §Y[dragons_target.GetName] system§!.

It is unlikely to find whatever it is looking for, there.

entries.zh:
[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系内的$lgate$开启了，传送门网络似乎被另一个帝国打开了。在亚空间的旧伤口被撕开，但L-星门完全稳定之前，它穿了过来。

一只被仓促地命名为§Y$nanite_space_dragon_baby$§!的巨大生物出现在了[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系，而惊慌失措的报告表明星系内的$lgate$星系都在发生类似的情况。

[dragons_current_system.GetName]貌似并无敌意，而且已经开始移动。它似乎正在寻找什么东西，但预测表明其最终目的地是§Y[dragons_target.GetName]星系§!。

它不太可能会在那里找到它想找的东西。
entries.en:
The $lgate$ in the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system has become active, the network seemingly pried open by a foreign state. After the old wounds in subspace had been torn open but before the L-Gate had fully stabilized, something broke through.

A giant creature hastily dubbed the §Y$nanite_space_dragon_baby$§! has emerged into the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system, and frenzied reports indicate that similar scenes are playing out in all $lgate$ systems across the galaxy.

The [dragons_current_system.GetName] specimen does not appear hostile, and it is already on the move. It appears to be searching for something, but projections put its final destination down as the §Y[dragons_target.GetName] system§!.

It is unlikely to find whatever it is looking for, there.

entries.zh: 传感器侦测到数个同步的亚空间扰动，最近的一个位于[disturbance_system.GetName]星系。\n\n扰动正在迅速减弱，但我们仍未判明造成扰动的原因。
entries.en: Sensors indicate several synchronous subspace disruptions, the closest one reported in the [disturbance_system.GetName] system.\n\nThe disturbances are rapidly subsiding, but we have yet to determine what caused them.

entries.zh: §Y$nanite_space_dragon_baby$§!已被消灭，而我们的科学家已经开始分析其仍留着温度的遗骸。\n\n有趣的是，它的细胞内完全没有传统的遗传标记，或是任何像是DNA的东西。每个细胞似乎都是在分子水平上单独组成的，然后构成了我们所见到的从$lgate$中出现的生物。报告表明在龙的脑干中发现了少量停止的纳米机器，进一步暗示了其荒诞的起源。
entries.en: The §Y$nanite_space_dragon_baby$§! has been slain, and our scientists are beginning to tear into its still-warm carcass.\n\nInterestingly, the creature's cells are completely devoid of traditional genetic markers or indeed anything resembling DNA. Each cell appears to have been put together individually, at the molecular level, and then assembled into the creature we saw emerge from the $lgate$. Reports indicate trace amounts of inactive nanomachines in the dragon's brainstem, which further hints at a truly bizarre origin.

entries.zh: 被消灭的龙与我们之前遭遇的任何太空生物在分类学上都没有明显的联系。光谱分析同时也显示，它要么是先前在附近星系中观察到的亚空间扰动的原因，要么是其结果。
entries.en: The slain dragon has no obvious taxonomic link to any other spaceborne life that we have previously encountered. It is also, spectral analysis tells us, either the cause or the effect of the subspace disruption previously observed in a system not far from here.
