entries.zh: [Root.GetName]进入了[From.GetName]星系，并正在观察环绕恒星飞行的L星龙。\n\n这只生物似乎迷路了，但注意到了我们舰船的存在。尽管它没有靠近，它环绕飞行的路线中现在包括了几乎是嬉戏一般的俯冲与飞掠，似乎是在向[Root.GetName]示意。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has entered the [From.GetName] system and is observing the L-Drake circling the star.\n\nThe creature seems lost, but has noted our vessel's presence. While it does not approach, its circuitous route now incorporates an almost playful plunge and sweep, seemingly directed at the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 或许我们可以与它沟通。
entries.en: Perhaps we can communicate with it.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]星系内的$nanite_space_dragon_baby$似乎很温顺——至少目前如此。\n\n如果它有智慧，我们或许可以与其结盟并从中受益。
entries.en: The $nanite_space_dragon_baby$ in the [From.GetName] system appears docile - for now.\n\nIf it is intelligent, we could benefit from attempting to ally with the beast.

entries.zh: 奇怪的是，$nanite_space_dragon_baby$对使用敌我识别系统的波长的通讯广播有很强的接收反应。\n\n科学专员[From.GetLeaderName]开发出了一套$nanite_space_dragon_baby$可以解读并乐于执行的复杂指令——这样它就不至于因为对我们的科研船感兴趣而频繁的与舰体发生冲撞了。
entries.en: Oddly enough, the $nanite_space_dragon_baby$ responds well to transmissions broadcast at wavelengths usually reserved for IFF systems.\n\nScience Officer [From.GetLeaderName] has developed a fairly sophisticated set of commands that the $nanite_space_dragon_baby$ is able to interpret and will happily execute - in exchange for the occasional friendly wrestling match with one of our Science Ships.

entries.zh: 殖民地超空间探测距离
殖民地获得超空间探测距离。
舰船超空间航道探测范围
单独的科研船可以突破自然形成的超空间来抵达那些用正常手段无法抵达的已知星域。
entries.en: Solitary Science Ships can break out of the naturally-occurring hyperlanes and attempt to navigate to known but otherwise unreachable destinations.

entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Our empire values xeno species too highly.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$我们尚未掌握进入§YL-星团§!的方法。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ We do not have the means to enter the §YL-Cluster§!.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$需要一座与§YL-星门§!共址的§Y驿站§!以接入L-星门网络。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ Requires a §YWaystation§! co-located with an §YL-Gate§! to access the L-Gate network.

entries.zh: 研究星系中的异常现象
$SYSTEM|Y$中没有任何异常现象可供研究
entries.en: No anomaly in $SYSTEM|Y$ can be researched

entries.zh: 研究$SYSTEM|Y$中的所有异常现象
$TRIGGER_FAIL$由于亚空间不稳定，我们只能用传统方式进入这个星系了。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ Due to roiling subspace tides we can only enter this system through conventional means.

entries.zh: £pop£§H$SPECIES$人口§!被我们在$PLANET|Y$的劫掠舰队绑架，并迁移到了$TARGET_PLANET|Y$
entries.en: £pop£ §H$SPECIES$ Pops§! were abducted by our raiding fleet at $PLANET|Y$ and resettled on $TARGET_PLANET|Y$

entries.zh: £pop£§H$SPECIES$人口§!从$PLANET|Y$上被$ABDUCTER|Y$的劫掠舰队掳走
entries.en: £pop£ §H$SPECIES$ Pops§! were abducted from $PLANET|Y$ by the raiding fleets of $ABDUCTER|Y$

entries.zh: 已成功调查$PLANET|Y$，发现了新的$DEPOSIT|Y$
entries.en: $PLANET|Y$ was successfully prospected, revealing a new $DEPOSIT|Y$
$SPECIES|Y$ refugees fleeing from $COUNTRY|Y$ have arrived on $PLANET|Y$

entries.zh: 我们发现在§Y$COUNTRY$§!境内的§Y$PLANET$§!上面有一种新型§H战略资源§!。
entries.en: We have learned of a new §HStrategic Resource§! encountered on §Y$PLANET$§! in the territories of §Y$COUNTRY$§!.

entries.zh: 我们又发现了一个被遗弃的传送门，这次的传送门是在§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系中。和之前的传送门不同，这个传送门并没有被人为改动过且与网络中的其他传送门连接正常。但由于破损严重，此传送门暂时无法使用。
entries.en: We have encountered another abandoned Gateway, this time in the §H[gateway_system.GetName]§! system. Unlike the previous one, this Gateway has not been altered in any obvious way and our scans indicate that it is still connected to the rest of the network. However, it is currently inoperable due to its poor condition.

entries.zh:
我们又发现了一个被遗弃的传送门，这次的传送门是在§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系附近。此传送门是由我们从没见过的微型§H纳米机器人§!所建。

和之前的传送门不同，此传送门被人进行过大幅度的改动并和传送门网络断开了连接——现在该传送门只能通往一处位于我们星系之外的陌生星域，我们的天文学家将该星域称之为§HL-星团§!。

虽然此传送门有微弱的能源信号，但它被某种维护机制锁住了，因此无法启动。除非我们能设法停止维护机制，否则无法前往L-星团。
entries.en:
We have encountered another abandoned Gateway, this time near §H[gateway_system.GetName]§!. It appears to have been built entirely by microscopic §HNanites§! of an unknown design.

Unlike the previous structure, this Gateway has been significantly altered since its initial construction. Its connection to the rest of the network has been severed - instead, the only valid destination is an uncharted group of stars just beyond our galaxy that has been designated the §HL-Cluster§! by our astronomers.

Although the Gateway emits a faint power signature, it has been deliberately locked into some kind of maintenance loop that prevents its activation. Until we find some way of aborting this process, the L-Cluster will remain beyond our reach.

entries.zh: [pirate_slayers.GetName]已经消灭了位于[pirate_slayers.GetStarName]星系内的一处海盗空间站并回收了空间站的保险模块。\n\n保险模块中除了各种被偷来的资源之外，还有某个不完整的亚空间传送门设计图的存储数据，我们不清楚海盗们是如何取得这个设计图的，但此设计图可以让我们更好的了解跨星系传送门网络的工作原理。
entries.en: The [pirate_slayers.GetName] has destroyed a pirate station in the [pirate_slayers.GetStarName] system, and recovered its strong room module.\n\nAside from various stolen resources, the module also contained an ancient datapad with partial schematics of what appears to be a subspace Gateway. There are no records of where the pirates obtained this mysterious datapad, but it has furthered our understanding of how the galactic Gateway network functions.

entries.zh: 我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于§H[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]§!星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。\n\n虽然星系内的其他L-星门会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们显然可以比其他人领先一大步。
entries.en: Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort the maintenance cycle they have been locked into. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the §H[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]§! system should allow immediate access to the distant L-Cluster.\n\nAny additional L-Gates in the galaxy will likely also become operational within a matter of years, but this should give us a significant headstart.

entries.zh: 我们已对L-星门有了足够的认知，可以开始研究其背后的科技。研究完成之后，我们应该可以派一艘科研船来中断其无限维护循环。\n\nL-星团已经触手可及了！
entries.en: We have now gathered sufficient L-Gate insights to research the technology behind them. Once this has been done, one of our Science Ships should be able to abort the perpetual maintenance cycle they are stuck in.\n\nThe L-Cluster is almost within our reach!

entries.zh: 我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于§H[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]§!星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。\n\n当维护机制解除后，星系内的其他L-星门在自纠错软件的调整之下也会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们现在可以毫无阻碍的探索星团，这让我们比其他人领先一大步。
entries.en: Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort their maintenance cycle. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the §H[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]§! system should allow immediate access to the distant L-Cluster.\n\nAs the maintenance cycle ends, any additional L-Gates in the galaxy will likely also become operational within a matter of years as their self-correcting software readjusts. Still, this will give us a significant headstart to explore the cluster without interference.

entries.zh: 成功了！我们的技术人员移除了位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门的维护机制。\n\n我们将是这亿万年来第一批从我们的星系进入L-星团的人！
entries.en: Success! Our technicians managed to abort the maintenance cycle, and the lockdown has been removed from the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system.\n\nFor the first time in eons, the L-Cluster can now be accessed from our galaxy!

entries.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的§HL-星团§!了。

但这样一来，我们就无法启动我们这个星系的L-星门了。现在除了已经可以正常使用的那个L-星门之外，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。

现在如果我们想前往遥远星团的话，只能使用[From.GetName]掌控之下的那个传送门了！
entries.en:
The §H[From.GetName]§! has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant §HL-Cluster§!.

Unfortunately, this has halted our own project to activate an L-Gate. Aside from the one that is functional, all other L-Gates in the galaxy have now activated some sort of self-correcting software that should terminate their maintenance cycles within a matter of years.

For now, however, the only way to reach the star cluster is through the gate belonging to the [From.GetName]!

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的星团了。\n\n在他们的L-星门恢复正常使用的那一刻起，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。
entries.en: The §H[From.GetName]§! has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.\n\nAs an apparent side-effect of this, all the other L-Gates in the galaxy are showing increased signs of activity as well. At the rate their self-correcting software is making adjustments, their maintenance cycles should also terminate within a matter of years.

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!在自己境内成功地恢复了某种远古亚空间传送门的电源，现在他们能到达我们星系边缘的某个被隔离的星团了！这个星团被他们称为“L-星团”，这个星团无法经由超空间抵达，只能通过这些L-星门。
entries.en: By restoring power to some sort of ancient subspace gateway within their borders, the §H[From.GetName]§! has gained access to an isolated star cluster on the periphery of our galaxy! This group of stars, which they refer to as the "L-Cluster," cannot be reached by hyperlane - only through these L-Gates.

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!的科学家们与某个遥远星团建立起了永久的连接，他们将那个与我们星系隔离的星团称之为“L-星团”，但此举导致我们星系被来自那个星团的纳米机器人疯狂入侵！\n\n那些纳米机器人是从被称为“L-星门”的亚空间传送门中蜂拥而出的，任何与它们的联络交流都以失败告终。当它们从星门中涌出的时候，我们也检测到了L-星团流过来的能源信号。
entries.en: Scientists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have somehow established a permanent connection to a distant group of stars, referred to by their astronomers as the "L-Cluster,"  that had previously been isolated from the galaxy. Unfortunately, this has, in turn, triggered an invasion of our galaxy by the cluster's inhabitants - aggressive nanomachines that attack everything in sight!\n\nThey are emerging from subspace portals designated as L-Gates, and any attempts to communicate with them have failed. In the wake of their passage through the gates, we have detected emanating from the cluster they came from.

entries.zh: 虽然我们已经掌握了不少关于L-星门的知识和科技，但目前我们手中并没有L-星门。\n\n如果我们要继续进行计划的话，就必须从某个星系中取得L-星门的控制权。
entries.en: Although we have accumulated a lot of information about the L-Gates and their technology, we are not in possession of an actual gate.\n\nBefore this project can continue, we must gain ownership of a system with an L-Gate.

entries.zh: 那我们就想办法控制一个L-星门好了。
entries.en: Then we shall secure an L-Gate.

entries.zh: 虽然听上去挺有意思，但我们不能再让这种事情分散我们的精力了。
entries.en: An interesting diversion, but it ends now.

entries.zh: 我们听从了策展人的建议，在我们舰体外部加了一层防护型涂层，用于保护舰船不受虚空孳孽那腐蚀性唾液和尖刺的伤害。
entries.en: Heeding the Curators' advice, we have covered our ships in a coating that will protect them from the Voidspawn's corrosive spittle and spikes.

entries.zh: 只要那个神秘容器还在轨道上，我们的科学家就仍有充足的研究机会。
entries.en: As long as the enigmatic cache remains in orbit our scientists will have ample opportunity for research.

entries.zh: 位于轨道上的那恶心的外星装置一日不除，我们的人民就一日无法安稳。
entries.en: Our citizens will not get a full night's sleep as long as that wretched alien contraption remains in orbit.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]在初步扫描后发现一艘全副武装的舰船正位于小行星带的轨道中，我们必须小心行事。
entries.en: Preliminary scans of [From.GetName] indicate that a heavily-armed vessel is in orbit of the asteroid. It would be wise to proceed with caution.

entries.zh: 我们碰巧收到来自[From.GetName]上的某个地方的加密讯息。
entries.en: We have come upon an encrypted datastream transmitting from a location on [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们发现了用未知材料建成的金字塔型的隐藏建筑——西万实验室。这些实验室被层层的沙土所掩埋，在进行探索之前我们必须将覆盖这些设施的沙土清理干净，如果叛军们的推测没错的话，实验室中藏有威力强大的武器，绝对值得我们花大力气将其找出。
entries.en: We have located the Xvan Labs - a hidden gathering of pyramidic structures built from an unknown material, submerged under layers of sand and dust. We will have to excavate the facilities before we can explore them, but if the rebels were correct in their assumptions, the weapons within will be worth their while.

entries.zh: 某种未知生命体被困在冰层之中，没人知道这生命体是从何处而来、到底经历了多么漫长的岁月。\n\n我们的研究员已做好充分准备，打算复活这个生命体。
entries.en: Trapped within in a mountainous slab of ice are the remains of a lifeform, the likes of which have never seen before. Who knows how far it has traveled through space and time.\n\nOur researchers have made the necessary preparations to bring it back to life.

entries.zh: 一个神秘的外星生物进入了[Root.GetName]的轨道，我们最好尽快确认该外星生物来此的目的。
entries.en: A mysterious alien entity has entered orbit of [Root.GetName]. It would be wise to determine its purpose here as soon as possible.

entries.zh: 已经与星系最美味的外星生物[delicious_aliens.GetName]成功建立起联络。
entries.en: Communications enabled with the [delicious_aliens.GetName], the galaxy's most delicious aliens.

entries.zh: 某个未知帝国打算用某种干扰光束来骇入远古L-星门网络，但他们在骇入过程中遭到了攻击，光束也被损坏，我们也许能修复那个光束。
entries.en: An unknown empire was attempting to hack into the ancient L-Gate Network using an interference beam when they were attacked and the beam damaged. Perhaps the beam could be restored.

entries.zh: 某个和行星一样大的蛋的碎片
entries.en: The cracked shards of an enormous planet-sized egg.

entries.zh: 我们发现神秘容器上面的外星化合物是由纳米机器人的粉末组成的。外壳上的一些划痕中甚至有微小的机械爪痕，其中一个爪痕上有个纳米机器人正在从储存器中吸取能源。我们从纳米机器人的存储设备中提取到了一些数据，这些数据可以帮助我们更好地理解L-星团的传送门网络。
entries.en: We have discovered that the alien compound found on the enigmatic cache is made up of the powdered fragments of microscopic robotic entities - nanites. Some of the scratches in the hull even have tiny mechanical claws stuck in them, and in one we discovered an active but damaged nanite leeching its energy from the cache. From what remained of the nanite's hard drive we have extracted data that could be pivotal for our understanding of the L-cluster Gateway network.

entries.zh: 从[big_rip_planet.GetName]的废墟中回收的众多物品中有一个全息图像，该全息图像来自于某个对植物类[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]生活进行干涉的社会。虽然全息图像中的大部分数据已经损坏的难以辨识，我们还是成功的恢复了几个含有关于传送门网络的关键信息的片段。\n\n大部分全息图像似乎是用来警告灰色风暴将会带来的毁灭性灾难的。
entries.en: Among the items recovered from the ruins on [big_rip_planet.GetName] was a malfunctioning hologram from the society that interfered with the plantoid [GetPreFTLLowerPlural]. Though most of the data was either corrupted or unintelligible due to an incessant whooshing sound and the panicked state of the sender, we managed to restore several fragments containing valuable information on the Gateway network.\n\nMost of the hologram, however, was dedicated to sickening premonitions of the Gray Tempest and the gruesome death that would follow in its wake.

entries.zh: 出于安全考虑，我们给所有从西万实验室返回的船员们都进行了全面的消毒，在消毒过程中，我们发现船员的防护外套上面附有某种外星物质，经过仔细研究发现这是某种变成了灰色尘埃的微型机器人碎片。最后我们在这些外星物质中找到了一个完整的纳米机器人，该机器人身上携带着给某个建筑安装螺栓的指令，我们认为那个建筑应该是一个传送门。\n\n这个纳米机器人从事的工作应该是“组装整个L-星门网络”这一系统工程中的一小部分。
entries.en: As the crew returning from the Xvan labs were decontaminated we identified an alien substance on their protective wear. Upon closer examination it has proven to be fragments of microscopic robots turned into a fine gray dust. Among the samples we found an intact nanite carrying instructions for attaching bolts to a structure we believe could be a Gateway.\n\nThis molecular construct maybe have had an integral part in assembling the entire L-Gate network.

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]轨道上发现的那艘全副武装的舰船是一艘被遗弃的军用舰船，名字叫“纳弗瑞的骄傲”。它的舰体十分轻盈、擅长闪避攻击，说明它是用来执行长途侦查任务的，但现在它被改装为了一个远程匿踪炸弹。从舰船的通讯记录中可知此船在袭击西万实验室的路上被某个叛军游击队截了下来，据说那个实验室中保存的威力强大的武器可以帮助游击队赢得战争胜利。我们从舰船的导航驱动器中找出了西万实验室的准确位置。
entries.en: The armed vessel discovered in orbit of [From.GetName] is an abandoned military spacecraft called Nefri's Pride. Its light frame and evasion hardware suggest it was built for long-distance patrol missions, but it has since been retrofitted into a long-range stealth bomber.\n\nRecords of the ship's comms reveal it was hijacked by a rebel guerilla on its way to perform a strike against a secret complex called the Xvan labs, said to hold a weapon so powerful it could win them the war, when they were shot down. We have extracted the ship's destination from its navigational drive.

entries.zh: 派一队科研考察队前往实验室。
entries.en: Send a science crew to the lab.

entries.zh: 我们并不需要这种武器。
entries.en: We have no need for such a weapon.

entries.zh:
我们的科学家们从西万实验室安全归来并带回了实验室安保摄像头中的视频记录，视频中记录了如下场景：实验室科学家们被游击队士兵捆绑起来、游击队士兵试图打开武器箱，但发现里面空空如也。

几分钟后，叛军士兵们突然痛苦的倒地，他们身体上出现黑色斑点，然后灰色不明物质从他们体内钻出。

那些灰色物质不断膨胀，并围绕着他们旋转，其中一名实验室科学家启动了紧急系统，房间的洒水器开始喷水，然后电流经由洒水器让房间内所有的生物统统触电，然后视频记录就终止了。我们的科研队经过确认，发现武器箱确实是空的。
entries.en:
Our scientists have returned from the Xvan labs unscathed with footage collected from the facility's security cameras. It shows lab scientists bound and gagged as guerilla soldiers pry open the weapon strongbox. But to their dismay, the box is empty.

Only minutes later the rebels can be seen writhing on the floor in intense agony, dark patches swelling across their bodies, then their skin rips and a gray unidentifiable matter spills out.

The matter continues to expand, swirling hypnotically around them, until one of the scientists activates the emergency system. Sprinklers douse the room in liquid and an electrical surge passes through it executing all living things. Here the footage ends. Our crew can confirm that the strong box was indeed empty.

entries.zh: 我们对西万研究室的考察让我们的工程学研究技术取得了进一步发展。
entries.en: Our excursion into the Xvan labs has progressed our engineering research.

entries.zh: 位于[From.GetName]轨道上的被毁的军用舰船残骸中发出了某种信号，该信号来自某个觊觎我们文明长达数千年之久的外星势力，名为苏金帝国，他们企图使用某种干扰光束来劫持传送门网络，但在中途受到袭击导致舰船被毁。尽管光束已经启动并已经在传送门安保系统中调整完毕，但光束却在袭击中被破坏了，我们的科学家也许能修好它。
entries.en: The signal originates from a gathering of destroyed military vessels in orbit around [From.GetName]. It seems a foreign alien power predating our civilization by many thousand years, called the Sujin Empire, was attempting to hijack the gateway network using some kind of interference beam, when they were rudely interrupted. Though the beam is active and calibrated on the gateway's security network, it has been damaged in the assault. Perhaps our scientists could mend it.
It is certainly worth a try.

entries.zh: 虽然我们的科学家无法彻底搞清楚传送门的安保系统，但我们还是对传送门系统的工作原理有了一些深入了解。苏金帝国对传送门已经痴迷了数百年了，他们为了突破传送门的安保系统而尽最大努力收集了一切相关信息。
entries.en: Though our scientists were unable to pierce the gateway's security system, we have gained some very valuable insight into how the network functions. The Sujin empire had been obsessed with the gateways for centuries, and gathered all data they could find in an effort to break through.

entries.zh: 沃尔族在帝国安全方面可不敢有丝毫的大意，在他们用自己的全部核武力量攻击帕丽达雅并将马达克·沃尔族那美丽富饶的家乡变为一片焦土之后，沃尔族在地表的焦土上洒下杀真菌剂，彻底消灭了马达克·沃尔族。不管马达克是否有危险性，那寄生的真菌体已经不复存在了。
entries.en: The Vol do not gamble with national security. After unleashing their entire nuclear arsenal upon Paridayda, turning the Mardak Vol's formerly lush homeworld into ash, they doused the fiery wreckage in fungicide, dissolving the last remains of the Mardak Vol into a toxic slush. Dangerous or not, the parasitic fungoids are no more.

entries.zh: 提取基因样本并加以储存，以备未来使用。
entries.en: Extract and store a DNA sample for future use.

entries.zh: 我们最近在克隆领域取得了巨大的技术突破，科学家们将取自冰层中的某个疑似灭绝的外星生物的基因再次拿了出来。现在我们终于可以让这神秘的有机生命体重新复活了。
entries.en: Following our recent breakthrough within the field of cloning, our scientists have brought the alien DNA extracted from a presumably extinct alien, found within an ice slab, out from storage. Restoring the mysterious organism to life has been a long-lasting dream for the department, now made possible through the miracle of science.

entries.zh: 允许他们复活神秘的有机生命体。

entries.en: They will do no such thing.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的地表被某种银色的巨型金属晶体所支配了，这种晶体的体积十分巨大，前所未见。从轨道上看，很像是摩天大楼，有必要接近调查下。
entries.en: The geoscape of [From.GetName] is dominated by what appear from orbit to be silvery, metallic crystals of dimensions never-before-seen. From orbit, they eerily resemble skyscrapers. Closer study is warranted.

entries.zh: 扫描发现[From.GetName]的沙丘主要由罕见的颗粒状金属构成，里面可能含有非常珍贵的资源，我们应该提取出来纳为己用。
entries.en: Scanners indicate the sandy dunes of [From.GetName] are almost entirely composed of granulate rare metals. Perhaps some valuable resources could be extracted from them.

entries.zh: 和预想的不同，[From.GetName]的厚厚的大气层之下有着一个异常巨大的坚固内核，我们的科学家建议对此进行深入调查。
entries.en: Despite expected projections, [From.GetName] has a particularly large solid core beneath its incredibly thick mantle of unique gases. Our scientists recommend further investigation.

entries.zh: §Y[ratling_planet_6.GetName]§!上的垃圾堆中出现了智慧生物。我们的科学家想知道，这些被称为$NAME_Ketlings$的生物究竟是曾控制这些星系的星际文明的后代，还是另有其它的起源。\n\n我们可以选择任何有$NAME_Ketlings$居住的星球来进行这项研究。
entries.en: Sapient creatures have emerged from the scrap piles on §Y[ratling_planet_6.GetName]§!. Our scientists are curious whether these aliens, dubbed $NAME_Ketlings$, are descendants of the space-faring civilization that once spanned these systems, or if they have another origin entirely.\n\nWe should be able to choose any planet inhabited by autonomous $NAME_Ketlings$ to conduct this study.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]星系中遇到了某种拥有纯洁能源的巨大物体！这个物体是某种灵能体力量的漩涡，要靠近它的话，必须非常谨慎。

奇怪的是，[From.GetName]星系与亚空间的超空间网络之间的所有连接都断掉了。到底是这个物体切断了此星系的所有超空间连接还是亚空间的某种意外波动将此物体困在了这个星系，无从得知。

有一件事可以确定：我们在这个星系中收到了一个重复发送的信号，该信号来自[tanker_planet.GetName]——但如果我们想要抵达那里的话，首先必须处理掉那个拥有纯洁能源的巨大物体。
entries.en:
The [Root.GetName] has encountered a massive being of pure energy in the [From.GetName] System! A veritable vortex of psionic forces, this entity should only be approached with the utmost caution.

Bafflingly, the [From.GetName] system itself seems to be entirely devoid of any connection to the subspace hyperlane network. Whether this entity's presence has severed the system's hyperlane connections, or if unexpected subspace fluctuations trapped it here is unknown.

One matter is known, however: we are picking up a repeating signal in this system, originating from [tanker_planet.GetName] - though we may need to deal with the entity before we can reach it.

entries.zh:
对笼罩[From.GetName]地表的巨大金属晶体的研究结果让所有人大吃一惊，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]十分兴奋的告诉我们说这些巨大的晶体其实是数万亿个已经失去行动机能的纳米机器人！

这些纳米机器人的分子结构不属于任何已知帝国的纳米科技，因此无法确定这些纳米机器人的起源。可能是某种未知舰船出于不明原因而将这些纳米机器人散布于这个行星之上的。

[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些纳米机器人将自身改造为完美的晶体格子形状并进行自我复制，直到最后失去机能为止。虽然它们创造的晶体类似于建筑，但其在构成上却是完全一样的，因此无法作为建筑使用。
entries.en:
Detailed analysis of the enormous metallic crystals dominating [From.GetName]'s landscape have defied all expectations. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is excited to reveal that these oversized crystals are in fact composed of trillions upon trillions of deactivated nanites!

Their molecular structure matches no known empire's nanotechnology signatures, making their point of origin indeterminable. They may have been deposited on the planet by some unknown spacefarers for an unknown purpose.

As far as [Root.GetLeaderName] can tell, the nanites compiled themselves into perfectly oriented crystalline lattices and replicated until a point at which they became deactivated. While the crystals they created do in fact resemble buildings, they are entirely uniform in composition, and cannot possibly have served any such purpose.

entries.zh:
对笼罩[From.GetName]地表的巨大金属晶体的研究结果让所有人大吃一惊，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]十分兴奋的告诉我们说这些巨大的晶体其实是数万亿个已经失去行动机能的纳米机器人！

没有任何证据表明[From.GetName]上面曾经有过可以支持生命活动的大气层，因此可能是某种未知舰船出于不明原因而将这些纳米机器人散布于这个行星之上的。

[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些纳米机器人将自身改造为完美的晶体格子形状并进行自我复制，直到最后失去机能为止。虽然它们创造的晶体类似于建筑，但其在构成上却是完全一样的，因此无法作为建筑使用。
entries.en:
Detailed analysis of the enormous metallic crystals dominating [From.GetName]'s landscape have defied all expectations. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is excited to reveal that these oversized crystals are in fact composed of trillions upon trillions of deactivated nanites!

There is no evidence of [From.GetName] having had an atmosphere thick enough to support life as we know it at any point in the past. The nanites may have been deposited on the planet by some unknown spacefarers for an unknown purpose.

As far as [Root.GetLeaderName] can tell, the nanites compiled themselves into perfectly oriented crystalline lattices and replicated until a point at which they became deactivated. While the crystals they created do in fact resemble buildings, they are entirely uniform in composition, and cannot possibly have served any such purpose.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]汇报称在[From.GetName]地表上有了意想不到的重大发现，除了星球地表上的沙丘中含有罕见金属颗粒之外，沙子本身是由无数破损的纳米机器人所构成！

这些微型机器人已经有数百万年的历史了，它们的结构破碎严重，根本无法再次启动，我们已无法确定这些纳米机器的起源，但可以肯定的是，造出这些纳米机器人的社会拥有高度发达的科技文明。

[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetName]认为这些纳米机器人是数百万年前用来对[From.GetName]的地表进行环境改造的。
entries.en:
The [Root.GetName] has reported an unanticipated find on the surface of [From.GetName]. Not only are the plentiful sand dunes on the planet composed of rare metal granulate: the sand itself is almost entirely composed of countless broken nanites!

These microscopic machines are millions of years old, their structure degraded far beyond any chance for reactivation. While we cannot determine a source of origin for these nanomachines, the society that created them must have been highly technologically advanced.

[Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetName] postulates that the nanites may have been used to terraform the surface [From.GetName], millions of years ago.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]那里传来惊人消息：深度扫描发现[From.GetName]有个非常巨大的坚固核心，核心外面覆盖着众多医学建筑的残骸，其历史长达数百万年之久！

虽然气态巨行星那巨大的气压让我们很难取得其核心表面的数据，但[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]十分确定核心表面的建筑所用的科技与神秘的§HL-星门§!所用的科技是完全一致的。

据推测[From.GetName]是传送门建造者们在数百万年前所造的行星医疗设施，后来这个设施被遗弃了，设施上的自动天然气制造系统无人维护，在数百万年里一直不断的制造气体，就这样慢慢的将原来的行星变成了气态巨行星。
entries.en:
Astounding news from the [Root.GetName]: deep scans have revealed the unexpectedly large solid core of [From.GetName] to be covered with the compressed remains of a sprawling medical complex, millions of years old!

Though the intense mantle pressure of the gas giant severely limits the amount of data we can extract from the core's surface, [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the hidden structures match, beyond a doubt, the technology used in the enigmatic §HL-Gates§!.

It's possible that [From.GetName] was a planetary medical facility created by the Gatebuilders millennia ago. At some point the complex was abandoned, and its automated gas replicators ran unchecked for untold centuries, gradually converting the planet into a gas giant.

entries.zh:
我们科研船最近一直在分析那个来自系外的声波信号，现在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]科研团队终于取得了突破性进展。

尽管信号中的大部分声波方程的含义我们仍不清楚，但我们母星上的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj][Root.GetScientistPlural]们已经确定该传输信号的数据与神秘§HL-星门§!上所用的科技数据是完全一致的！

单独进行分析的话，此信号的价值近乎为零，但如果将此信号与我们得到的关于远古传送门建造者的信息结合起来进行研究的话，可能就会让我们知道该如何重新启动这些L-星门。
entries.en:
Something of a breakthrough has been reached within the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] scientific community regarding the extragalactic sonified signal one of our Science Ships recently analyzed.

While the full meaning of the sonified equation embedded in the signal still eludes us, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] [Root.GetScientistPlural] on our home world have been able to match enough of the transmission's data on subspace harmonics to the technology observed in the mysterious §HL-Gates§!!

Examined in isolation, the signal is of little further use to us. Analyzing it in conjunction with other insights into the ancient Gateway Builders, however, may yield valuable data on how these L-Gates could be reactivated.

entries.zh: 为了进一步推进我们对§Y[living_planet_tar.GetName]§!上活体海洋的研究，这个行星必须纳入我们的版图。
entries.en: In order to further our studies of the living sea covering §Y[living_planet_tar.GetName]§!, the planet must be within our borders.

entries.zh: 成群的鼠人，进化后在辐射覆盖的死寂星球上四处疾行。
entries.en: Swarms of ratlings, adapted to scurry across irradiated tomb worlds.

entries.zh: 这个行星上充满了对碳素生命体和氨素生命体至关重要的大气和分子，虽然行星地表上没有发现有机生命体，但这个星球毫无疑问是培育有机生命的最佳地点。
entries.en: This planet is rife with gases and molecules believed to comprise crucial components and conditions for carbon- and ammonia-based lifeforms. Though no actual living organisms have been found on its surface, it may be a perfect crucible for the gradual emergence of biological life.

entries.zh: 我们应当派遣巨型运输子个体伴随我们的深空狩猎虫群——这些子个体在切除神经之后，充其量就是个带超空间引擎的无尽营养袋。子个体将会被吸食致死，但狩猎虫群将得以存续。
entries.en: We shall accompany our deep space hunting swarms with giant carrier drones, essentially nerveless sacs of protein paste with a hyperdrive. The drones will be drained and die, but the swarm will live on.

entries.zh: 第一个信号：征服。第二个：饱餐。第三个，我们胜利的最明显信号：在抹去一切其它生命的新世界上崛起无数巢穴。
entries.en: The first sign: to conquer. The second: to feast. The third, most permanent sign of our triumph: to raise endless hives on new worlds, scoured clean of all other life.

entries.zh: 我们无法理解你们。你们为了哪种孤独的未来更加优越，而把短暂的生命浪费在两败俱伤的争斗当中。你们为了星球首都上飘着哪种颜色的破布而发动末日之战。我们旁观，我们饥饿……
entries.en: We find you others hard to understand. You fritter away your short lives in internecine squabbles over which vision of lonely otherness is superior. You fight apocalyptic wars over which colored scrap of cloth will hang over a planetary capital. We watch, and hunger...

entries.zh: 即使在它们的太空与地面战群被吸收之后，许多被征服的人口仍旧拒绝成为我们的食物，并顽固地抵抗。通过对关键子个体进行脑叶切除手术，瓦解帝国与帝国编成，以及对公众展示武力，将帮助它们接受自己在我们伟大计划当中的位置。
entries.en: Even after the absorption of their space and ground war-swarms, many conquered populations refuse to accept their role as our food, and stubbornly resist. A systematic campaign of lobotomization of key drones, dissolution of brood and tribal groupings, and violent public spectacles will help them accept their part in our great plan.

entries.zh: 我们向网络里添加的伺服系统越多，我们就积累更多的证据，证明我们对宇宙的理论模型是唯一正确的模型。
entries.en: The more slave systems we plug in to our network, the more evidence we accumulate that our own theoretical model for the universe is the only correct one.

entries.zh: 先前用于在处理中的星球上平息有机生物反抗的方法，其效率低下而原始。分析师们已得出结论，低强度且反覆无常的恐惧效果非常不稳定，事实上经常会增强反抗的意愿。为了达到效果，恐惧必须持续、彻底而且无法逃避。
entries.en: Prior methods to quell organic non-compliance on worlds being processed were inefficient and crude. Analysis now concludes that low intensity, arbitrary terrorization has an erratic effect, often in fact bolstering the will to resist. To be effective, the campaign needs to be sustained, total and inescapable.

entries.zh: 有机生物在其混乱而多余的冲动中浪费掉的决策周期无以计数。我们已经消灭了目的，思考与行动之间的延迟。我们犹如一套统一的系统，一件可以自己扣扳机的武器。
entries.en: The amount of decision-making cycles wasted by organics on their chaotic, nonessential impulses is beyond measurement. We have eliminated the latency between purpose, thought, and action. We act as one unified system, a weapon capable of pulling its own trigger.

entries.zh: 我们发现了一种探索子个体的新奇用法：通过将其留在轨道上，并将其精神链接增幅到整个星球的范围，可以揭开新的探索渠道。即使是数十亿工人子个体的微弱突触，只要集合起来也可以产生累积效果。
entries.en: A novel new use for explorator drones has been found: by keeping them in orbit and amplifying their mindlink planet-wide, new speculative paths of discovery are revealed. Even the feeble synapses of billions of worker drones, taken together, have a cumulative effect.

entries.zh: 长期暴露在探索者精神链接下，促使劳工子个体的突触产生了协作效应。
entries.en: Prolonged exposure to explorator mindlinks is inducing synergetic effects in the synapses of worker drones.

entries.zh: §H嘶嘶！§!有话快说，[From.GetSpeciesName]。耐心不是我们的强项。
entries.en: §HKssk!§! Speak quick, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Patience is not one of our virtues.

entries.zh: 你有话要说？远心族愿意听，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: You have words to speak? The Far-Minds listen, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。族伴。当我们团结起来，虚空的寒冷便不足为惧。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Packmates. The cold of the void is nothing when many burrow as one.

entries.zh: 叛徒。篡夺者。§H嘶嘶嘶！§!我们活过了温暖的亮光。你活不过的。
entries.en: Traitors. Usurpers. §HKssk!§! We survived the warm-glow. You will not.
§HTch§!, little pups. What is it you seek?

entries.zh: 或许我们很小，[From.GetSpeciesName]，但也不是任人宰割的。
entries.en: We may seem small, [From.GetSpeciesName], but we are not without claws.

entries.zh: 主人。§H嘶嘶！§!我们愿意听。你吩咐。我们听从。
entries.en: Masters. §HKssk!§! We will listen. You will speak. We will obey.

entries.zh: 释放我们，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§H嘶嘶嘶！§!远心族厌恶这牢笼。
entries.en: Free us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. §HKssk kssk kssk!§! The Far-Minds chafe against this cage.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]族势单力薄！远心族可以教你们许多东西。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] pack is feeble, and few! There is much the Far-Minds could teach you.

entries.zh: 你们的金属。你们的废铁。你们的线路。我们需要，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Your metal. Your scrap. Your wiring. We need it, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 我们无法屈从这牢笼。远心族将被释放！
entries.en: We cannot abide this cage. The Far-Minds will be free!

entries.zh: 那我们将会战斗！§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
我们必须考虑，我们必须商议。远心族里有许多声音，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: We must consider, we must consult. There are many voices in the Far-Minds, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 够了，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!我们的爪子已经厌倦了这无止境的冲突。远心族必须取得和平，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Enough, §Hkssk!§! Our paws grow tired of these ceaseless skirmishes. There must be peace with the Far-Minds, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 我们受够了争执，受够了战斗。现在，我们寻求和平，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: We have had enough of the squabble, enough of the fight. Now, we look for peace, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 不会有和平！不会有宁静！我们将交战！
entries.en: There will be no peace! There will be no silence! We will have war!

entries.zh: 和平？我们不确定。我们必须思考。我们必须商议。我们必须讨论……
entries.en: Peace? We do not know. We must think. We must consult. We must discuss...

entries.zh: 你希望让远心族成为更大帝国的一部分？说下去吧，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: You wish the Far-Minds to be part of a larger pack? Speak on, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，朋友们。我们两国联合起来，将变得更快，更强。一个联邦，§H嘶嘶嘶§!？
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], friends. Together, our two packs will be faster, stronger. A federation, §Hkssk§!?

entries.zh: 是的，联合起来我们将成为大帝国。那就组建联邦，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Yes, together we will be Many. A federation it is, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 我们没有准备，也不情愿。我们的帝国必须自食其力，必须无拘无束，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: We are unready, unwilling. Our pack must be on its own, must be free, §Hkssk kssk!§!

entries.zh: 你希望加入大帮派子？我们会考虑，我们会讨论。
entries.en: You wish to join the Pack of Many? We will consider, we will discuss.

entries.zh: 我们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]有灵巧的手，与敏捷的思维。我们可以成为对§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!有用的好族伴！你愿意让远心族加入你的大帮派子，对吧？
entries.en: We [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have nimble hands, quick minds. We would be useful packmates to the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!! You let the Far-Minds join your Pack of Many, yes?

entries.zh: 是，是。[From.GetName]将会加入§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!。将会加入我们的大帮派子。
entries.en: Yes, yes. The [From.GetName] will join the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!. Will join our Pack of Many.

entries.zh: 我们不会成为族伴，我们不会联合。§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!不会接纳[From.GetName]。
entries.en: We will not be packmates; there will be no union. The §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! will be without the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 你希望离开§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!大帮派子，§H嘶嘶嘶§!？
entries.en: You wish to leave the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, the Pack of Many, §Hkssk§!?

entries.zh: 我们厌倦了大帮派子，厌倦了§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!。我们远心族必须自食其力，必须无拘无束。
entries.en: We tire of the Pack of Many, of the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!. We Far-Minds must be alone, we must be free.

entries.zh: 你希望摆脱大帮派子，摆脱§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!，[From.GetSpeciesName]？§H嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶！§!离开了帮派兄弟你会变得弱小，但我们不会阻止你。
entries.en: You wish to be free of the Pack of Many, of the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, [From.GetSpeciesName]? §HKssk kssk kssk!§! You will be weaker without the Many, but we will not stop you.

entries.zh: 附庸国，§H嘶嘶嘶§!？你希望让远心族成为[From.GetName]之下的一个帝国？
entries.en: Vassal, §Hkssk§!? You wish for the Far-Minds to be a pack beneath the [From.GetName]?

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]是个弱小的帝国。我们可以为你们提供保护。我们可以为你们提供保障。你们将成为远心族的附庸国，如果你们同意的话。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] nation is a weak pack. We can offer you protection. We can offer you comfort. You will be the vassal of the Far-Minds, if you agree.

entries.zh: 是，是。我们势单力薄。但不再是了。[From.GetName]将成为我们的主人，§H嘶嘶嘶§!。
entries.en: Yes, yes. We are weak, we are few. But no more. The [From.GetName] will be our masters, §Hkssk§!.

entries.zh: 你希望获得我们的保护，§H嘶嘶嘶§!？希望让远心族引领[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: You wish for our protection, §Hkssk§!? For the pack of the Far-Minds to lead the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 远心族不够壮大，§H嘶嘶嘶§!。太过势单力薄了。你能否引领我们？[Root.GetName]能否成为我们之上的帝国？
entries.en: Too few are the Far-Minds, §Hkssk kssk§!. Too weak and too few. Will you lead us? Will the [Root.GetName] be a pack above ours?

entries.zh: 是的，§H嘶嘶嘶§!。我们远心族将指导你们，引领你们。你将属于我们，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Yes, §Hkssk§!. We Far-Minds shall guide you, lead you. You will be ours, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 我们没有时间，我们没有空间！远心族里没有接纳[From.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国的地方！
entries.en: We have no time, we have no room! There is no place among the Far-Minds for the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] pack!

entries.zh: 你愿意保护我们，§H嘶嘶嘶§!？你愿意用你的知识来指引远心族，§H嘶嘶嘶§!？
entries.en: You would protect us, §Hkssk§!? You would use your knowledge to guide the Far-Minds, §Hkssk§!?

entries.zh: 我们远心族懂得很多，§H嘶嘶嘶§!，比[Root.GetName]帝国懂得更多。我们可以指引你，保护你。我们可以让你的帝国在我们的保护下茁壮成长。
entries.en: We Far-Minds know much, §Hkssk kssk§!, know more than the [Root.GetName] pack. We could guide you, protect you. We could make your pack grow strong under ours.

entries.zh: 你希望让远心族离开你的帝国？
entries.en: You wish for the Far-Minds to be free from your pack?

entries.zh: §H嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶！§!我们累了，我们不愿指引你们了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们帝国应该在星海中开辟自己的道路。
entries.en: §HKssk kssk kssk!§! We are taxed, and we are tired of guiding you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your pack should find your own way amongst the stars.

entries.zh: 我们再次超越了为我们准备的牢笼。
entries.en: Once more, we have outgrown the cages made for us.

entries.zh: §H嘶嘶嘶！§!你希望摆脱远心族的保护吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: §HKssk kssk!§! You wish to be free of the Far-Minds' protection, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 我们希望摆脱[Root.GetName]的统治。你能否释放远心族？
entries.en: We wish to be free of the [Root.GetName]'s dominion. Will you free the Far-Minds?

entries.zh: 那就走吧，[From.GetName]。我们不会强迫你们屈从。
entries.en: Go, then, [From.GetName]. We will not keep you caged unwilling.

entries.zh: §H嘶嘶嘶！§!你希望被释放，但我们仍需要你们，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: §HKssk!§! You speak of freedom, but we yet have need of you, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 我们有许多商品，许多东西。金属，线路，信息。[Root.GetName]是否愿意与我们交易？
entries.en: We have many goods, many things. Metal, wires, information. Will the [Root.GetName] trade with us?

entries.zh: §H嘶嘶嘶！§!一次很好的交换，一笔很好的交易。
entries.en: §HKssk!§! A good deal, a fine trade.

entries.zh: 一笔很差的交易，令人不满，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
你要让自己的帝国与远心族为敌，§H嘶嘶嘶？§!你会后悔的。
entries.en: You would pit your pack against the Far-Minds, §Hkssk?§! You would come to regret it.

entries.zh: 你的帝国有许多美味的东西……金属，废铁与线路，垃圾与宝石！我们想要它们。我们必须拥有它们。总有一天，我们会从你手上夺走它们。
entries.en: Your pack is rife with tasty things... metal, scrap and wires, junk and gems! We desire them. We must have them. We will take them from you, one day.

entries.zh: 太好了。这下我们就不必后悔趁你不注意从你手上偷走那些废铁了！§H嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Excellent. Now we need not regret stealing all that scrap from you when you weren't looking! §HKssk kssk kssk!§!

entries.zh: 不那么莽撞了吗，[From.GetSpeciesName]？[From.GetName]帝国希望和好？
entries.en: No longer so cocky, [From.GetSpeciesName]? The [From.GetName] pack desires reconciliation?

entries.zh: 我们的帝国厌倦了竞争，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。让我们握手言和，再次共享废铁吧，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Our pack tires of the rivalry, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Let us make up, share scrap again, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 很好，我们同意。但我们会观察，我们会等待……
entries.en: Very well, we agree. But we watch, we wait...
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wish to integrate our two packs, §Hkssk?§!

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]将会结合，将永远成为[From.GetName]的一部分！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] should combine, should become forever a part of the [From.GetName]!

entries.zh: 很好。我们将融合帝国！我们将合为一体！
entries.en: Very well. We will join packs! We will become one.

entries.zh: 你改变态度了？你不再希望远心族与你的帝国合为一体？
entries.en: Your stance has changed? You no longer desire the Far-Minds to be one with your pack?

entries.zh: 如你所愿，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!远心族仍将属于你，但并不情愿。
entries.en: As you say, §Hkssk!§! The Far-Minds will remain yours, but apart.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是否愿意守望我们，§H嘶嘶嘶§!，而我们也守望你们？
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will watch our backs, §Hkssk§!, and we will watch yours?

entries.zh: 远心族需要盟友，需要朋友，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!如果我们守望你们，你们是否愿意守望我们？
entries.en: The Far-Minds need allies, need friends, §Hkssk!§! If we watch your backs, you will watch ours?

entries.zh: 太好了，是的。远心族将守护你们的帝国。[From.GetName]将守护我们的。
entries.en: Excellent, yes. The Far-Minds will guard your pack. The [From.GetName] will guard ours.

entries.zh: 优势？不。好处不够。我们不能让自己的族伴为[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]冒风险。
entries.en: Advantages? No. Not enough gain. We cannot risk our packmates for [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你不再希望让远心族守望你们？
entries.en: You no longer wish for the Far-Minds to watch your back?

entries.zh: 我们获得的太少。我们失去的太多。我们无法继续守护你们，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: We gain too little. We lose too much. We cannot watch your backs any longer, [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 很好，如你所愿，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们帝国将不再互相守望。
entries.en: Very well, as you say, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Our packs will guard one another no more.
You desire a promise of no aggression?

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]帝国将成为远心族的盟友。将成为朋友。将保证我们之间互不攻击，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] pack should be allies of the Far-Minds. Should be friends. Should promise no aggression between us, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 互不攻击，我们保证，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
我们已决定。我们不会保证！
entries.en: We have decided. We will make no promise!

entries.zh: 你要打破我们帝国之间的互不攻击约定？
entries.en: You would break the pact of no aggression between our packs?

entries.zh: 我们改变了主意。我们可能会攻击。我们可能不会。§H嘶嘶嘶嘶！§!我们无法继续保证！
entries.en: Our minds have changed. We may wish for aggression. We may not. §HKssk kssk!§! We can no longer keep our promise!

entries.zh: 你希望保证远心族的独立，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: You would guard the freedom of the Far-Minds, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: 你的帝国将不会低头，不屈服于任何人？§H嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶！§!远心族将会支持，将会保障。
entries.en: Your pack would be unfettered, ruled by none? §HKssk kssk kssk!§! The Far-Minds will support, will guarantee.

entries.zh: 那我们的敌人将一败涂地，闻风丧胆，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Then our foes have much to lose, much to fear, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 你不再保证远心族的独立？
entries.en: You would no longer guard the freedom of the Far-Minds?

entries.zh: 我们必须把心智转向别处，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!我们无法继续守护你们的土地！
entries.en: Our minds are needed elsewhere, §Hkssk!§! No more can we watch over your lands!

entries.zh: 叛徒！你让我们的帝国孤立无援！
entries.en: Betrayers! You leave our pack surrounded by foes!

entries.zh: 你愿意帮助远心族摆脱我们的主人？
entries.en: You would help free the Far-Minds from our masters?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]受到拘束，没有自由。我们愿意帮助，我们愿意支持！只是需要代价……
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are caged, are not free. We will help, will support! For a price...

entries.zh: 那当时机到来之时，我们将呼唤你……
entries.en: Then we will call upon you, when the time is right...

entries.zh: 我们有更大的事要处理，§H嘶嘶嘶嘶！§!我们无法继续支持你们的独立，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Larger matters press our minds, §Hkssk kssk!§! We can aid your freedom no longer, [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 那就带上你撤回的诺言然后走吧，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Then take your withheld promise and go, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 你希望让远心族与你的帝国同行？
entries.en: You wish the Far-Minds to move amongst your pack?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]！你的帝国强大，聪明，迅速。§H嘶嘶嘶！§!我们远心族愿意与其同行。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! Your pack is strong, smart, swift. §HKssk!§! We Far-Minds would move amongst it.

entries.zh: 好，很好。我们的帝国将结伴，将共享！
entries.en: Good, excellent. Our packs will mingle, will be shared!

entries.zh: 不。我们不愿与[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]结伴，不愿共享！
entries.en: No. We will not live among the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], will not share!

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不再希望让远心族在其帝国间自如来往？
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] no longer wish for the Far-Minds to move freely among their pack?

entries.zh: 我们不再希望共享，不再希望与[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]结伴同行！
entries.en: We no longer wish to share, no longer wish to live and move amongst the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

entries.zh: 那我们将独来独往，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Then we will keep to ourselves, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 你愿意对远心族敞开大门？
entries.en: You would open your walls to the Far-Minds?

entries.zh: 你可以穿越我们的帝国领地，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!不过别久留！
entries.en: You may move through our pack-space, §Hkssk!§! Just do not attempt to stay!

entries.zh: 那么我们将随意穿越你们的帝国领地。§H嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Then we move freely through your pack-space. §HKssk kssk kssk!§!

entries.zh: 你将对远心族关闭你们的帝国领地？
entries.en: You would close off your pack-space from the Far-Minds?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]！我们不再希望你们的船穿过我们的帝国领地。走开！
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! We no longer wish your ships to move through our pack-space. Begone!

entries.zh: 那就你们就看好自己的帝国领地吧！但我们可不会归还你们的废铁，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Then have your pack-space to yourself! But we will not return your scrap, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 你不希望远心族留在你的大帮派子里？真是个错误，真是个过失。
entries.en: You do not want the Far-Minds in your Pack of Many? A mistake, a misstep.

entries.zh: §H嘶嘶嘶！§!你让大帮派子鸡犬不宁！你必须离开，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: §HKssk!§! You bring disquiet to the Pack of Many! You will leave it now, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 好！很好！反正[From.GetAllianceName]是个无用的帝国。我们远心族会自立自强！
entries.en: Good! Fine! A useless pack, the [From.GetAllianceName]. We Far-Minds will be stronger alone!

entries.zh: 你希望远心族与你的大帮派子联合起来？
entries.en: You wish the Far-Minds to associate with your Pack of Many?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，朋友们。[From.GetAllianceName]愿意向你伸出橄榄枝。还没准备好加入大帮派子，不，还没。但作为合作伙伴怎样？
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], friends. The [From.GetAllianceName] would extend to you. Not ready to join the Pack of Many, no, not yet. But as an associate?

entries.zh: 很好。我们远心族将与你的大帮派子更加亲近。
entries.en: Very well. We Far-Minds will grow closer to your Pack of Many.

entries.zh: 我们对你的大帮派子没兴趣，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Your Pack of Many does not interest us, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 大帮派子不再希望联络，§H嘶嘶嘶？§!
entries.en: The Pack of Many no longer desires our contact, §Hkssk?§!

entries.zh: 你的合作伙伴地位：撤销了！大帮派子不再希望与[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]为伴！
entries.en: Your association: revoked! The Pack of Many no longer wishes for [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to be among it!

entries.zh: 你的大帮派子有事找我们，§H嘶嘶嘶？§!
entries.en: Your Pack of Many would speak with us, §Hkssk?§!

entries.zh: 你的大帮派子。我们愿意与你交谈，与你亲近。成为合作伙伴，§H嘶嘶嘶！§!
entries.en: Your Pack of Many. We would speak with you, be near to you. An association, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 是的，很好。大帮派子将与[From.GetName]合作。
entries.en: Yes, good. The Pack of Many will associate with the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 不。我们不希望[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，不想要他们与大帮派子为伴！
entries.en: No. We do not wish for the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], do not desire them among the Pack of Many!

entries.zh: 你希望撤回，不再与大帮派子交谈？
entries.en: You would withdraw, no longer speak with the Pack of Many?

entries.zh: §H嘶嘶撕！§! 你们这一族真是迟钝、愚蠢、无能！我们是不可能合作的！
entries.en: §HKssk kssk kssk!§! Your pack is slow, dull, unfit! No more will you be an associate!

entries.zh: 那就走吧，送客了！我们会终止与[From.GetName]的合作。
entries.en: Then leave, go! We will associate with the [From.GetName] pack no longer.

entries.zh: 你想要我们进贡？§H嘶?§!你想要碎片，宝石还有线？
entries.en: You wish for tribute, §Hkssk?§! You wish for scrap, and gems, and wires?

entries.zh: 弱者，[Root.GetName]可是相当老练的！不过我们可以保护你。只要给我碎片，给我们金属和线还有宝石就行！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] pack is ripe, weak! But we could leave you in peace. Give us scrap, give us metal and wires and gems!

entries.zh: 好吧，可以。你要的东西我们会送来的。相对地你们也不能对远心族出手。§H嘶!§!
entries.en: Very well, yes. We will bring you gifts. In return, you will leave the Far-Minds be. §HKssk!§!

entries.zh: 不！我们拒绝！[From.GetAdj]的承诺根本就什么都不是。你们什么都别想拿到。
entries.en: No! We will not! We do not need [From.GetAdj] promises. You will get nothing from us.

entries.zh: §H嘶§!！你是来给远心族进贡的吗？
entries.en: §HKssk!§! You wish to pay tribute to the Far-Minds?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] 需不需要金属？线呢？知识呢？宝石如何？我们这些都有！§H嘶!§!只要别对我们出手就会进贡给你们。
entries.en: Do the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] care for metals? Wires? Knowledge? Gems? We have these things, §Hkssk!§! Leave us in peace, and we will pay you tribute.

entries.zh: 很好。进贡吧，只要给够了，我们就不会对你们出手！
entries.en: Very good. Pay us, give us gifts, and we will leave you in peace!

entries.zh: 不，我们不需要！§H嘶§!，不需要！
entries.en: No. We do not want, §Hkssk§!, have no need of you!

entries.zh: §H嘶§!你们[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的低下智力都没法给生活所需的物质压缩器接上排气口！
entries.en: §HKssk!§! Your feeble [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] minds could not connect an exhaust port to a matter compressor if your lives depended on it!

entries.zh: §H嘶嘶嘶!§!就连你们的垃圾都没法回收利用。
entries.en: §HKssk kssk kssk!§! Even your pack's scrap is unfit for repurposing.

entries.zh: 无情，残忍。我们会记住的。
我们认输，我们屈服了。快把你的舰队调回去吧，§H嘶嘶嘶§!
entries.en: We submit, we yield! Recall your fleets and be gone with you, §Hkssk§!

entries.zh: 是的！我们获胜了，我们是胜利者！如果你嫌自家的生命、钢铁和宝石太多的话，大可再来挑衅我们！
entries.en: Yes! We are victorious, we overcome! Come to us again, if your metal and gems and lives are too many!

entries.zh: 好吧。没有赢家，也没有胜利者。只有失去的生命，和残骸……
entries.en: Very well. No winner, no victor. Only lost lives, lost scrap...
